en:
Alexios IV Angelos (c. 1182–1204), son of the blinded Emperor Isaac II Angelos, was imprisoned when his uncle Alexios III seized the throne in 1195. Smuggled out of Constantinople in 1201, he fled to his brother-in-law Philip of Swabia and diverted the Fourth Crusade, promising pay, troops and church union.

Isaac II was restored in July 1203 and Alexios crowned co-emperor in August, but he soon clashed with the Latins and the city's populace. Alexios Doukas Mourtzouphlos seized him on 27 January 1204 and had him strangled around 8 February.

en:
Alexios Palaiologos (c. 1140 – before 1203) was a Byzantine sebastos who rose to the high naval rank of megas doux, probably between 1185 and 1190. Around 1180 he married Irene Komnene, daughter of the sebastos John Kantakouzenos and Maria Komnene, a grand-niece of the Emperor Manuel I Komnenos.

Their sons were Michael and Andronikos, the megas domestikos who fathered the Emperor Michael VIII. The typikon with which Michael VIII refounded the monastery of the Archangel Michael names Alexios as the emperor's grandfather.

The typikon also records that Alexios restored the house and ended his life there as the monk Antonios. Irene died a nun.

Alexios Palaiologos (died 1203) was a Byzantine nobleman, son of the megas hetaireiarches George Palaiologos. In spring 1199 Emperor Alexios III Angelos, who had no son, married him to his widowed eldest daughter Irene Angelina and named him despot and heir.

He helped lure the rebel Ivanko to his execution in 1200 and crushed the coup of John Komnenos the Fat in July 1201. He died in 1203, before the Fourth Crusade reached Constantinople; through his daughter Theodora he was an ancestor of the Palaiologan dynasty.

en:
Alexios V Doukas, called Mourtzouphlos for his bushy brows, seized the throne from Alexios IV in a February 1204 palace coup, with the Fourth Crusade camped outside Constantinople. He organized the city's defence and repelled an assault on 9 April.

Three days later the crusaders breached the walls and sacked it; Alexios fled by night to Thrace with Eudokia Angelina. Her father Alexios III had him blinded.

Captured by the Latins in November 1204, he was tried for Alexios IV's death and thrown from the Column of Theodosius. He was the last Byzantine emperor to rule the city before its recapture in 1261.

en:
Anastasius I (c. 430–518), nicknamed Dicorus for his mismatched eyes, was Eastern Roman emperor from 491 to 518. A former silentiary from Dyrrachium, he was chosen at sixty by Zeno's widow Ariadne, who married him.

In the Isaurian War of 492–497 he faced supporters of Zeno's brother Longinus, who held out in the mountains for years. He fought Persia in 502–505 and built the fortress of Daras.

Against Bulgar raids he raised the Long Wall west of Constantinople. His reforms left a vast treasury surplus, though his Monophysite sympathies embittered religious politics. He died in July 518; Justin I succeeded him.

阿纳斯塔修斯一世（约430—518）因双眼瞳色不同而得绰号“双瞳者”，是491年至518年在位的东罗马帝国皇帝。他出身都拉斯，本是宫廷侍从官，约六十岁时被芝诺的遗孀阿里阿德涅选中登基，随后与她成婚。

他在492—497年的伊苏利亚战争中对抗芝诺之弟隆吉努斯的支持者，叛军在山区坚持抵抗多年。他在502—505年与波斯交战，随后修筑达拉要塞。

为抵御保加尔人袭扰，他在君士坦丁堡以西修建长城。他的改革为国库留下巨额盈余，但基督一性论倾向使宗教斗争日趋激烈。518年7月他去世，查士丁一世继位。

en:
Artemius, who took the name Anastasius II (died 719), was a senior imperial secretary when the Opsikion army blinded the Monothelete emperor Philippicus in 713 and raised him to the throne. He restored Orthodoxy by replacing patriarch John VI with Germanus I and repaired relations with Pope Constantine, while rebuilding the fleet against an expected Umayyad attack.

In 715 the fleet mutinied off Rhodes and proclaimed Theodosius III; Anastasius abdicated. In 719 he rebelled against Leo III with Bulgar support, but the Bulgars handed him over and he was executed.

en:
Andreas Ritzos (1421–1492) was a Greek icon painter born in Candia, modern Heraklion, in Venetian-ruled Crete. First recorded as a painter in 1451 and documented as active until 1492, he is counted among the founding fathers of the Cretan School.

Working chiefly in the traditional maniera greca with rich gold backgrounds, he signed his icons both in Greek and as Andreas Rico de Candia, and his Ascension of Christ separates its scenes into compartments. About sixty of his works survive, shaping later Cretan masters down to El Greco; his sons and grandsons also became painters.

安德烈亚斯·里佐斯（1421—1492）是希腊圣像画家，生于威尼斯治下克里特岛的干地亚（今伊拉克利翁）。他1451年首次以画家身份见诸记载，创作活动有据可查持续至1492年，被视为克里特画派的奠基人之一。

他主要沿用传统的“希腊样式”，喜用华丽金底，签名时既用希腊文，也写作“干地亚的安德烈亚斯·里科”。他的《基督升天》以分格安排各个场景。他存世作品约六十幅，影响了后世克里特大师，直至埃尔·格列柯；他的儿孙也多以绘画为业。

Andronikos Angelos Doukas (c. 1133–before 1185) was a Byzantine aristocrat, the third son of Constantine Angelos and Theodora Komnene, and father of the emperors Isaac II and Alexios III.

He led a division in the defeat at Myriokephalon in 1176 and went on an embassy to Jerusalem in 1177. At Charax in 1179 he fled his own army, fearing he was surrounded by Turks.

Sent against the rebel Andronikos I in 1182, he was beaten and defected, then joined a failed plot against him. Escaping with his sons, he took refuge with Saladin and died at Acre before 1185.

安德洛尼卡·杜卡斯·安格洛斯（约1133—1185年前）是拜占庭贵族，君士坦丁·安格洛斯与狄奥多拉·科穆宁娜的第三子，也是后来伊萨克二世、阿历克塞三世两帝之父。

他在1176年密列奥塞法隆战败时指挥一路军队，1177年出使耶路撒冷。1179年他在卡克斯以为被突厥人包围，弃军而逃。

1182年他受命讨伐起兵的安德洛尼卡一世，兵败后倒戈，旋又参与推翻新帝的密谋；事泄后携子出逃，得到萨拉丁的接济，最终客死阿卡，时在1185年之前。

Andronikos Asanes Palaiologos (c. 1330–after 1356) was a Byzantine commander, son of the despot Manuel Komnenos Raoul Asanes and great-grandson of Tsar Ivan Asen III of Bulgaria. After civil war broke out in 1342, John VI Kantakouzenos placed him with his maternal grandfather in Thessalonica; he later joined his father at Bizye.

In 1351 he attended the Second Palamite Council. In December 1354 he led troops to John VI's aid, too late to save the throne, and Matthew Kantakouzenos promoted him to sebastokrator. He is last documented in 1356.

Andronikos Asen (c. 1279–c. 1322) was the son of Tsar Ivan Asen III of Bulgaria and Irene Palaiologina, sister of Emperor Andronikos II. After his parents fled to Byzantium in 1280, he entered imperial service, and in 1316 the emperor named him governor of the province in the Morea.

Exploiting strife within the Frankish Principality of Achaea, he conquered much of the central Morea and in 1320 seized Akova, Karytaina and Saint George, defeating a Frankish army in September. He died about 1322; his daughter Irene married the future emperor John VI Kantakouzenos.

en:
Andronikos Doukas (died 1077) was the son of the Caesar John Doukas and a cousin of Emperor Michael VII. In 1071 he commanded the Byzantine rearguard under Romanos IV at Manzikert; announcing that the emperor had fallen, he deserted the field, and was widely blamed for the catastrophic defeat.

In 1072 he and his brother Constantine hunted the deposed Romanos IV down in Cilicia. In 1074, fighting the rebel Roussel de Bailleul, his own rearguard abandoned them. Captured and badly wounded, he was released to Constantinople, where he died on 14 October 1077. His daughter Irene married Alexios I Komnenos.

安德洛尼卡·杜卡斯（?—1077）是凯撒约翰·杜卡斯之子、皇帝米哈伊尔七世的堂兄弟。1071年，他在罗曼努斯四世麾下指挥曼齐刻尔特战役的拜占庭军后卫，却宣称皇帝已战死并撤离战场，被普遍视为这场惨败的祸首。

1072年，他与兄弟君士坦丁在奇里乞亚追擒被废黜的罗曼努斯四世。1074年讨伐叛将鲁塞尔·德·巴约勒时，己方后卫临阵抛弃了他们。他被俘且身负重伤，获释后前往君士坦丁堡，1077年10月14日卒于该城。其女伊琳娜嫁给阿历克塞一世·科穆宁。

en:
Andronikos I Komnenos (c. 1118–1185), son of the sebastokrator Isaac Komnenos, long intrigued against his cousin Emperor Manuel I and spent years in exile. After Manuel's death in 1180 he marched on Constantinople as protector of the young Alexios II, seized the capital in 1182, and eliminated the regent Maria of Antioch. In September 1183 he was crowned co-emperor and then had Alexios murdered.

As emperor (1183–1185) his brutal reforms curbed the aristocracy and benefited common citizens, but the Norman sack of Thessaloniki in 1185 provoked the uprising in which he was overthrown and killed, the last Komnenian emperor.

安德洛尼卡一世·科穆宁（约1118—1185）是至尊者伊萨克·科穆宁之子，长期与表兄曼努埃尔一世皇帝明争暗斗，流亡多年。1180年曼努埃尔死后，他以保护年幼的阿莱克修斯二世为名进军君士坦丁堡，1182年控制首都，铲除摄政安条克的玛丽。1183年9月他加冕为共治皇帝，随后命人杀害阿莱克修斯。

在位期间（1183—1185）他以严酷手段打击贵族，改革使平民受益；1185年诺曼人洗劫塞萨洛尼基激起民变，他被推翻并杀害，是科穆宁王朝末代皇帝。

en:
Andronikos II Palaiologos (1259–1332) became sole emperor in 1282 and at once repudiated Michael VIII's Union of Lyons. Faced with financial difficulties, he disbanded the imperial fleet in 1285, increasing dependence on Genoa.

The defeat at Bapheus in 1302 opened Anatolia to the Ottoman Turks. The Catalan Company he hired under Roger de Flor turned on Byzantium after de Flor's murder in 1305. Civil war with his grandson Andronikos III forced his abdication in 1328, and he died a monk in 1332.

安德洛尼卡二世·巴列奥略（1259—1332）于1282年成为独自执政的皇帝，随即废除其父米海尔八世与罗马教廷达成的里昂教会联合。面对财政困难，他于1285年解散帝国舰队，加剧了对热那亚的依赖。

1302年巴菲乌斯战败后，安纳托利亚向奥斯曼土耳其人敞开。他雇佣罗杰·德·弗洛率领的加泰罗尼亚佣兵团，结果弗洛于1305年被杀，佣兵团倒戈祸害帝国。与孙子安德洛尼卡三世的内战迫使他于1328年退位，1332年以修士身份去世。

en:
Andronikos III Palaiologos (1297–1341) was the last soldier-emperor of the Palaiologan dynasty. The son of Michael IX and Rita of Armenia, he was co-emperor before 1313. In 1320 he accidentally caused the death of his brother Manuel, and the scandal, together with his wild ways, split him from his grandfather Andronikos II.

He rebelled in 1321, and intermittent civil war ended in 1328 with the old emperor retiring to a monastery. Orhan beat his relief of Nicaea at Pelekanon in 1329 and the Bulgarians beat him at Rusokastro in 1332, yet he recovered Chios, Lesbos, Phocaea, Thessaly and Epirus.

He died in 1341, aged forty-four. The quarrel over the regency between his widow Anna of Savoy and his closest friend John VI Kantakouzenos then became the civil war that opened the way to the Serbian Empire and the Ottomans in Europe.

安德洛尼卡三世·巴列奥略（1297—1341）是巴列奥略王朝最后一位军人皇帝，为米海尔九世与亚美尼亚的丽塔之子，1313年前被立为共治皇帝。1320年他意外导致弟弟曼努埃尔之死，丑闻连同他的放纵作风，使他与祖父安德洛尼卡二世彻底决裂。

他于1321年起兵反叛，断续的内战在1328年以老皇帝退隐修道院告终。1329年他驰援尼西亚，在佩勒卡农败给奥尔汗；1332年又在鲁斯卡斯特罗败于保加利亚人，但他收复了希俄斯、莱斯沃斯、福西亚、色萨利和伊庇鲁斯。

1341年他去世，终年44岁。遗孀萨伏依的安娜与密友约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯争夺摄政权，演变成内战，为塞尔维亚帝国崛起和奥斯曼人进入欧洲打开通路。

Andronikos Kantakouzenos (c. 1334–1347) was the third son of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos and Irene Asanina; his approximate birth year is inferred from his father's History. When civil war broke out in autumn 1341, the boy was in Constantinople with his grandmother Theodora Palaiologina.

The regency first placed him under house arrest and later imprisoned him on Alexios Apokaukos's orders. He died in 1347 during Constantinople's first outbreak of plague, shortly after the civil war ended.

en:
Andronikos Doukas Komnenos Palaiologos (c. 1190–1248/1252) was megas domestikos, or commander-in-chief, of the Empire of Nicaea and the father of Michael VIII, founder of the Palaiologan dynasty. In 1233 he led the expedition against the Caesar Leo Gabalas of Rhodes, forcing him to acknowledge Nicaean suzerainty.

He campaigned with John III Vatatzes at the siege of Thessalonica in 1241, until a Mongol invasion of Asia Minor cut the campaign short. After the city fell in 1246 he governed it as praitor of all Nicaean Macedonia, where his son Michael served under him.

en:
Anna of Hungary (c. 1260–1281) was a princess of the Árpád dynasty, daughter of King Stephen V of Hungary and Elizabeth the Cuman. In 1273 she married Andronikos II Palaiologos, then co-emperor to Michael VIII.

She bore him two sons, the future emperor Michael IX and Constantine, and died in 1281, shortly before Andronikos took the throne. Every Palaiologan emperor down to the fall of Constantinople in 1453 descended from her through Michael IX.

匈牙利的安娜（约1260—1281）是阿帕德王朝公主，匈牙利国王伊什特万五世与库曼人伊丽莎白之女。1273年，她嫁给当时与米哈伊尔八世共治的安德洛尼卡二世·巴列奥略。

她生下后来的皇帝米哈伊尔九世和君士坦丁两个儿子，于1281年去世，不久安德洛尼卡便继位为帝。此后直至1453年君士坦丁堡陷落，每一位巴列奥略朝皇帝都是她经米哈伊尔九世传下的后裔。

Anna Doukaina (born c. 1068) was a Byzantine aristocrat, the second daughter of the protvestiarios Andronikos Doukas and Maria of Bulgaria, and a younger sister of the empress Irene Doukaina. Before 1081 she married the sebastos George Palaiologos, and with her mother persuaded him to side with Alexios I Komnenos against Nikephoros III Botaneiates.

She bore four sons, among them Andronikos and the general Alexios Palaiologos. She was still living around 1118 and had died by 1136.

安娜·杜卡伊娜（约1068年生）是拜占庭贵族女子，为首席衣橱官安德罗尼科斯·杜卡斯与保加利亚的玛丽亚的次女，皇后伊琳娜·杜卡伊娜之妹。1081年之前，她嫁给贵族塞瓦斯托斯·乔治·巴列奥略，并与母亲一同劝说他投效阿历克塞一世·科穆宁、反对尼基弗鲁斯三世·博塔尼亚特斯。

Anna Komnene Angelina (c. 1176–1212) was a daughter of Emperor Alexios III Angelos and Euphrosyne Doukaina Kamatera. Her first husband, the sebastokrator Isaac Komnenos Vatatzes, was captured fighting a Bulgarian revolt in 1195 and died in prison.

In late 1199 she married Theodore Laskaris, and in autumn 1203 fled with him from the Fourth Crusade to Asia Minor. When Theodore founded the Empire of Nicaea in 1205 she became its empress. She died in 1212; her daughters Irene and Maria married John III Vatatzes and Béla IV.

安娜·科穆宁·安杰丽娜（约1176—1212）是皇帝阿历克塞三世·安杰洛斯与欧芙洛绪涅·杜卡伊娜·卡玛特拉之女。首任丈夫至尊者伊萨克·科穆宁·瓦塔特泽斯1195年在讨伐保加利亚起义时被俘，死于狱中。

Anna Komnene Palaiologina (1260–1300) was a Byzantine princess, a daughter of Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos and Empress Theodora Vatatzaina. Michael VIII first betrothed her to Stefan Uroš II Milutin of Serbia, but when Anna arrived the Serbian king answered her rich clothes and jewels by showing the envoys a poorly dressed local woman, and the match collapsed.

In 1278 she married Demetrios Doukas Komnenos Koutroules, a son of Michael II of Epirus, who received despot rank from the emperor; Anna became despoina of Epirus. They had two sons, Andronikos and Constantine.

Anna of Savoy (1306–1365), born Giovanna, was a daughter of Amadeus V, Count of Savoy. In 1326 she married Andronikos III Palaiologos and took the Orthodox name Anna. When Andronikos III died in June 1341, she became regent for her son John V.

With Alexios Apokaukos she fought the 1341–1347 civil war against John VI Kantakouzenos, and in 1343 pawned the crown jewels to Venice; the 1347 settlement left John V co-emperor. From 1351 she held court at Thessalonica, where she died after becoming a nun named Anastasia.

Anna Palaiologina (c. 1302–1320) was a Byzantine princess, daughter of co-emperor Michael IX Palaiologos and Rita of Armenia. In 1304 the Epirote regent Anna Palaiologina Kantakouzene sought her for her son Thomas I Komnenos Doukas; they married around 1307, tying the Despotate of Epirus to Constantinople. Sources hint that Thomas treated her badly.

In 1318 Thomas was murdered by his nephew Nicholas Orsini, who seized Epirus and, though she was technically his aunt, took Anna as his wife. She died two years later, in 1320.

en:
Antoninus Pius (86–161) was Roman emperor from 138 to 161 and the fourth of the Five Good Emperors. After a distinguished senatorial career, the emperor Hadrian adopted him in 138 on condition he in turn adopt Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus. He is said to have taken the name Pius for forcing the Senate to deify Hadrian.

Roman writers praised his simple tastes, strict economy and clemency; he was nicknamed the ‘cummin-splitter’ for his thrift and spent his whole reign near Rome. Work began on the Antonine Wall across southern Scotland in 142, the northernmost frontier barrier of the empire. His reign saw no major revolts or invasions, and he left a large surplus in the treasury.

He died on 7 March 161 after a brief fever, and the last password he gave the night-watch tribune was ‘aequanimitas’, equanimity. Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus succeeded him as joint emperors.

Antoninus Pius (86–161) was Roman emperor from 138 to 161 and the fourth of the Five Good Emperors. After a distinguished senatorial career, the emperor #TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,[GetCharacter('byz_hadrian').GetID],X #L Hadrian#!#! adopted him in 138 on condition he in turn adopt #TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,[GetCharacter('byz_marcus_aurelius').GetID],X #L Marcus Aurelius#!#! and #TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,[GetCharacter('byz_lucius_verus').GetID],X #L Lucius Verus#!#!. He is said to have taken the name Pius for forcing the Senate to deify Hadrian.

Roman writers praised his simple tastes, strict economy and clemency; he was nicknamed the ‘cummin-splitter’ for his thrift and spent his whole reign near Rome. Work began on the Antonine Wall across southern [GetCountry('SCO').GetName] in 142, the northernmost frontier barrier of the empire. His reign saw no major revolts or invasions, and he left a large surplus in the treasury.

He died on 7 March 161 after a brief fever, and the last password he gave the night-watch tribune was ‘aequanimitas’, equanimity. Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus succeeded him as joint emperors.

安敦宁·毕尤（86—161）138年至161年为罗马皇帝，是五贤帝中的第四位。历经显赫的元老仕途后，皇帝哈德良于138年收他为养子，条件是他再收马可·奥勒留和卢基乌斯·维鲁斯为养子。一说他因逼元老院将哈德良封神而得名“毕尤”。

罗马作家称赞他生活简朴、节俭宽厚；他因吝啬得绰号“剖孜然者”，在位期间始终住在罗马近郊。142年，穿越苏格兰南部的安多宁长城动工，那是帝国最靠北的边境屏障。他在位期间没有大规模叛乱或入侵，给国库留下大笔盈余。

161年3月7日，他短暂发烧后去世，给夜巡护民官的最后口令是“平静”。马可·奥勒留和卢基乌斯·维鲁斯作为共治皇帝继位。

en:
Arcadius (c. 377–408), eldest son of Theodosius I, was proclaimed augustus in 383 and inherited the eastern empire in 395, his brother Honorius taking the west. A passive ruler, he was dominated in turn by the prefect Rufinus, the eunuch Eutropius, and his wife Aelia Eudoxia, whom he married in 395.

Alaric's Goths ravaged Greece, Eutropius fell in 399, and in 400 the Gothic general Gainas lost his followers in a massacre at Constantinople and was killed after fleeing. Eudoxia died in 404 after securing the exile of John Chrysostom, and Arcadius himself died on 1 May 408, leaving the throne to his seven-year-old son, Theodosius II.

Ariadne (c. 450–515) was a daughter of Emperor Leo I and Verina. In 467 she married the Isaurian officer Tarasicodissa, renamed Zeno; their son Leo II was born that year. After Leo I died in 474, she and Verina had the child emperor crown Zeno co-emperor, and when Leo II died that November Zeno became sole emperor with Ariadne as his empress.

On Zeno's death in 491 she chose the silentiary Anastasius and married him, securing the throne for Anastasius I. She died in 515 and is venerated as an Orthodox saint on 22 August.

阿里阿德涅（约450—515）是皇帝利奥一世与维里娜之女。467年，她嫁给伊苏里亚军官塔拉西科迪萨，此人改名芝诺；同年儿子利奥二世出生。474年利奥一世去世后，她与维里娜促使幼帝加冕芝诺为共治皇帝；同年11月利奥二世夭折，芝诺成为独自执政的皇帝，阿里阿德涅为皇后。

491年芝诺去世，她选出宫廷侍卫官阿纳斯塔修斯继位并下嫁于他，为阿纳斯塔修斯一世稳住帝位。她于515年去世，被东正教尊为圣人，瞻礼日为8月22日。

en:
Aurelian (214–275) pulled the Roman empire back together after it had split in three. When Claudius II died in 270, the legions at Sirmium proclaimed Aurelian emperor. The east had fallen to the Palmyrene Empire and the west to the Gallic Empire.

He defeated invading Alamanni in Italy, began his walls of Rome, beat the Goths beyond the Danube and gave up Dacia. In 272 he marched on Queen Zenobia of Palmyra; she appeared in his triumph in golden chains together with her son, and when the city rebelled in 273 he let his soldiers sack it. In 274 he defeated Tetricus at Châlons, ending the Gallic Empire and earning the title Restitutor Orbis.

In 275, preparing to march against Persia, he was murdered in Thrace by officers who feared punishment after a secretary forged a death list. The Senate briefly condemned his memory, then made him a god.

奥勒良（214—275）把一分为三的罗马帝国重新拼合起来。270年克劳狄二世去世，西尔米乌姆的军团拥立奥勒良为帝。此时东部已落入帕米拉帝国，西部则组成高卢帝国。

他在意大利击败入侵的阿勒曼尼人，动工修建以他命名的罗马城墙，又在多瑙河以北击败哥特人并放弃达契亚。272年他进军帕米拉女王芝诺比阿；芝诺比阿戴着金锁链，与儿子一同在他的凯旋式上游街，273年帕米拉再度叛乱，他纵兵洗劫该城。274年他在沙隆击败泰特里库斯，终结高卢帝国，赢得“世界光复者”称号。

275年，他正准备进军波斯，却在色雷斯被军官杀害——一名秘书伪造了处决名单，军官们担心受罚便先下手。元老院一度谴责他的名誉，随后将他封神。

en:
Balbinus (c. 178–238) was a wealthy Roman patrician, twice consul and famed as an orator. After the deaths of the Gordians in Africa, the Senate elected Balbinus and Pupienus joint emperors in April 238, though Rome forced the young Gordian III upon them.

Balbinus stayed in the capital while Pupienus campaigned against Maximinus, but failed to keep public order. After his return they fell to mutual suspicion, and in July or August 238 Praetorians murdered both after ninety-nine days.

巴尔比努斯（约178—238）是富有的罗马贵族，两度出任执政官，以演说家闻名。戈尔迪安父子在阿非利加败亡后，元老院于238年4月推举巴尔比努斯与普皮恩努斯共同称帝，但罗马城方面迫使他们接纳年幼的戈尔迪安三世为共治皇帝。

普皮恩努斯出征马克西米努斯期间，巴尔比努斯留守首都，却未能维持治安。普皮恩努斯凯旋后二人互生猜忌；238年7月或8月，禁卫军将二人一同杀害，他们共在位九十九天。

en:
Barlaam of Seminara (c. 1290–1348), born in Greek-speaking Calabria, was a Basilian monk who came to Constantinople in the 1320s and taught at the university under Andronikos III. Learned in the classics, astronomy and mathematics, his sarcasm put off even his friends.

In 1333–1334 he negotiated church union with envoys of Pope John XXII, writing treatises against papal primacy and the Filioque. In 1339 he went to Pope Benedict XII at Avignon to propose a crusade against the Turks, and gave Petrarch his first Greek lessons there.

His attack on Gregory Palamas and Hesychast prayer ended in 1341, when two synods ruled against him. He joined the Latin Church in 1342, became bishop of Gerace and died there in 1348.

塞米纳拉的巴拉姆（约1290—1348）生于卡拉布里亚讲希腊语的地区，是巴西略会修士，1320年代来到君士坦丁堡，在安德洛尼卡三世治下的大学任教。他通晓古典、天文与数学，言辞尖刻，连朋友也被得罪。

1333至1334年，他与教皇约翰二十二世的使节谈判教会合一，撰写论文反对教皇首席权和“和子句”。1339年他前往阿维尼翁觐见教皇本笃十二世，建议组织十字军对抗土耳其人，并在当地向彼特拉克传授希腊语入门。

他抨击格列高利·帕拉马斯和静修派祈祷，1341年两次主教会议裁定他理亏。1342年他加入拉丁教会，出任杰拉切主教，1348年死于该地。

en:
Basil I the Macedonian (811–886) ruled Byzantium from 867 to 886 and founded the Macedonian dynasty. A peasant from the theme of Macedonia, he became Michael III's favourite and was named co-emperor in 866, then murdered Michael in 867 to rule alone.

His legal reforms became the sixty-book Basilika under Leo VI, and his army crushed the Paulicians at Tephrike in 872. He restored Ignatios as patriarch, improving relations with Rome, and campaigned against the Arabs in Italy. He died after a hunting accident in August 886 and was succeeded by Leo VI.

en:
Basil II (958–1025), called the Bulgar-Slayer, was senior Byzantine emperor from 976 until his death. Crowned co-emperor in 960, he escaped the regent Basil Lekapenos only in 985, after two generals had held the throne before him.

He crushed the revolts of Bardas Skleros and Bardas Phokas by 989 and, after long warfare, annexed the First Bulgarian Empire. He married his sister Anna to Vladimir I of Kiev in exchange for military support, forming the Varangian Guard, and the marriage led to the conversion of Rus'. He curbed the landowning families and campaigned against Georgia, leaving Byzantium at its greatest extent in four centuries.

en:
Basil Vatatzes (died 1194) was a Byzantine commander from the Adrianople region. He rose under Manuel I Komnenos and c. 1187 married a cousin of Isaac II Angelos. By 1189 he held a provincial governorship, and after promotion to command in the Thracesian Theme he crushed the rebel Theodore Mankaphas near Philadelphia c. 1192 and drove him to the Seljuks.

As Domestic of the West, he confronted the Bulgarian rebellion and refused to back his brother-in-law Constantine Angelos Doukas's revolt in 1193. In 1194 he was killed fighting the Bulgarians at the Battle of Arcadiopolis. He was likely the father of the Nicaean emperor John III Vatatzes.

en:
Gaius Julius Caesar Germanicus (AD 12–41), known as Caligula, was the third Roman emperor, ruling 37–41. The son of the general Germanicus and Agrippina, he followed his father's campaigns as a boy in a miniature soldier's outfit, and the soldiers nicknamed him Caligula, 'little boot'. After Germanicus's death he joined Tiberius.

When Tiberius died in 37, the Praetorians hailed the 24-year-old and the Senate gave him in one day all Augustus's powers. He doubled the Praetorians' payment, gave every citizen in Rome 150 sesterces, built theatres and aqueducts, annexed Mauretania and abandoned an invasion of Britain.

Ancient writers, mostly senators, portrayed him as a tyrant who demanded worship as a god and planned to make his horse Incitatus consul; modern historians doubt many of these stories. In January 41 Praetorian tribunes killed him beneath the palace, with his wife and daughter. The Praetorians made his uncle Claudius emperor.

盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·凯撒·日耳曼尼库斯，绰号卡利古拉（公元12—41年），是罗马帝国第三任皇帝，37至41年在位。他是名将日耳曼尼库斯与阿格里皮娜之子，幼年穿迷你军装随父征战，士兵戏称他“卡利古拉”，意为“小军靴”。日耳曼尼库斯死后，他入侍提比略。

提比略去世后，禁卫军拥立24岁的卡利古拉，元老院一日内授以奥古斯都的全部权力。他加倍禁卫军赏金，给每个罗马人发放150塞斯特提乌斯，兴建剧场与水道，并吞毛里塔尼亚，放弃入侵不列颠。

古代作家多为元老，把他写成要求被神化、打算让爱马因基塔图斯任执政官的暴君；现代史家多有存疑。41年1月，禁卫军保民官在宫中将他刺死，妻女同被杀。禁卫军拥立叔父克劳狄称帝。

en:
Caracalla (188–217), born Lucius Septimius Bassianus, was Roman emperor from 198, ruling alone from 211. By 205 he had executed Prefect Plautianus, whose daughter he was forced to marry. After Severus died in 211 he fell out with his brother Geta, and that December guardsmen killed Geta in their mother's arms. Caracalla had 20,000 of Geta's supporters massacred.

In 212 his Antonine Constitution gave Roman citizenship to nearly all free inhabitants of the empire. He lavished money on the army and raised its pay, debasing the coinage. He built the Baths of Caracalla and, obsessed with Alexander the Great, wintered at Alexandria before invading Parthia in 216.

In April 217 a soldier stabbed him, and the praetorian prefect Macrinus took the throne three days later. The Senate disliked him, but his army popularity protected his memory: Macrinus had him deified, while ancient writers portray him as a tyrant.

卡拉卡拉（188—217）本名卢基乌斯·塞普蒂米乌斯·巴西亚努斯，198年起为罗马皇帝，211年起独掌大权。205年前，他处死被迫迎娶其女的禁卫军长官普劳提阿努斯。211年塞维鲁去世后，他与弟弟盖塔反目，12月士兵在母亲怀中杀死盖塔，两万名盖塔的支持者遭屠杀。

212年他颁布安东尼努斯敕令，把罗马公民权授予帝国几乎所有自由民。他对军队挥金如土、提高军饷，为此降低钱币成色。他修建卡拉卡拉浴场，又因迷恋亚历山大大帝，曾在亚历山大里亚过冬，于216年入侵安息。

217年4月，一名士兵将他刺死，禁卫军长官马克里努斯三天后称帝。元老院厌恶他，但他的军中声望保住身后名：马克里努斯将他奉为神，古代作家则把他描绘成暴君。

en:
Chandrenos was a Byzantine general from a landowning family in Asia Minor who fought the Turks until his ancestral lands were lost. He fought in the defeat by the Catalan Company at the Battle of Apros in 1305, then served in Macedonia under Angelos Palaiologos, helping save Thessalonica from siege and driving the Catalans into Thessaly.

In 1309 he repelled a Serbian invasion aided by Turks. Around 1310–1311 he was accused of treason in Constantinople, where the scholar Thomas Magistros defended him before Andronikos II.

en:
Claudius II Gothicus (214–270) was a senior officer under Gallienus. After Gallienus was murdered by his officers in 268, Claudius was proclaimed emperor as the empire faced invasions and the breakaway Gallic Empire held its western provinces.

With his cavalry leader Aurelian he destroyed the Gothic host at the Battle of Naissus (268–269), earning the surname Gothicus, and that autumn routed the Alemanni at Lake Benacus. He also recovered Hispania and the Rhône valley from the Gallic Empire. Preparing a campaign against the Vandals at Sirmium, he died of plague in 270. The Senate deified him, and Aurelian succeeded him after his brother Quintillus's brief reign.

“哥特征服者”克劳狄二世（214—270）是在加里恩努斯麾下晋升的高级将领。268年加里恩努斯被军官杀害后，军队拥立克劳狄为帝，当时帝国面临外敌入侵，分离出去的高卢帝国占据西部行省。

他与骑兵统帅奥勒良在纳伊苏斯战役（268—269）中击溃哥特大军，因此得到“哥特库斯”（哥特征服者）的称号，同年秋又在贝纳库斯湖大败阿勒曼尼人，并从高卢帝国手中收复西班牙与罗讷河谷。270年，他在西尔米乌姆筹备远征汪达尔人时死于瘟疫。元老院将他神化，其弟昆提卢斯短暂称帝后，奥勒良继位。

en:
Commodus (161–192), son of Marcus Aurelius and the first emperor born in the purple, ruled from 177 to 192. When Marcus died in 180, he made peace with the tribes and returned to Rome in triumph. He left administration to favourites who sold offices, until a mob forced Cleander's beheading in 190.

His sister Lucilla's conspiracy failed in 182, and later plots made him more dictatorial. He posed as Hercules and fought as a gladiator, and in 192 renamed Rome Colonia Commodiana and declared himself a new Romulus. Cassius Dio called his accession a fall from a golden kingdom to iron and rust.

In December 192 his mistress Marcia, the prefect Laetus and the chamberlain Eclectus, on his death list, sent Narcissus to strangle him in his bath. The Senate declared him a public enemy, the dynasty ended, and Pertinax began the Year of the Five Emperors.

Commodus (161–192), son of #TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,[GetCharacter('byz_marcus_aurelius').GetID],X #L Marcus Aurelius#!#! and the first emperor born in the purple, ruled from 177 to 192. When Marcus died in 180, he made peace with the tribes and returned to Rome in triumph. He left administration to favourites who sold offices, until a mob forced Cleander's beheading in 190.

His sister Lucilla's conspiracy failed in 182, and later plots made him more dictatorial. He posed as Hercules and fought as a gladiator, and in 192 renamed Rome Colonia Commodiana and declared himself a new Romulus. Cassius Dio called his accession a fall from a golden kingdom to iron and rust.

In December 192 his mistress Marcia, the prefect Laetus and the chamberlain Eclectus, on his death list, sent Narcissus to strangle him in his bath. The Senate declared him a public enemy, the dynasty ended, and #TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,[GetCharacter('byz_pertinax').GetID],X #L Pertinax#!#! began the Year of the Five Emperors.
zh:
康茂德（161—192）是马可·奥勒留之子，也是第一位“生于紫室”的皇帝，177年至192年在位。180年马可死于多瑙河前线，他与诸部落议和，返回罗马举行凯旋式。他懒理政务，任由宠臣卖官，直到190年罗马民众施压，他下令将被释奴克里安德斩首。

182年姐姐露西拉的阴谋失败，此后他越发独断。他以赫拉克勒斯自居，亲自下场角斗，192年自称新罗慕路斯，把罗马改名为康茂德殖民城。卡西乌斯·狄奥认为，他登基使国家从黄金王国沦为铁锈王国。

192年12月，情妇玛尔奇娅、长官莱图斯和内侍埃克莱克图斯发现自己上了处死名单，便派纳尔基索斯在浴室勒死他。元老院宣布他为公敌，安敦尼王朝终结，佩蒂纳克斯开启“五帝之年”。

en:
Constans I (c. 323–350), youngest son of Constantine the Great and Fausta, was made caesar in 333 and became augustus in 337, receiving Italy, Illyricum and Africa. In 340 his troops ambushed and killed the invading Constantine II near Aquileia, seizing Gaul, Spain and Britain.

He later quarrelled with his surviving brother Constantius II over the exiled bishop Athanasius. He campaigned against the Franks in 341–342 and crossed to Britain in 343, the last legitimate emperor to visit it for a millennium. In January 350 the general Magnentius was proclaimed emperor at Autun; Constans fled toward the Pyrenees and was hunted down and killed.

zh:
君士坦斯一世（约323—350）是君士坦丁大帝与福斯塔的幼子，333年被立为凯撒，337年成为奥古斯都，领有意大利、伊利里库姆和阿非利加。340年其兄君士坦丁二世入侵，他的军队在阿奎莱亚附近设伏将其杀死，夺取高卢、西班牙和不列颠。

此后，他与在世的兄长君士坦提乌斯二世因流亡主教亚他那修发生争执。341至342年他征讨法兰克人，343年渡海前往不列颠，是此后千年间最后一位到访该岛的正统皇帝。350年1月，将领马格嫩提乌斯在欧坦称帝；君士坦斯逃往比利牛斯山方向，终被追兵捕杀。

en:
Constans II (630–668), son of Constantine III, was crowned Byzantine co-emperor in 641 and became sole emperor after Heraklonas was deposed later that year.

Egypt was lost in 642, and in 655 the Arabs crushed his fleet at the Battle of the Masts. His Typos of 648 forbade debate over Christ's natures, and in 653 he had Pope Martin I exiled.

In 663, after campaigning against the Lombards in Italy, he became the first emperor to visit Rome since 476. He was murdered in his bath at Syracuse by his chamberlain in 668 and was succeeded by his son Constantine IV.

他在位时埃及于642年沦丧，655年阿拉伯人在桅杆之战歼灭其舰队。648年他颁布《提波斯》敕令，禁止争论基督的本性；653年又将教皇马丁一世流放。

en:
Constantine I, called the Great (c. 272–337), was the Roman emperor who ended the Tetrarchy, favoured Christianity and founded Constantinople. Born at Naissus, son of Constantius and Helena, he was raised at Diocletian’s court; passed over at Diocletian’s abdication in 305, he joined his father in Britain and was hailed Augustus in 306.

In 312 he defeated Maxentius at the Milvian Bridge, where Eusebius records a vision of the Chi Rho. In 313 he and Licinius issued the Edict of Milan, allowing Christians to worship freely. He ruled alone from 324, summoned the Council of Nicaea in 325 and in 330 dedicated Byzantium as his new capital, Constantinople.

In 326 he had his eldest son Crispus put to death and wife Fausta killed in an overheated bath. He fell ill in 337 and was baptized only on his deathbed, leaving the empire to his three sons by Fausta.

zh:
君士坦丁一世，世称君士坦丁大帝（约272—337），是终结四帝共治、扶持基督教并建立君士坦丁堡的罗马皇帝。他生于奈苏斯，父亲是君士坦提乌斯，母亲是海伦娜，在戴克里先的宫廷长大；305年戴克里先退位时他被排除在继承之外，便赴不列颠投奔父亲，306年被军队拥立为奥古斯都。

312年他在米尔维安桥击败马克森提乌斯，据优西比乌记载他看到“凯乐”异象。313年他与李锡尼颁布《米兰敕令》，允许基督徒自由礼拜。324年起他独掌大权，325年召集尼西亚公会议，330年以拜占庭为新都，定名君士坦丁堡。

326年他处死长子克里斯普斯，又把妻子福斯塔杀死在过热的浴室里。337年他病倒，直到临终才受洗，把帝国留给福斯塔所生的三个儿子。

en:
Constantine II (316–340), second son of Constantine the Great and eldest by Fausta, was made caesar in 317 as an infant. From his court at Trier he campaigned against the Sarmatians, Alamanni and Goths, and in 337 allowed the exiled bishop Athanasius to return to Alexandria.

After Constantine I died in 337, he and his brothers divided the empire, taking Gaul, Spain and Britain. Claiming seniority over his younger brother Constans, he invaded Italy in 340 and was trapped and killed near Aquileia, after which Constans seized his lands and his memory was condemned.

en:
Constantine III (612–641), born Heraclius Constantine, was the eldest son of Heraclius. Crowned Augustus in 613, he helped defend Constantinople against the Avar and Persian siege of 626 while his father campaigned in the East.

He married Gregoria, and their son Constans II was born in 630. His stepmother Martina’s rising influence weakened his position, and when Heraclius died in 641, Constantine ruled jointly with his half-brother Heraklonas.

Dying of tuberculosis, he sent money to the soldiers to secure his sons’ succession. Rumours that Martina had poisoned him provoked the army to overthrow her and enthrone Constans II.

君士坦丁三世（612—641）原名希拉克略·君士坦丁，是希拉克略的长子。他613年加冕为奥古斯都，626年父亲东征期间协助守卫君士坦丁堡，抵御阿瓦尔人与波斯人围城。

他娶格雷戈里娅为妻，630年生下儿子君士坦斯二世。继母玛蒂娜势力日盛，使他的地位受到削弱；641年希拉克略去世后，他与异母弟赫拉克洛纳斯共同执政。

他因肺结核病逝，临终前送钱款给士兵以确保儿子们的继承权。玛蒂娜毒杀他的传言激起军队发难，玛蒂娜一党被推翻，君士坦斯二世登上帝位。

en:
Constantine IV (c. 650–685) was Byzantine emperor from 668, the eldest son of Constans II. He first crushed the Sicilian usurper Mezezius. Arab fleets assaulted Constantinople from 670, but his defence forced Caliph Mu'awiya I to sue for peace, the first major Arab reverse in fifty years.

In 680 he convened the Sixth Ecumenical Council, which condemned monothelitism. He besieged Khan Asparukh's Bulgars in their fortified camp, but illness forced him to leave the army and it was defeated. In 681 he recognized their state in Moesia and paid them tribute. He died of dysentery in 685 and was succeeded by his son Justinian II.

君士坦丁四世（约650—685）668年登基，是君士坦斯二世的长子。他首先平定了西西里僭位者梅泽齐乌斯。阿拉伯舰队自670年起进攻君士坦丁堡，但被他的守御击退，哈里发穆阿维叶一世被迫求和，这是阿拉伯人五十年来首次重大挫败。

680年他召开第六次大公会议，谴责基督一志论。他围攻阿斯巴鲁赫汗的保加利亚人设防营地，却因病离开军队，军队随即溃败。681年他承认其在默西亚建立的国家并缴纳岁币。685年他死于痢疾，其子查士丁尼二世继位。

680年他召开第六次大公会议，谴责基督一志论。他围攻阿斯巴鲁赫汗的[GetCountry('BUL').GetName]人设防营地，却因病离开军队，军队随即溃败。681年他承认其在默西亚建立的国家并缴纳岁币。685年他死于痢疾，其子#TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,[GetCharacter('byz_justinian_ii').GetID],X #L 查士丁尼二世#!#!继位。

en:
Constantine IX Monomachos (c. 1000–1055) became Byzantine emperor in 1042 by marrying Empress Zoë, sharing the throne with her and her sister Theodora. Exiled by Michael IV, he was recalled after Michael V’s overthrow.

He won two civil wars and repelled a Kievan Rus’ raid, and annexed the Armenian kingdom of Ani, but was humiliated by the Pechenegs and could not check the rising Seljuq Turks. His lavish spending and the first permanent debasement of the gold coinage since Constantine the Great emptied the treasury. He also attempted legal reform, founding a law school, and in 1054 the Great Schism split Rome and Constantinople. He died in 1055.

君士坦丁九世·莫诺马科斯（约1000—1055）于1042年迎娶女皇邹伊，与邹伊及其妹狄奥多拉共掌皇权，由此成为拜占庭皇帝。他先前被米哈伊尔四世流放，米哈伊尔五世被推翻后获召回。

他两度赢得内战，击退基辅罗斯人的袭扰，在位期间吞并亚美尼亚阿尼王国，但败于佩切涅格人，也无力阻挡崛起的塞尔柱突厥人。他挥霍无度，并自君士坦丁大帝以来首次持续贬值金币，耗尽国库。他还尝试改革法律，创办法学院；1054年东西教会大分裂发生在他治下。他于1055年病逝。

en:
Constantine Palaiologos (1278/1281–1334/1335) was the second son of Emperor Andronikos II, a purple-born prince made Despot in 1294 on his marriage to Eudokia.

In 1305 he fought under his brother Michael IX at the rout of Apros against the Catalan Company, and in 1317 turned back his half-sister Simonis, who had fled Serbia for a monastery. A second marriage to another Eudokia was also childless, though he had an illegitimate son, Michael.

He governed Avlona and Thessalonica until his nephew Andronikos III imprisoned him. He died as the monk Kallistos in 1334 or 1335.

zh:
君士坦丁·巴列奥略（1278/1281—1334/1335）是皇帝安德洛尼卡二世的次子，是“生于紫室”的皇子。1294年他娶欧多基娅，受封专制君主。

1305年他在兄长米海尔九世麾下参加对加泰罗尼亚佣兵团的阿普罗斯惨败；1317年异母妹妹西莫妮达想出家、离开塞尔维亚，被他截下送回。他后来再娶另一位欧多基娅，两次婚姻均无子女，但有一个非婚生子米海尔。

他曾任阿夫洛纳和塞萨洛尼基总督，后被侄子安德洛尼卡三世囚禁，出家后取教名卡利斯托，1334或1335年去世。

en:
Constantine V (718–775), son of Leo III, became emperor in 741 and immediately faced the usurpation of his brother-in-law Artabasdos. While Artabasdos held Constantinople, Constantine won support in the Anatolic and Thracesian themes, defeated him at Sardis in 743 and later blinded him.

In 746–747 his forces recovered Cyprus and destroyed the Arab navy. His iconoclast council at Hieria in 754 condemned icon veneration and unleashed persecution of monks.

He created the professional tagmata regiments and waged repeated wars on Bulgaria, crushing Khan Telets at Anchialus in 763, and settled Christians from the Arab frontier in Thrace. He died campaigning in 775, leaving a strengthened empire to his son Leo IV.

zh:
君士坦丁五世（718—775）是利奥三世之子，741年即位，随即面临姐夫阿尔塔瓦兹德篡位。阿尔塔瓦兹德占据君士坦丁堡时，君士坦丁得到安纳托利亚和色雷西亚军区的支持；743年他在萨第斯击败对手，后来将其刺瞎。

746—747年，他的军队收复塞浦路斯并歼灭阿拉伯海军。754年他在希里亚召开圣像破坏派主教会议，定圣像崇拜为异端，大肆迫害修士。

他组建精锐的职业中央军塔格马塔，连年征伐保加尔，763年在安基阿卢斯大破汗王捷列茨，又把阿拉伯边境的基督徒迁至色雷斯。775年他在征战途中病逝，把更为强盛的帝国留给儿子利奥四世。

en:
Constantine VI (771–c. 798), only child of Leo IV and Irene, was crowned co-emperor in 776 and became sole emperor in 780, aged nine, with his mother as regent.

An Armeniac revolt enabled him to take power in 790, but in 792 he restored Irene as co-ruler and suffered a humiliating defeat by the Bulgars at Marcellae. He crushed an Armeniac revolt in 793, then divorced his wife Maria to marry his mistress Theodote, alienating the church.

In 797 Irene’s supporters seized and blinded him; he died before 805, possibly soon after from his wounds, the last emperor universally recognized as Roman.

君士坦丁六世（771—约798）是利奥四世与伊琳娜的独子，776年被立为共治皇帝，780年九岁时成为唯一皇帝，由母亲摄政。

790年亚美尼亚军区士兵的叛乱使他亲掌大权，但792年他恢复伊琳娜的共治者地位，又在马塞莱惨败于保加尔。793年他镇压了亚美尼亚军区的叛乱，随后与妻子玛丽亚离婚、改娶情妇狄奥多蒂，因而与教会交恶。

797年伊琳娜的党羽将他拘捕并刺瞎双眼，他在805年之前去世，可能不久后便因伤而死，是最后一位被普遍承认的罗马皇帝。

en:
Constantine VII Porphyrogenitus (905–959) was Byzantine emperor from 913 to 959, ruling alone only after 944. Son of Leo VI, he was born in the Purple Room and crowned co-emperor at two.

Regents ruled for him: the patriarch Nicholas, his mother, then from 920 his father-in-law Romanos Lekapenos, whose daughter Helena he married. After Romanos fell in 944, he removed the Lekapenoi and ruled alone.

A scholar-emperor, he wrote De Administrando Imperio and De Ceremoniis. He ordered peasant lands restored in 947 and died in 959, succeeded by his son Romanos II.

zh:
君士坦丁七世，绰号“生于紫室者”（905—959），913年至959年为拜占庭皇帝，但直到944年后才独自掌权。他是利奥六世之子，生于宫中紫室，两岁即被加冕为共治皇帝。

长期由他人代掌国政：先是牧首尼古拉，其后是生母，920年起则是他的岳父罗曼努斯·利卡潘努斯，他娶了其女海伦娜。944年罗曼努斯倒台后，他清除利卡潘努斯家族，开始独掌大权。

作为学者型皇帝，他撰写《帝国行政论》和《典仪论》。947年他下令归还农民土地，959年去世，其子罗曼努斯二世继位。

en:
Constantine VIII (960–1028) was de jure Byzantine emperor for sixty-six years, yet ruled in his own right only from 1025. Crowned co-emperor in 962, the younger son of Romanos II spent his life as nominal colleague to senior emperors, above all his brother Basil II.

Little interested in government, he loved wrestling and riding but later suffered from gout. When Basil died childless in 1025, his three-year reign saw Basil’s land laws abandoned under aristocratic pressure and cruel purges. On his death in 1028 he was succeeded by his daughter Zoe’s husband, Romanos III Argyros.

君士坦丁八世（960—1028）名义上做了六十六年拜占庭皇帝，但直到1025年才独自掌权。他是罗曼努斯二世的小儿子，962年被加冕为共治皇帝，此后一直挂名在一众资深皇帝之下，尤其是兄长巴西尔二世。

en:
Constantius I, nicknamed Chlorus (c. 250–306), was a Roman emperor of the Tetrarchy and father of Constantine the Great. A career soldier from Moesia Superior, he rose to become Maximian’s praetorian prefect, divorced Helena to marry Maximian’s daughter Theodora, and in 293 was made caesar of the western provinces.

From Gaul he overthrew the British usurpers Carausius and Allectus and campaigned against the Alamanni and Franks; in the persecution of 303 he only demolished churches. He became augustus in 305 and died at Eboracum in 306, where his army proclaimed Constantine emperor, hastening the Tetrarchy’s collapse.

君士坦提乌斯一世绰号克洛鲁斯（约250—306），是罗马帝国四帝共治时期的皇帝，也是君士坦丁大帝之父。他生于上默西亚，以军功起家，升任马克西米安的禁卫军长官，与海伦娜离婚、另娶马克西米安之女狄奥多拉，293年被立为西部凯撒。

他以高卢为基地，消灭了不列颠的篡位者卡劳修斯和阿莱克图斯，又征讨阿勒曼尼人和法兰克人；303年大迫害开始后，他境内仅拆毁教堂，并不搜捕基督徒。305年他成为奥古斯都，306年卒于埃伯拉肯，军队随即拥立君士坦丁为帝，加速了四帝共治的瓦解。

en:
Constantius II (317–361), son of Constantine the Great, was made caesar in 324. In 337, after his father’s death and a massacre of kinsmen, he took the East. Years of inconclusive war with Persia followed while his brothers fought in the West.

After Magnentius killed Constans in 350, he crushed the usurper at Mursa in 351 and Mons Seleucus in 353, becoming sole emperor. He made Gallus and then Julian caesar, promoted Arianism and banned pagan sacrifices.

War with Persia resumed in 359. Julian’s revolt in 360 drew him west, but fever killed him at Mopsuestia in 361.

君士坦提乌斯二世（317—361）是君士坦丁大帝之子，324年被立为凯撒。337年父亲去世、宗室成员遭屠杀后，他成为奥古斯都，领有帝国东部。此后他与波斯进行多年代价高昂而未决胜负的战争，其兄弟则在西部争夺领地。

350年马格嫩提乌斯杀害君士坦斯，他于351年穆尔萨战役、353年塞琉古山战役击败篡位者，成为唯一皇帝。他先后立加卢斯和朱利安为凯撒，扶持阿里乌派，禁止异教献祭。

359年与波斯的战争再起。360年朱利安起兵促使他西返，他却于361年在莫普苏埃斯蒂亚染热病而死。

en:
Decius (c. 201–251), born at Budalia in Pannonia, was among the first emperors from the Danubian provinces. Serving under Philip the Arab, he was sent in 249 to put down a Danube revolt, only to be hailed emperor by his troops; he defeated and killed Philip near Verona.

In 250 his edict ordering sacrifice to the Roman gods launched the first empire-wide persecution of Christians, martyring Pope Fabian.

After Cniva’s Goths captured Philippopolis, he returned with a reorganized army, and in 251 he and his son Herennius Etruscus fell at the Battle of Abritus, the first Roman emperor slain fighting a foreign foe.

德西乌斯（约201—251）生于潘诺尼亚的布达里亚，是最早一批出身多瑙河行省的皇帝之一。他在阿拉伯人菲利普治下任职，249年奉命平定多瑙河前线的叛乱，军队却拥立他为帝，同年他在维罗纳击败并杀死菲利普。

250年，他颁布敕令要求全体居民向罗马诸神献祭，由此掀起第一次遍及全帝国的基督徒迫害，教宗法比安殉道。

哥特王尼瓦攻陷菲利波波利斯后，德西乌斯率重组的军队返回；251年他与儿子赫伦尼乌斯·埃特鲁斯库斯在阿伯里图斯战役中迎战哥特人，双双战死，他也成为第一位在抗击外敌的战役中阵亡的罗马皇帝。

Demetrios Koutroules (fl. 1278–1304), born Demetrios Doukas Komnenos and later renamed Michael, was the third son of Michael II of Epirus. In 1278 he married Anna Palaiologina, daughter of Emperor Michael VIII, who made him despot.

He served in the Byzantine army at the siege of Berat against Charles of Anjou and later campaigned against the Alans. In 1304 he was accused of plotting against Andronikos II and imprisoned, after which nothing more is heard of him.

Demetrios Palaiologos (c. 1295 – after 1343) was the youngest son of Emperor Andronikos II and his second wife, Irene of Montferrat, and received the title of despot in 1306. In the civil war of 1321–1328 he backed his father against his nephew Andronikos III, governing Thessalonica in 1327–1328 before fleeing to Serbia.

Reconciled after the war, he was accused of conspiracy in 1336–1337, but Andronikos III dropped the charges. He was also a noted theologian and miniature painter.

en:
Didius Julianus (133–193) was a Roman senator from Mediolanum who governed Dalmatia and held the consulship in 175. After the Praetorian Guard murdered Pertinax in 193, Julianus bought the throne at their auction of the empire, a purchase that made him deeply unpopular in Rome; he also reduced the silver content of the denarius.

His reign, lasting barely nine weeks, was immediately challenged by Pescennius Niger, Clodius Albinus and Septimius Severus. Severus marched on Rome; abandoned by the guard and the Senate, Julianus was killed in the palace in 193.

狄狄乌斯·尤利安努斯（133—193）出身梅迪奥拉努姆的罗马元老家庭，曾治理达尔马提亚，175年就任执政官。193年禁卫军杀害佩蒂纳克斯后，尤利安努斯在禁卫军拍卖帝国的竞价中买下皇位。买官之举令他在罗马极不得人心，他还降低了第纳尔的含银量。

en:
Diocletian (242/245–311/312), born Diocles to a low-status Dalmatian family, was Roman emperor from 284 to 305 and ended the Crisis of the Third Century. After Numerian's death, the army hailed him emperor outside Nicomedia; he accused Prefect Aper of murder and killed him. In 285 he defeated Carinus.

He made Maximian Augustus in 286 and in 293 created the Tetrarchy with Galerius and Constantius as Caesars. He secured the frontiers and made peace with Persia in 299. He standardised taxation; his Edict on Maximum Prices of 301 was ignored, and his persecution of Christians from 303 failed.

He abdicated in 305, the first emperor to give up office voluntarily, retiring to his Dalmatian palace, later the core of Split. When begged to return in 308, he is said to have replied that they would not ask if they could see the cabbages he had planted himself.

戴克里先（242/245—311/312）出身达尔马提亚卑微家庭，本名戴克里，284年至305年为罗马皇帝，终结三世纪危机。努梅里安死后，他在尼科米底亚城外被军队拥立，杀死长官阿佩尔。285年他击败争位的卡里努斯。

他286年立马克西米安为奥古斯都，293年又以伽列里乌斯和君士坦提乌斯为凯撒，创立四帝共治制。他稳固边境，299年与波斯议和；他统一税制，301年的《最高价格敕令》无人理会，303年起的基督徒大迫害终告失败。

他于305年退位，是第一位主动让位的罗马皇帝，退居达尔马提亚海岸的宫殿，后为斯普利特的核心。308年有人恳求他复位，相传他答道，若见过他手种的卷心菜，就不会提此请求。

en:
Domitian (51–96), younger son of Vespasian, was the last Flavian emperor and ruled Rome from 81 to 96. In the civil war of 69 he escaped the Capitol, where his uncle Sabinus was executed, disguised as an Isis worshipper; under his father and brother Titus he held honours but no real power, and the Praetorian Guard proclaimed him on Titus’ death.

He revalued the coinage, strengthened frontiers and rebuilt Rome; Agricola pushed into Caledonia, but wars against Dacian king Decebalus brought no decisive victory. He ran government himself and quarrelled with the Senate, whose powers he cut.

On 18 September 96 officials killed him: Stephanus, hiding a dagger under a bandage for days, stabbed him as he read a document, while a servant lied that the midday he feared had passed. The Senate proclaimed Nerva and condemned his memory, though a 1992 study calls him a ruthless, efficient autocrat.

图密善（51—96）是韦斯巴芗的幼子，弗拉维王朝的末代皇帝，81年至96年统治罗马。69年内战中，他的叔父萨宾努斯被处决，他自己乔装成伊西斯崇拜者逃出卡庇托利欧山；父亲与兄长提图斯在位时，他有荣誉头衔却没有实权，提图斯去世后禁卫军拥立他为帝。

他重估币值、加固边防、重建罗马城；部将阿格里科拉深入喀里多尼亚，对达契亚国王德塞巴鲁斯的战争却没有决定性胜利。他亲自执掌政务，与权力被他削减的元老院交恶。

96年9月18日，宫廷官员杀死了他：斯特凡努斯连日把匕首藏在手臂的绷带里，趁他看文书时刺中他，同谋的仆人又骗他说，他一直害怕的正午已经过去。元老院当天宣布涅尔瓦为帝并抹除他的记忆，但1992年的一项研究称他是冷酷而高效的专制君主。

96年9月18日，宫廷官员杀死了他：斯特凡努斯连日把匕首藏在手臂的绷带里，趁他看文书时刺中他，同谋的仆人又骗他说，他一直害怕的正午已经过去。元老院当天宣布涅尔瓦为帝并抹除他的记忆，但1992年的一项研究称他是冷酷而高效的专制君主。

Irene Angelina was the eldest daughter of Emperor Alexios III Angelos and Euphrosyne Doukaina Kamatera. First married to the droungarios Andronikos Kontostephanos, who died around 1196, she wed Alexios Palaiologos in summer 1199; her sonless father made him despot and heir.

Crowned basilissa, she bore Alexios a daughter, Theodora Angelina Palaiologina, whose marriage to Andronikos Palaiologos in 1216 made her the mother of Michael VIII. Irene outlived her husband, who died in 1203, and died in exile.

Irene of Montferrat (c. 1274–1317), born Yolande at Casale, was the daughter of William VII, Marquess of Montferrat. In 1284 she married Emperor Andronikos II Palaiologos as his second wife and was renamed Eirene, bringing her family's claim to the Kingdom of Thessalonica.

When her brother John I died without male heirs in 1305, her son Theodore inherited the Margraviate of Montferrat. She left Constantinople in 1303, kept her own court in Thessalonica, and died of fever at Drama in 1317. Her daughter Simonis married King Stefan Milutin of Serbia.

蒙费拉托的伊琳娜（约1274—1317）原名约兰达，生于卡萨莱，是蒙费拉托侯爵古列尔莫七世之女。1284年，她作为续弦嫁给安德洛尼卡二世·巴列奥略皇帝并改名伊琳娜，同时带来家族对塞萨洛尼基王国的宣称权。

en:
Irene Doukaina (c. 1066–1138), empress of Alexios I Komnenos, was the daughter of Andronikos Doukas. She married Alexios in 1078, and her Doukas kin backed his 1081 seizure of the throne and secured her coronation. Long overshadowed by her mother-in-law Anna Dalassene, she accompanied him on campaign and acted as regent.

She pressed Alexios to set aside their son John in favour of Anna Komnene and Nikephoros Bryennios. After Alexios died in 1118 her plot against John II failed, and she ended her life in the nunnery she founded, dying in 1138.

伊琳娜·杜卡伊娜（约1066—1138）是阿历克塞一世·科穆宁的皇后，安德罗尼科斯·杜卡斯之女。她于1078年嫁给阿历克塞，杜卡斯家族支持他在1081年夺取皇位，并促成她加冕。她长期受婆婆安娜·达拉瑟内压制，曾随皇帝出征，并在君士坦丁堡摄政。

她一再劝说阿历克塞废黜亲子约翰，改立女儿安娜·科穆宁与女婿尼基弗鲁斯·布里尼奥斯。1118年阿历克塞死后，她反对约翰二世的密谋失败，最终在自己创立的凯卡瑞托梅内修女院度过余生，于1138年去世。

Irene Palaiologina (died after 1356) was the daughter of Despot Demetrios Palaiologos, a son of Emperor Andronikos II. In 1340 she married Matthew Kantakouzenos, eldest son of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos, and when Matthew was proclaimed co-emperor in April 1353 she became Byzantine empress.

In February 1356 she and Matthew were captured by Serbian raiders in Thrace; handed over to John V in December 1357, Matthew was forced to abdicate and Irene lost her title. She and Matthew had at least five children, including Demetrios Kantakouzenos, later briefly ruler of the Morea.

Eirene Komnene Kantakouzene Palaiologina Asanina, born Eirene Synadene, was a Byzantine aristocrat of the fourteenth century, the younger daughter of the megas konostaulos John Synadenos and Thomais Komnene Doukaina Laskarina. By about 1330 she had married Michael Komnenos Tornikes Asanes, a grandson of the Bulgarian tsar Ivan Asen III and later governor of Lesbos.

The couple appear together in a miniature in the typikon of the Bebaia Elpis convent, founded by Eirene's grandmother Theodora Synadene. Their children died young. After Michael's death, Eirene commissioned Nikephoros Gregoras to compose an epitaph in his memory.

en:
Doménikos Theotokópoulos, known as El Greco, 'the Greek' (1541–1614), was a Cretan-born painter and one of the most individual artists of the Spanish Renaissance. A Cretan School icon painter, around 1567 he moved to Venice and in 1570 to Rome, where offering to paint over Michelangelo's Last Judgment made him enemies.

In 1577 he settled in Toledo seeking Philip II's favour. Toledo made his name, but after the king disliked his Martyrdom of St Maurice he received no more royal work and stayed for life. In 1586 he took the commission for The Burial of the Count of Orgaz, his best-known work.

Short of money after disputes, he fell ill on a hospital commission and died 7 April 1614; buried in Santo Domingo el Antiguo, he left a 130-volume library. Only later was he hailed as a precursor of Expressionism and Cubism, influencing artists such as Goya and Picasso.

多米尼克·塞奥托科普洛斯，通称埃尔·格列柯，意为“希腊人”（1541—1614），是生于克里特岛的画家，也是西班牙文艺复兴时期最具个性的艺术家之一。他早年在克里特画派学习圣像画，约1567年前往威尼斯，又于1570年到罗马；在罗马他提出要把米开朗基罗的《最后的审判》整幅涂掉重画，由此树敌。

1577年他定居托莱多，寻求腓力二世的赏识。托莱多的委托使他成名，但国王不喜欢他的《圣莫里斯的殉教》，他再没得到王室委托，于是终生留在托莱多。1586年他接下《奥尔加斯伯爵的葬礼》的委托，这幅画如今是他最著名的作品。

长期的酬金纠纷使他晚年拮据。1614年4月7日，他在承接一项医院委托期间病倒后去世，葬在古圣多明各教堂，留下130卷藏书。很久以后他才被视为表现主义与立体主义的先驱，影响了戈雅、毕加索等艺术家。

en:
Elagabalus (c. 204–222), born Varius Avitus Bassianus, was Roman emperor from 218 to 222, a Syrian teenager from Emesa who served as hereditary high priest of the sun god Elagabal. A rumour backed by his mother claimed he was Caracalla’s son; when Macrinus exiled them, his grandmother Julia Maesa plotted a revolt and the legions defeated Macrinus at Antioch in 218.

In Rome from 219, he made Elagabal chief god in 220, housing the god’s black stone in a new Palatine temple, and shocked the city by marrying Vestal Virgin Aquilia Severa. Hostile writers add tales of debauchery modern scholars treat with caution.

As support faded, Maesa had him adopt Severus Alexander as Caesar in 221. When he tried to remove the boy, the Praetorian Guard killed him and his mother in 222; the eighteen-year-old was thrown into the Tiber, his memory condemned, and Severus Alexander took the throne.

A rumour backed by his mother claimed he was #TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,[GetCharacter('byz_caracalla').GetID],X #L Caracalla#!#!’s son; when #TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,[GetCharacter('byz_macrinus').GetID],X #L Macrinus#!#! exiled them, his grandmother Julia Maesa plotted a revolt and the legions defeated Macrinus at Antioch in 218.

In Rome from 219, he made Elagabal chief god in 220, housing the god’s black stone in a new Palatine temple, and shocked the city by marrying Vestal Virgin Aquilia Severa. Hostile writers add tales of debauchery modern scholars treat with caution.

As support faded, Maesa had him adopt #TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,[GetCharacter('byz_alexander_severus').GetID],X #L Severus Alexander#!#! as Caesar in 221. When he tried to remove the boy, the Praetorian Guard killed him and his mother in 222; the eighteen-year-old was thrown into the Tiber, his memory condemned, and Severus Alexander took the throne.
zh:
埃拉伽巴路斯（约204—222）本名瓦瑞乌斯·阿维图斯·巴西安努斯，218—222年为罗马皇帝，出身叙利亚的埃梅萨家族，在当地世袭担任太阳神埃拉伽巴路斯的大祭司。他的母亲支持他是皇帝卡拉卡拉之子的传言；马克里努斯把这一家人流放后，祖母尤利亚·玛伊莎密谋起事，军团于218年在安条克击败马克里努斯。

219年他抵达罗马，220年把埃拉伽巴路斯奉为罗马众神之首，在帕拉蒂尼山的新神庙中供奉黑色圣石，又娶维斯塔贞女阿奎利娅·塞维拉为妻，震惊罗马。敌视他的古代作家记下许多荒淫传闻，今天的学者对此持谨慎态度。

玛伊莎眼见他失去支持，221年让他收亚历山大·塞维鲁为恺撒。他试图除掉这个少年，222年禁卫军便杀死了他和他的母亲，十八岁的他被抛入台伯河，名字遭到抹除，亚历山大·塞维鲁继位。

en: Syrgiannes was a Cuman leader, originally named Sytzigan, who was baptized and took the Hellenized name Syrgiannes. Under Emperor Andronikos II he rose to become megas domestikos, the Byzantine army's commander-in-chief. He was the father or possibly grandfather of the general Syrgiannes Palaiologos.

en:
Eudokia Angelina (c. 1173–c. 1211) was a daughter of Emperor Alexios III Angelos. Around 1190 she married Stefan, son of the grand župan and ruler of Serbia from 1196, bearing him two kings; her uncle Isaac II arranged it while her father was exiled.

Banished c. 1200 over mutual adultery accusations, she sheltered with Stefan’s brother in Zeta and fled via Dyrrachium to Constantinople. She took Alexios V Doukas as a lover and married him in 1204, only for her father to blind him. She then married Leo Sgouros, lord of Corinth, who killed himself under siege in 1207 or 1208.

欧多基娅·安格利娜（约1173—约1211年）是皇帝阿历克塞三世·安格洛斯之女。约1190年，她嫁给大茹潘之子斯特凡，后者1196年成为塞尔维亚统治者，她为他生下两位后来的国王。这桩婚事由她的叔父伊萨克二世安排，当时她的父亲正在流亡。

约1200年，夫妻互相指控通奸，她被逐出塞尔维亚，在泽塔得到斯特凡的兄弟庇护，随后经都拉斯回到君士坦丁堡。她与阿历克塞五世·杜卡斯相好，1204年与他成婚，她的父亲不久便将他刺瞎。她随后改嫁科林斯领主利奥·斯古罗斯，后者遭围困时于1207或1208年自杀。

en:
Eudokia Makrembolitissa (born c. 1030), niece of Patriarch Michael I Cerularius, married the future emperor Constantine X Doukas. When he died in 1067 she took supreme power, appearing with her sons Michael VII and Konstantios on the coinage.

Though she had sworn at Constantine's deathbed not to remarry, she chose the general Romanos IV Diogenes and made him emperor. After Manzikert in 1071 she briefly resumed power before being forced aside by Michael VII, then retired from court and died sometime after 1081.

欧多西亚·玛克勒姆玻利提萨（约1030年生）是牧首米哈伊尔一世·凯鲁拉里奥斯的外甥女，嫁给后来成为皇帝的君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯。1067年君士坦丁十世死后，她总揽大权，钱币上铸有她与儿子米哈伊尔七世、孔斯坦提奥斯的形象。

她虽曾在君士坦丁临终时发誓不再改嫁，仍选择将领罗曼努斯四世·第欧根尼并立他为帝。1071年曼齐刻尔特战役后，她短暂重掌政权，旋即被米哈伊尔七世逼迫退位，晚年退出宫廷，1081年后去世。

en:
Eudokia Palaiologina Tzamplakonissa was a fourteenth-century Byzantine noblewoman, the daughter of Constantine Palaiologos. She married Demetrios Tzamplakon, megas stratopedarches; the Tzamplakons were landowners around Serres, where Eudokia probably first lived.

In 1345 she was with her husband at Serres, and after the city fell to the Serbs she followed him to Chrysoupolis, where Demetrios remained until 1360. In 1362 the couple donated part of an estate near the Gallikos river to Vatopedi monastery; the surviving charter carries her signature.

欧多基娅·巴列奥略娜·察穆普拉科尼萨是14世纪拜占庭贵妇，君士坦丁·巴列奥略之女。她嫁给大军营长官季米特里奥斯·察穆普拉孔；察穆普拉孔家族是塞雷一带的地主，欧多基娅早年可能住在塞雷。

1345年她随丈夫驻留塞雷，城陷于塞尔维亚人后又随他迁往赫里苏波利斯，季米特里奥斯在那里一直住到1360年。1362年，夫妇二人把加利科斯河附近一处庄园的份额捐给瓦托佩迪修道院，保存至今的特许状上留有她的签名。

en:
Eugenia Palaiologina Kantakouzene (1255–1329) was a Byzantine noblewoman of the Palaiologos and Kantakouzenos houses. Her mother Irene Palaiologina was a sister of Emperor Michael VIII, making Eugenia the emperor's niece. She married Syrgiannes, a Cuman chieftain baptized at court who rose to megas domestikos under Andronikos II.

Their son Syrgiannes Palaiologos became the turncoat general of the Byzantine civil wars of the 1320s and 1330s, while their daughter Theodora married Guy de Lusignan and became queen of Armenian Cilicia. Eugenia ended her life as a nun.

尤金尼娅·巴列奥略吉娜·坎塔库泽尼（1255—1329）是出身巴列奥略与坎塔库泽努斯两大家族的拜占庭贵族女子。她的母亲伊琳娜·巴列奥略吉娜是皇帝米海尔八世的姐妹，因此尤金尼娅是皇帝的外甥女。她嫁给库曼人首领西尔吉安：此人在宫廷受洗，在安德洛尼卡二世麾下升任大统帅。

其子西尔吉安·巴列奥略是1320至1330年代拜占庭内战中反复倒戈的将领，女儿狄奥多拉嫁给吕西尼昂的居伊，成为奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王后。尤金尼娅晚年出家为修女。

en:
Euphrosyne Synadene was a fourteenth-century Byzantine noblewoman, daughter of the megas stratopedarches John Synadenos and Theodora Palaiologina, herself a niece of Michael VIII. She was pledged to the church from infancy.

After her father's death, her mother became a nun under the name Theodoule and founded in Constantinople the Convent of the Theotokos Bebaia Elpis, ‘Certain Hope’; Euphrosyne took vows with her and became its co-founder. Theodora drew up the convent's first typikon, or rule, between 1327 and 1347. After her mother's death, Euphrosyne wrote a second rule and appended it to the first, largely revising what Theodora had set down.

尤芙洛西妮·西纳德妮是14世纪拜占庭贵族女子，大都官约翰·西纳德诺斯与狄奥多拉·巴列奥略吉娜之女，母亲是米海尔八世的侄女。她从襁褓时起就被许给教会。

父亲去世后，母亲以狄奥杜蕾之名成为修女，在君士坦丁堡创立天主之母贝瓦亚·埃尔皮斯修道院（意为“可靠的希望”）；尤芙洛西妮随母出家，成为修道院的共同创立者。狄奥多拉于1327至1347年间编写了修道院的第一部典章。母亲去世后，尤芙洛西妮撰写第二部典章，附在第一部之后，内容主要是对母亲所定规章的修订。

en:
Galerius (c. 258–311), born near Serdica and nicknamed Armentarius, the herdsman, rose through the army and married Diocletian's daughter Valeria. When the Tetrarchy was created in 293 he became Caesar, and defeated the Persian king Narseh at Satala in 298. He also crossed the Danube to defeat the Carpi.

After Diocletian's abdication in 305 he ruled as senior Augustus, contending with Constantine and Maxentius. A fierce persecutor of Christians, he nonetheless issued the Edict of Serdica in 311 ending the persecution, and died that May at his palace of Felix Romuliana.

伽列里乌斯（约258—311）出生于塞尔迪卡一带，绰号“牧人”阿门塔里乌斯，行伍出身，娶戴克里先之女瓦莱里娅为妻。293年四帝共治制建立时，他被任命为凯撒，298年在萨塔拉击败波斯国王纳塞赫，还渡过多瑙河击败卡尔皮人。

305年戴克里先退位后，他以资深奥古斯都执政，与君士坦丁、马克森提乌斯周旋。他虽残酷迫害基督徒，却于311年颁布《塞尔迪卡敕令》终止迫害，同年5月在菲利克斯·罗慕里亚纳宫去世。

en:
Gallienus (c. 218–268), son of Valerian, ruled the West as Augustus from 253 while his father held the East, and routed the Alemanni near Mediolanum in 259.

Valerian's capture at Edessa in 260 made him sole emperor and plunged the empire into civil war. He overthrew the eastern usurpers but could not stop Postumus founding the Gallic Empire, and his son Saloninus was killed by Postumus' army.

His 260 edict granted Christians their first imperial toleration, and he built a cavalry field army. In 268 he was killed in an officers' plot while besieging a rebel at Mediolanum.

加里恩努斯（约218—268）是瓦勒良之子，253年升为奥古斯都，与父亲分治帝国，负责西方，259年在梅蒂奥拉努附近击溃阿勒曼尼人。

260年瓦勒良在埃德萨被俘后，他成为唯一的皇帝，帝国陷入内战。他消灭东方的僭帝，却未能阻止波斯图穆斯建立高卢帝国，儿子萨洛尼努斯也被波斯图穆斯的军队杀害。

他260年颁布敕令，首次在帝国境内宽容基督教，又建立以骑兵为核心的机动野战军。268年，他在梅蒂奥拉努围攻叛将时死于一场军官策划的阴谋。

en:
Georgios Gemistos Plethon (c. 1355–1454) was among the last great philosophers of Byzantium. Born in Constantinople, he studied there and in Adrianople, and before 1410 Emperor Manuel II sent him to Mystra in the Morea, where he taught philosophy and advised the despot Theodore II.

At the Council of Florence in 1438–1439, convened to reconcile the Eastern and Western churches, he lectured on Plato, reintroduced Platonic thought to Western Europe and inspired Cosimo de' Medici's Platonic Academy. In his Book of Laws, circulated only among friends, he rejected Christianity for the worship of the classical Hellenic gods; he was later called the last Hellene.

格弥斯托士·卜列东（约1355—1454）是拜占庭最后几位大哲学家之一。他生于君士坦丁堡，曾在当地和阿德里安堡求学。1410年前，曼努埃尔二世皇帝派他前往摩里亚的米斯特拉，在当地讲授哲学，并为专制君主狄奥多尔二世出谋划策。

1438—1439年，在旨在调和东西教会的佛罗伦萨公会议上，他讲授柏拉图，把柏拉图哲学重新引入西欧，启发科西莫·德·美第奇创办了柏拉图学院。在只向友人传阅的《法律篇》中，他摒弃基督教，主张回归对古希腊众神的崇拜；他后来被称为“最后的希腊人”。

en:
George Palaiologos (fl. 1078–1110) was a Byzantine general and one of the earliest known members of the Palaiologos family. He married Anna Doukaina, the empress Irene's sister. In 1080 he took command of an army in Asia Minor and brought it back in good order after attacks by the Turks.

He joined the Komnenian coup only at the last moment: his negotiation of the garrison's defection let Alexios enter Constantinople unopposed on 1 April 1081. He then secured the fleet's allegiance and fought at Dyrrhachium against the Normans and at Levounion against the Pechenegs. Anna Komnene's Alexiad records him as a trusted commander.

乔治·巴列奥略（活跃于1078—1110年）是拜占庭将领，也是巴列奥略家族最早见诸记载的成员之一。他娶皇后伊琳娜的妹妹安娜·杜卡伊娜为妻。1080年，他在小亚细亚接管一支军队，遭突厥人袭击后率军有序撤退。

他在最后一刻才加入科穆宁政变：经他策反城门守军，阿历克塞于1081年4月1日兵不血刃进入君士坦丁堡。此后他争取舰队效忠，又先后在都拉基乌姆迎战诺曼人、在莱沃尼翁迎战佩切涅格人。安娜·科穆宁的《阿历克塞传》将他记为深受倚重的将领。

George Palaiologos (c. 1125–1167/68), sebastos and megas hetaireiarches under Manuel I Komnenos, was a diplomat rather than a soldier. Related to the imperial Komnenos family through both parents.

In 1162 he went to Hungary to arrange the marriage of Manuel's daughter Maria to Prince Béla, and in 1167 he escorted Manuel's niece Maria Komnene to Jerusalem to marry King Amalric.

He founded a lavishly decorated monastery adorned with portraits of his imperial kin. Taken ill at Adrianople, he died in 1167 or 1168; his great-grandson Michael VIII founded the Palaiologan dynasty.

他修建了一座装饰华美的修道院，院中有皇室亲族的肖像。他在阿德里安堡病倒，于1167或1168年去世；其曾孙米海尔八世后来开创了巴列奥略王朝。

en:
Publius Septimius Geta (189–211) was the younger son of Septimius Severus and Julia Domna, born at Rome or Mediolanum. Raised to Caesar in 198, he was made Augustus in late 209 and ruled jointly with his father and elder brother Caracalla.

When Severus died at Eboracum in February 211, the two brothers inherited the empire together, but their long rivalry made joint rule unworkable. In December 211 Caracalla had Geta cut down by centurions in their mother's apartments at a staged reconciliation, then imposed damnatio memoriae and purged some twenty thousand of his followers.

普布利乌斯·塞普提米乌斯·盖塔（189—211）是塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁与尤利亚·多姆娜的幼子，生于罗马或梅蒂奥拉努。他于198年受封凯撒，209年年末成为奥古斯都，与父亲和兄长卡拉卡拉共治。

en:
Gordian I (c. 158–238) was a Roman senator who governed Roman Britain in 216 and later became consul under Elagabalus, popular for the lavish games he held as aedile.

He was serving as proconsul of Africa when a revolt against Maximinus Thrax broke out early in 238. Proclaimed emperor at about eighty, he ruled jointly with his son Gordian II. Within weeks Capellianus of Numidia marched on Carthage and killed Gordian II in battle, and Gordian I took his own life after a reign of just twenty-two days.

en:
Gordian II (c. 192–238), the only known son of Gordian I, briefly ruled with his father during the Year of the Six Emperors. He accompanied his father, proconsular governor of Africa, as his legate.

In March 238 a provincial revolt against the exactions of Maximinus Thrax brought father and son to the throne, and the Senate recognized them. Gordian II led untrained militia against Capelianus, governor of neighboring Numidia, and was defeated and killed outside Carthage. His reign of about twenty-two days was the shortest recorded of any Roman emperor; his father committed suicide shortly after.

en:
Gordian III (225–244) was the grandson of Gordian I and nephew of Gordian II. In 238, after the violent deaths of the two Gordians and the senatorial emperors who followed them, the praetorians acclaimed the thirteen-year-old emperor.

From 241 his praetorian prefect and father-in-law Timesitheus held power. After Shapur I invaded Mesopotamia, Gordian joined the eastern campaign, which defeated the Persians at Resaena in 243. After Timesitheus' death Philip the Arab became prefect, and Gordian died during the campaign around February 244 in disputed circumstances; Philip succeeded him.

zh:
戈尔迪安三世（225—244）是戈尔迪安一世的外孙、戈尔迪安二世的外甥。238年，戈尔迪安父子及随后元老院拥立的皇帝们先后死于非命，近卫军拥立年仅十三岁的他为帝。

241年起，他的岳父、近卫军长官提梅西图斯掌握实权。沙普尔一世入侵美索不达米亚后，戈尔迪安随军东征，于243年在雷塞纳击败波斯军。提梅西图斯死后，阿拉伯人菲利普出任近卫军长官；约244年2月，戈尔迪安在对波斯的战事中身亡，具体经过仍有争议，菲利普继位。

en:
Gregory Palamas (c. 1296–1359) was a Byzantine monk and theologian. Emperor Andronikos II helped raise him in Constantinople; he rejected government service and in 1316, barely twenty-one, withdrew to Mount Athos. Turkish raids drove him to Thessalonica in 1326, where he was ordained priest.

From 1336 he defended Hesychast teaching on the uncreated light and the distinction between God's essence and energies against Barlaam of Calabria and others. Patriarch John XIV imprisoned him in 1344. Released in 1347 and made archbishop of Thessalonica, he could take his see only in 1350.

In 1354 Turkish pirates captured his ship, and he spent a year at the Ottoman court before being ransomed. His last words are recorded as “To the heights!”. He died in 1359 and was canonized in 1368.

格列高利·帕拉马斯（约1296—1359）是拜占庭修士、神学家。他在君士坦丁堡由安德洛尼卡二世抚养长大，却放弃从政，1316年年仅21岁时退隐阿索斯山。1326年因土耳其人袭扰，他转往塞萨洛尼基，并在那里受任神父。

1336年起，他为静修派关于“非受造之光”以及上帝本质与能量之别的教义辩护，与卡拉布里亚人巴拉姆等人论战。牧首约翰十四世于1344年将他下狱。1347年他获释并出任塞萨洛尼基大主教，直到1350年才得以就任。

1354年土耳其海盗俘获了他乘坐的船，他在奥斯曼宫廷羁留一年后获赎。史载他的临终之言是“向着高处！”。他于1359年去世，1368年被尊为圣徒。

en:
Hadrian (76–138) was Roman emperor from 117 to 138, the third of the Five Good Emperors, who chose to hold the empire's frontiers rather than extend them. Born at Italica, he became a ward of his kinsman Trajan; his love of Greek literature earned him the nickname Graeculus, the Greekling. He succeeded Trajan in 117.

He gave up Trajan's eastern conquests and spent years touring the provinces. In Britain he built Hadrian's Wall, and in Rome he rebuilt the Pantheon. In 130 his young companion Antinous drowned on the Nile; Hadrian founded Antinoöpolis in his name.

The Bar Kokhba Revolt of 132–135 took twelve legions to crush, and he renamed Jerusalem Aelia Capitolina. In 138 he adopted Antoninus Pius on condition that he adopt Marcus Aurelius, then died at Baiae in July. The Senate deified him only after Antoninus threatened to refuse the throne, earning the name Pius.

哈德良（76—138）117—138年任罗马皇帝，是五贤帝中的第三位，选择守住帝国边界而不再扩张。他生于意大利迦，由族亲图拉真监护，因热爱希腊文学得了“小希腊人”的绰号。117年他继承图拉真的帝位。

他放弃图拉真在东方的征服所得，多年巡行各行省，在不列颠修建哈德良长城，在罗马重建万神殿。130年，他的年轻伴侣安提诺乌斯在尼罗河上溺水而死，哈德良以他的名字建起安提诺波利斯城。

132—135年的巴尔·科赫巴起义动用十二个军团才平定，他把耶路撒冷改名埃利亚·卡皮托利纳。138年，他收安敦宁·毕尤为养子，条件是安敦宁再收养马可·奥勒留，随后于7月在巴亚去世。元老院在安敦宁以拒绝登基相威胁后才将他封神，安敦宁也因此得名“毕尤”。

en:
Helena Kantakouzene (1333–1396), a daughter of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos, was the empress of John V Palaiologos. Her marriage in May 1347, when she was about thirteen, sealed the settlement ending the civil war of 1341–1347 and made her father senior co-emperor over her husband.

The peace held until 1352, when war with her father resumed. When her son Andronikos IV deposed John V in 1376, she failed to reconcile them, and after John V escaped prison in 1379 she was suspected: Andronikos held her, her aged father and her sisters hostage at Galata until the treaty of May 1381.

After John V died in 1391 she became the nun Hypomone, and in 1393 she was regent for Manuel II. She died in 1396.

海伦娜·坎塔库泽努斯（1333—1396）是皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯之女、约翰五世·巴列奥略的皇后。1347年5月，年约13岁的她嫁给约翰五世，为1341至1347年的内战画上句号，其父得以资深共治皇帝的身份压过她的丈夫。

和平维持到1352年，对她父亲的战事重启。1376年儿子安德洛尼卡四世推翻约翰五世，她调解无果；1379年约翰五世越狱后她受到怀疑，安德洛尼卡把她、年迈的父亲和姐妹扣在加拉塔为质，直到1381年5月订约。

1391年约翰五世去世后，她出家为尼，改名希波莫尼，1393年曾为曼努埃尔二世摄政，1396年去世。

en:
Heraclius (c. 575–641) was Byzantine emperor from 610 to 641, the ruler who broke Sasanian Persia and then lost the East to the Arabs. In 608 he and his father rose against the emperor Phocas; Heraclius seized Constantinople and was crowned in 610. The war went badly: after his defeat at Antioch in 613 the Persians took Syria, Palestine and Egypt and reached Chalcedon.

He rebuilt the army and from 622 counterattacked into Persia, winning at Nineveh in 627. Khosrow II was overthrown and Persia sued for peace, abandoning its conquests, and Heraclius returned the True Cross to Jerusalem around 630. From 629 he styled himself basileus, and made Greek the state language.

In 636 Arab armies defeated his forces, and Mesopotamia, Armenia and Egypt fell. He died in February 641, leaving the throne to his sons Constantine and Heraclonas; by year's end Constantine's son Constans II was emperor.

希拉克略（约575—641）是610至641年在位的拜占庭皇帝，他击垮了萨珊波斯，却在此后把东方行省丢给了阿拉伯人。608年他与父亲起兵反对皇帝福卡斯，夺取君士坦丁堡，于610年加冕。对波斯的战事节节失利：613年他在安条克战败，波斯人夺取叙利亚、巴勒斯坦与埃及，兵锋直抵迦克墩。

他重建军队，自622年起反攻深入波斯，于627年在尼尼微获胜。霍斯劳二世被推翻，波斯求和并放弃全部占领的土地，约630年希拉克略把真十字架送回耶路撒冷。629年起他自称“巴西琉斯”，希腊语也取代拉丁语成为官方语言。

636年阿拉伯军队击败他的军队，美索不达米亚、亚美尼亚与埃及随后相继陷落。641年2月他去世，帝位留给儿子君士坦丁和赫拉克洛纳斯；当年年底，君士坦丁之子君士坦斯二世即位。

en:
Heraklonas (626–642), son of Heraclius and the empress Martina, was briefly Byzantine emperor in 641. Crowned co-emperor in 638, he succeeded jointly with his half-brother Constantine III when Heraclius died in February 641.

When Constantine died in May, Heraklonas became sole ruler under Martina's regency. The Arab conquest of Egypt, Martina's monothelite policy and rumours that Constantine had been poisoned turned Constantinople against them.

In autumn 641 the general Valentinus deposed Heraklonas, had his nose cut off and exiled him to Rhodes, placing Constans II on the throne. Heraklonas died there in 642.

赫拉克洛纳斯（626—642）是希拉克略与皇后玛蒂娜之子，641年短暂在位的拜占庭皇帝。他638年加冕为共治皇帝，641年2月希拉克略去世后与异母兄君士坦丁三世共同继位。

5月君士坦丁三世去世，赫拉克洛纳斯成为唯一皇帝，由玛蒂娜摄政。阿拉伯人进攻埃及、玛蒂娜推行基督一志论，加上毒杀君士坦丁三世的传言，使君士坦丁堡朝野群起反对。

641年秋，将领瓦伦丁努斯废黜赫拉克洛纳斯，割去他的鼻子，将他流放罗得岛，另立君士坦斯二世。赫拉克洛纳斯于642年死于流放地。

en:
John Apokaukos (died 1345) was the eldest son of the Byzantine megas doux Alexios Apokaukos, a chief instigator of the civil war of 1341–1347. In 1343 he was named megas primikerios and governor of Thessalonica, although real power in the city rested with the anti-Kantakouzenist Zealot faction.

After his father was lynched by political prisoners in June 1345, John switched sides and declared for John VI Kantakouzenos, attempting to seize Thessalonica. The Zealots crushed his coup, and he was captured and executed later that year.

约翰·阿波考寇斯（?—1345）是拜占庭海军大统帅阿历克塞·阿波考寇斯的长子，其父是1341至1347年内战的主要挑起者之一。1343年，他被授予大首席官头衔，出任塞萨洛尼基总督，但城中实权掌握在反对坎塔库泽努斯的狂热派手中。

1345年6月父亲被政治犯私刑处死后，约翰倒向约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯，试图夺取塞萨洛尼基；狂热派平息了他的政变，他被俘并于同年被处决。

en:
John Asanes, elder son of Andronikos Asen and grandson of Tsar Ivan Asen III of Bulgaria, was a Byzantine commander; his grandfather had fled Bulgaria for the empire in 1280. His father governed the Morea and won towns from the Franks of Achaea.

In 1335 John and his brother Manuel were imprisoned on a charge of conspiring against Andronikos III, and released in 1341. Joining their brother-in-law John VI Kantakouzenos in the civil war, he campaigned in the west and became governor of Melenikon, then sebastokrator in 1347 and despot at Peritheorion in 1355.

He married a daughter of Alexios Apokaukos, Kantakouzenos's great rival in the civil war. His niece Helena later married John V, and her descendants wore the imperial crown.

约翰·阿萨尼斯是拜占庭军事将领，安德洛尼卡·阿森的长子、保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森三世之孙，其祖父于1280年自保加利亚逃入帝国。他的父亲曾治理摩里亚，从亚该亚的法兰克人手中夺得城镇。

1335年，约翰与弟弟曼努埃尔被控阴谋反对安德洛尼卡三世而下狱，1341年获释。内战中他投身妹夫约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯一方，随军西征，出任梅尔尼克长官，1347年获授至尊者头衔，1355年在佩里塞奥里昂受封专制公。

他娶了坎塔库泽努斯在内战中的大对头阿历克塞·阿波考寇斯之女为妻。他的外甥女海伦娜后来嫁给约翰五世，她的后裔日后成为拜占庭皇帝。

en:
John Doukas (c. 1126–c. 1200), eldest son of Constantine Angelos and Alexios I's daughter Theodora Komnene, took his grandmother's surname Doukas. He fought at Myriokephalon in 1176 under Manuel I.

In 1185 he backed his nephew Isaac Angelos' revolt against Andronikos I; when Isaac hesitated to take the crown, the elderly John offered his bald head, but the crowd rejected him, and Isaac II made him sebastokrator. He led troops against the Vlach-Bulgarian revolt in 1186, but Isaac suspected him of seeking the throne and removed him from command. His sons by Zoe Doukaina founded the Despotate of Epirus.

约翰·杜卡斯（约1126—约1200）是君士坦丁·安格洛斯与阿莱克修斯一世之女狄奥多拉·科穆宁娜的长子，随祖母姓杜卡斯。他在曼努埃尔一世麾下参加1176年的密列奥塞法隆战役。

en:
John Doukas Angelos Palaiologos Raoul Laskaris Tornikes Philanthropenos Asanes was a Byzantine noble child of the fourteenth or fifteenth century who died young. He is known only from his funerary portrait icon, preserved in a monastery in the Peloponnese.

His extraordinary string of family names proclaims direct descent from eight of the greatest Byzantine aristocratic houses: the Doukas, Angelos, Palaiologos, Raoul, Laskaris, Tornikes, Philanthropenos and Asen families. The portrait marks him as a kinsman of a Byzantine empress.

en:
John Doukas (died c. 1088), son of Andronikos Doukas and elder brother of Constantine X, was a general made caesar by his brother. After Constantine's death in 1067 he championed his nephew Michael VII and opposed Romanos IV Diogenes, and was forced to retire to Bithynia for much of Romanos's reign.

Following Manzikert in 1071 he returned to court and forced the empress Eudokia into a nunnery. He sent his sons to capture Romanos and ordered him blinded, securing Michael's sole rule. Ousted by the eunuch Nikephoritzes around 1073, he helped his grandson-in-law Alexios I Komnenos seize the throne in 1081.

en:
John II Komnenos (1087–1143), the Good (Kaloïōannēs), was Byzantine emperor from 1118 to 1143 and the eldest son of Alexios I. Crowned co-emperor in 1092, he married the Hungarian princess Piroska, renamed Irene, in 1104, sealing an alliance that strengthened Byzantium in the Balkans.

In a quarter-century of campaigns he defeated the Pechenegs, Hungarians and Serbs in the Balkans, allied with the Holy Roman Empire, drove the Turks back across Anatolia and campaigned in Syria beside unreliable Crusader allies. Preparing another move on Antioch, he died of a hunting wound in Cilicia in 1143, leaving the throne to his younger son Manuel.

en:
John III Doukas Vatatzes (c. 1192–1254) was probably the son of the general Basil Vatatzes. Theodore I Laskaris married him to his daughter Irene, and he took the Nicaean throne in 1221.

He defeated rival claimants at Poimanenon in 1224, seizing Adrianople, but lost it in 1227. He besieged Latin Constantinople in 1235–1236, imposed his suzerainty on Thessalonica in 1242, and annexed it and much of Thrace in 1246.

A collector of manuscripts, he died at Nymphaion in 1254 and was later venerated as Saint John the Merciful. His son Theodore II succeeded him.

约翰三世·杜卡斯·瓦塔泽斯（约1192—1254）可能是将领瓦西里·瓦塔泽斯之子。狄奥多尔一世·拉斯卡里斯把女儿伊琳娜嫁给他，1221年他登上尼西亚皇位。

1224年他在波伊马农击败争位者，夺取阿德里安堡，1227年又将其丢失。1235—1236年他围攻拉丁人占据的君士坦丁堡，1242年迫使塞萨洛尼基承认其宗主权，1246年兼并该城和色雷斯大片土地。

en:
John IV Laskaris (1250–c. 1305) became emperor of Nicaea in 1258, aged seven, on the death of his father Theodore II. The regent George Mouzalon was murdered by the nobility, and Michael Palaiologos seized the regency, crowning himself co-emperor as Michael VIII in 1259.

After recovering Constantinople in 1261, Michael left John at Nicaea and on 25 December 1261, the boy's eleventh birthday, had him blinded and imprisoned in Bithynia, where he lived as a monk. In 1290 Andronikos II visited him to seek forgiveness. He died around 1305 and was venerated as a saint.

约翰四世·拉斯卡里斯（1250—约1305）于1258年父亲狄奥多尔二世去世后即位，年仅7岁。摄政乔治·穆扎隆被贵族杀害，米海尔·巴列奥略攫取摄政之位，1259年加冕为共治皇帝，即米海尔八世。

John Komnenos (c. 1015–1067) was a Byzantine general and the younger brother of Emperor Isaac I Komnenos. A doux during Isaac's 1057 revolt, he was rewarded with the post of Domestic of the Schools.

A chronicler wrote that John refused the crown when Isaac abdicated in 1059, though the account has been questioned. He withdrew from public life under Constantine X Doukas and died as a monk in 1067. By his wife Anna Dalassene he was the father of Emperor Alexios I.

John Komnenos Doukas Palaiologos Synadenos was a Byzantine nobleman of the early fourteenth century who held the court rank of megas konostaulos. A son of the megas stratopedarches John Synadenos and Theodora Palaiologina, he commonly used the surname Palaiologos inherited from his mother.

He married Thomais Komnene Doukaina Laskarina Kantakouzene and had two daughters, Anna and Eirene. During the closing stage of the civil war of 1321–1328, he served as an envoy of Andronikos III to the aged Andronikos II.

en:
Irene of Athens (c. 752–803) married Leo IV in 769 and became empress in 775. Though her husband opposed icons, Irene favored their veneration. From 780 she was regent for her son Constantine VI, and in 787 convened the Second Council of Nicaea, restoring icon veneration.

In 790 a military revolt restored Constantine; Irene returned as co-ruler in 792 and in 797 had him blinded, ruling alone until 802, when Nikephoros I overthrew her and exiled her to Lesbos, where she died in 803. Her usurpation helped prompt Charlemagne's imperial coronation in Rome in 800.

en:
Irene Asanina (died after 1354), daughter of Andronikos Asen and empress of John VI Kantakouzenos, took part in war and diplomacy to a degree uncommon for a Byzantine empress.

In the civil war of 1341–1347 she held Didymoteicho while her husband was driven into Serbia. When the Bulgarians she had appealed to tried to take the city, she wrote to Umur of Smyrna, whose landing on the Maritsa sent them away. She helped win the Serbs and Turkish beyliks for her husband and helped secure the peace that married her daughter Helena to John V.

As empress she organised Constantinople's defence against the Genoese in 1348 and John V's forces in 1353. When Kantakouzenos abdicated in 1354 she retired to Hagia Martha convent as the nun Eugenia, and in 1356 rejected an offer to restore her imprisoned son Matthew.

伊琳娜·阿森尼娜（1354年后卒）是安德洛尼卡·阿森之女、约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯的皇后，参与战事与外交的程度在拜占庭皇后中罕见。

1341—1347年内战中，丈夫败退塞尔维亚，她坚守季季莫蒂霍。她求援的保加利亚人转而想占领该城，她便写信给士麦那的乌穆尔；乌穆尔的军队在马里查河登陆，保加利亚人随之退去。她还协助争取塞尔维亚人与土耳其诸贝伊国支持丈夫，并促成女儿海伦娜嫁给约翰五世的和议。

成为皇后后，她于1348年组织君士坦丁堡防务抵御热那亚人，1353年又抵御约翰五世的军队。1354年坎塔库泽努斯退位后，她进入圣玛尔塔修道院出家，法名尤金尼娅；1356年她拒绝了释放被囚的儿子马修并助其复位的提议。

en:
Irene Angelina was the eldest daughter of Emperor Alexios III Angelos and Euphrosyne Doukaina Kamatera. She was already married to Andronikos Kontostephanos when her father seized the throne in 1195. Andronikos retired to a monastery shortly before his death around 1196.

In summer 1199 Irene married Alexios Palaiologos; her father, who had no sons, raised him to despot and heir and crowned Irene basilissa. Her only daughter, Theodora Angelina Palaiologina, married Andronikos Palaiologos in 1216 and became the mother of Emperor Michael VIII. Irene died in exile after 1203.

伊琳娜·安杰丽娜是皇帝阿历克塞三世·安杰洛斯与欧芙洛绪涅·杜卡伊娜·卡玛特拉的长女。1195年父亲夺取皇位时，她已嫁给安德洛尼卡·孔托斯特法诺斯。安德洛尼卡约1196年去世，不久前曾退入修道院。

Irene Laskarina (c. 1194–1240) was a daughter of Theodore I Laskaris, founder of the Empire of Nicaea. She first married Andronikos Palaiologos; after his death her father in 1212 wedded her to his successor, the future John III Vatatzes.

When John succeeded in 1221 she became empress of Nicaea, and their son was Theodore II Laskaris. Badly injured in a riding accident after his birth, she could bear no more children, withdrew to a convent as the nun Eugenia, and died there in 1240.

Isaac Angelos Doukas was a twelfth-century Byzantine nobleman and commander, a son of Constantine Angelos and of Theodora Komnene, daughter of Emperor Alexios I Komnenos. His brother Andronikos fathered Emperor Isaac II Angelos, who appointed him strategos of the theme of Cilicia.

A daughter of Isaac married Basil Vatatzes, domestikos of the West. His son Constantine Angelos Doukas became megas doux of the fleet and was blinded after a failed bid for the throne in 1193.

Isaac I Komnenos (c. 1007–1060), the first Komnenian Byzantine emperor, reigned from 1057 to 1059. Son of General Manuel Erotikos Komnenos, he commanded the eastern field army before leading the 1057 revolt against Michael VI, winning at Hades and forcing his abdication.

As emperor he cut salaries and confiscated Church lands to rebuild the army and treasury. These measures provoked opposition, above all from Patriarch Michael Keroularios, whom he exiled in 1058. After campaigning against the Pechenegs in 1059, he fell ill and abdicated in favour of Constantine X Doukas, dying as a monk in 1060.

伊萨克一世·科穆宁（约1007—1060）是科穆宁王朝第一位拜占庭皇帝，1057至1059年在位。他是将领曼努埃尔·厄洛提科斯·科穆宁之子，曾任东方野战军统帅；1057年领导众将起兵反叛米哈伊尔六世，在哈迪斯之战获胜，迫使对方退位。

即位后他削减俸禄、没收教会地产以充实军队和国库，招致强烈反对，牧首米哈伊尔·凯鲁拉里奥斯尤甚，伊萨克于1058年将他放逐。1059年他出征佩切涅格人后患病，让位给君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯，出家后于1060年去世。
