en:
Isaac II Angelos (1156–1204) was Byzantine emperor from 1185 to 1195 and again in 1203–1204. In 1185 he took refuge in Hagia Sophia after a killing, sparking the revolt that toppled Andronikos I.

Taxes provoked a Bulgarian and Vlach revolt that founded the Second Bulgarian Empire; his reign also saw Cyprus lost and defeats at Tryavna in 1190 and Arcadiopolis in 1194. In 1195 his brother Alexios III blinded and imprisoned him. Restored by the Fourth Crusade in 1203 with his son Alexios IV, he died in 1204, weeks before the city was sacked.

en:
Isaac Komnenos (1093–after 1152), third son of Emperor Alexios I, was a porphyrogennetos. He helped his brother John II take the throne in 1118 and became sebastokrator, but conspired against John from 1130 and spent years exiled in Asia Minor and the Levant.

Pardoned in 1138, he was exiled again in 1139 after his son defected to the Seljuk Turks, and in 1143 backed the losing claimant against Manuel I. Forced into retirement in 1150, he founded the Kosmosoteira Monastery and wrote its charter in 1152, and rebuilt the Chora Church. His son Andronikos I later seized the throne.

Isaac Komnenos Doukas (c. 1155–1203) was the eldest son of the sebastokrator John Doukas and Zoe Doukaina, and elder brother of the Epirote founders Michael I and Theodore Komnenos Doukas. In 1185 he joined his father at the Hagia Sophia in backing Isaac II Angelos' uprising against Andronikos I.

Around 1187 he married a daughter of Alexios Branas, shortly before Branas revolted against Isaac II. He was probably killed fighting the Fourth Crusade at Constantinople in 1203.

Isaac Doukas Vatatzes (c. 1188–1261) was the elder brother of the Nicaean emperor John III Doukas Vatatzes and probably eldest son of the general Basil Vatatzes. He held the title of sebastokrator by 1253, and in 1261, as keeper of the imperial seal, witnessed the Treaty of Nymphaeum with Genoa.

Sent to Genoa to ratify it, he died during the negotiations and was buried in Genoa Cathedral. His short-lived son John married Eudokia Angelina and fathered Theodora, wife of Michael VIII Palaiologos.

伊萨克·杜卡斯·瓦塔泽斯（约1188—1261）是尼西亚皇帝约翰三世·杜卡斯·瓦塔泽斯之兄，一般认为是将领瓦西里·瓦塔泽斯的长子。到1253年他已拥有塞巴斯托克拉托高级宫廷头衔；1261年以御玺掌管者身份见证了与热那亚签订的《尼姆法伊翁条约》。

他奉命赴热那亚批准条约，却在谈判期间去世，葬于热那亚主教座堂。其子约翰早逝，娶优多基娅·安格丽娜，生女狄奥多拉，即米海尔八世·巴列奥略的皇后。

en:
Isabelle de Lusignan (born c. 1333) was the daughter of Guy de Lusignan, a prince of the Cypriot Lusignan dynasty, and the Byzantine noblewoman Theodora Syrgiannaina. Her father was crowned king of Armenian Cilicia as Constantine II in 1342 but was murdered at Adana in November 1344 in an anti-Latin rising, while Isabelle stayed at the Byzantine court.

In 1349 she married Manuel Kantakouzenos, son of Emperor John VI and despot of the Morea at Mystras, becoming its despoina and holding lands including Aradippou on Cyprus. She died after 1387 and was buried at Mystras.

伊莎贝尔·德·吕西尼昂（约1333年生）是塞浦路斯吕西尼昂家族王公居伊·德·吕西尼昂与拜占庭贵妇狄奥多拉·西尔伊安奈娜之女。1342年，她的父亲在奇里乞亚亚美尼亚加冕为国王，称康斯坦丁二世，但1344年11月在阿达纳的一场反拉丁人暴动中遇害，伊莎贝尔则留在拜占庭宫廷。

1349年，她嫁给皇帝约翰六世之子曼努埃尔·坎塔库泽努斯；后者以米斯特拉斯为治所担任摩里亚专制君主，她遂成为摩里亚专制君主夫人，并领有塞浦路斯的阿拉迪普等地。她于1387年后去世，葬于米斯特拉斯。

Ivan Rostyslavych Berladnik (c. 1112–1162) was a Rurikid prince, son of Rostyslav Volodarevych of Peremyshl and grandson of Volodar. He held Zvenyhorod from 1129 and briefly claimed Halych in 1144, when its boyars tried to raise him to the throne against Prince Volodymyrko. Defeated, he fled to Berlad, among the Berladnici, from whom he took his nickname.

After years at the Kyiv court and renewed wars against Yaroslav Osmomysl, who allied Hungary and Poland against him, he was driven into Byzantine exile and died at Thessaloniki in 1162, reputedly poisoned.

伊凡·罗斯季斯拉维奇·贝尔拉德尼克（约1112—1162）是留里克王朝王公，普热梅希尔的罗斯季斯拉夫·沃洛达列维奇之子、沃洛达尔之孙。他自1129年起领有兹韦尼哥罗德，1144年加利奇的贵族试图推翻王公弗拉基米尔科、将他拥上王公之位，事败后他逃往贝尔拉德，投奔贝尔拉德尼克流民，绰号即由此而来。

他在基辅的宫廷客居多年，后来又与雅罗斯拉夫·奥斯莫梅斯尔交战，后者联合匈牙利与波兰将他逐走，他被迫流亡拜占庭，1162年死于塞萨洛尼基，相传是被毒杀。

en:
John I Tzimiskes (c. 925–976) was an Armenian-born Byzantine commander who helped murder his uncle Nikephoros II in 969 and seized the crown. He crushed Bardas Phokas's revolt. In 971 he besieged Sviatoslav of Kiev at Dorostolon for sixty-five days, negotiated the departure of the Rus', and proclaimed Bulgaria annexed. On his return to Constantinople he stripped Boris II of his imperial insignia.

In 972–975 he campaigned through Mesopotamia and Syria, but failed to take Jerusalem. He died on his return in 976, supposedly poisoned by Basil Lekapenos, and Basil II succeeded him.

约翰一世·齐米斯西斯（约925—976）是亚美尼亚出身的拜占庭将领，969年参与谋杀舅父尼基弗鲁斯二世后夺取皇位，并镇压了巴尔达斯·福卡斯的叛乱。971年，他在多罗斯托隆围困基辅大公斯维亚托斯拉夫六十五天，议定罗斯人撤离，并宣布吞并保加利亚；返回君士坦丁堡后，他剥夺了保加利亚皇帝鲍里斯二世的帝号。

972—975年，他转战美索不达米亚和叙利亚，却未能攻下耶路撒冷。976年他在班师途中暴卒，传为巴西尔·利卡潘努斯毒杀，皇位由巴西尔二世继承。

en:
John VI Kantakouzenos (1292–1383) was a Byzantine statesman and emperor. The closest friend of Andronikos III, whom he backed against Andronikos II in the 1320s civil war, he became grand domestic and chief minister, and was entrusted with the empire's administration when Andronikos took sole power in 1328.

In 1341 he became regent for the nine-year-old John V. While he was away raising an army, court rivals led by Anna of Savoy overthrew the regency and imprisoned or exiled his relatives. His army proclaimed him emperor at Didymoteichon in 1341, and he was crowned in Constantinople in 1347, ruling until 1354.

The civil wars let his former ally Stefan Dušan seize the Balkan provinces, and the Ottoman Turks occupied Gallipoli in 1354. Deposed by John V, he became the monk Joasaph and wrote a history covering 1320 to 1354. He died at about 91.

约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯（1292—1383）是拜占庭政治家、皇帝。他是安德洛尼卡三世最亲密的朋友，1320年代祖孙内战中支持安德洛尼卡三世对抗安德洛尼卡二世，后任大将军、首席大臣；1328年安德洛尼卡三世独掌大权，将帝国政务托付给他。

1341年他为年仅九岁的约翰五世摄政。他离开首都筹备军队时，萨伏依的安娜为首的朝中政敌推翻摄政政府，将他的亲属囚禁或流放。1341年他在季季莫蒂霍被军队拥立为帝，1347年在君士坦丁堡加冕，在位至1354年。

连年内战使昔日盟友斯特凡·杜尚夺取巴尔干诸省，奥斯曼土耳其人也于1354年占领加里波利。他被约翰五世废黜后出家，改名约阿萨夫，写下一部记述1320至1354年的史著，享年约91岁。

en:
John Koukouzelis Papadopoulos (born c. 1270) was a Byzantine composer, singer and reformer of Byzantine chant, probably born at Dyrrhachium. Educated in the imperial school at Constantinople, he became a principal choir chanter and a favourite of the emperor before withdrawing to the Great Lavra on Mount Athos, where he took the monastic name Ioannikios.

Celebrated for his voice as Angel-voiced, he composed and annotated chants that shaped later Byzantine music, and the Orthodox Church later honoured him as a saint with feast day on 1 October.

John Palaiologos (1286–1307) was a son of Emperor Andronikos II and his second wife, Irene of Montferrat. He was made Despot in 1295 and in 1303 married Irene Choumnaina, daughter of Nikephoros Choumnos, and from 1304 governed Thessalonica.

In 1305 his mother wanted him to claim the vacant March of Montferrat, but Patriarch Athanasius I blocked the plan and his younger brother Theodore went instead. John died in Thessalonica in 1307 and was buried in Constantinople's Pantokrator Monastery in 1321.

en:
John V Palaiologos (1332–1391), son of Andronikos III and Anna of Savoy, inherited the throne at nine in 1341 and reigned as the empire slid toward Ottoman vassalage. In the regency civil war Anna pawned the crown jewels to Venice in 1343. The peace of 1347 made John VI Kantakouzenos senior emperor and married John to his daughter Helena. War resumed in 1352, and the Ottomans won their first European territory amid the chaos. John took real power in 1354.

Seeking Western help, he became a Catholic in Rome in 1369, but Venice detained him for debt; in 1371 he accepted Sultan Murad I as suzerain.

His son Andronikos IV deposed him in 1376 and his grandson John VII in 1390. That year Bayezid I, threatening to blind his hostage son Manuel, forced him to dismantle the newly strengthened Golden Gate. He died in 1391 and Manuel succeeded him.

约翰五世·巴列奥略（1332—1391）是安德洛尼卡三世与萨伏依的安娜之子，1341年年方九岁继承皇位，在位期间帝国一步步滑向对奥斯曼人的臣属。摄政内战中，安娜于1343年把皇冠珠宝典当给威尼斯。1347年和约规定两帝共治，由约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯居首掌政，约翰五世位居其次，并娶约翰六世之女海伦娜为妻。1352年战事再起，奥斯曼人趁乱夺得第一块欧洲领土。1354年他真正掌权。

为争取西方援助，他于1369年在罗马皈依天主教，却因债务被威尼斯扣押；1371年承认苏丹穆拉德一世的宗主权。

1376年他被儿子安德洛尼卡四世推翻，1390年又被孙子约翰七世推翻。同年，巴耶济德一世以刺瞎人质曼努埃尔相威胁，迫使他拆除刚加固的金门。不久后他于1391年去世，由曼努埃尔继位。

en:
John XIV Kalekas (c. 1282–1347), patriarch of Constantinople from 1334, came from a modest Thracian family and had a wife and children before ordination. Kantakouzenos, chief minister of Andronikos III, pushed through his election as patriarch against the synod's resistance.

After Andronikos died in 1341 Kalekas turned against his patron: Anna of Savoy made him regent for the child John V, and with Alexios Apokaukos he led the regency side in the 1341–1347 civil war against Kantakouzenos. He also opposed Hesychasm, and his synod of 1345 excommunicated Gregory Palamas and jailed him.

Kantakouzenos, helped by the Ottoman emir Orhan and Apokaukos's murder, then struck the regency a heavy blow. In 1347 a synod deposed Kalekas and exiled him to Didymoteicho; days later Kantakouzenos entered Constantinople and confirmed the sentence. Kalekas died in December 1347.

约翰十四世·卡莱卡斯（约1282—1347）自1334年起任君士坦丁堡牧首，出身色雷斯贫寒家庭，受神职前已娶妻生子。安德洛尼卡三世的首席大臣约翰·坎塔库泽努斯不顾牧首会议反对，扶他当选牧首。

1341年安德洛尼卡三世去世后，卡莱卡斯与恩主反目：萨伏依的安娜让他出任年幼的约翰五世的摄政，他与阿历克塞·阿波考寇斯在1341—1347年内战中领导摄政一方对抗坎塔库泽努斯。他还反对静修派，1345年他主持的宗教会议将格列高利·帕拉马斯革出教会并关押。

此时坎塔库泽努斯借助奥斯曼埃米尔奥尔汗的援军，又逢阿波考寇斯被杀，已给摄政一方沉重一击。1347年宗教会议废黜卡莱卡斯，将他流放季季莫蒂霍；数日后坎塔库泽努斯进入君士坦丁堡确认裁决。卡莱卡斯于1347年12月去世。

en:
Jovian (331–364), born at Singidunum, was a senior guard officer on Julian's Persian campaign of 363. After Julian's mortal wounding at Samarra in June, the army proclaimed Jovian emperor.

Unable to bridge the Tigris and reach Roman territory, he bought his army's safety by a thirty-year peace with Shapur II that ceded five provinces, the fortress of Nisibis and Roman influence in Armenia. The people of Nisibis had three days to leave before the city was handed over.

As a Christian he ended Julian's pagan revival. In February 364 he was found dead in his tent at Dadastana, aged thirty-three, after a reign of eight months.

约维安（331—364）出生于辛吉杜努姆，363年以禁军高级军官身份参加尤利安的波斯战争。6月尤利安在萨马拉受致命伤后，撤退中的军队拥立约维安为帝。

由于无法在底格里斯河上架桥返回罗马领土，他以与沙普尔二世缔结三十年和约、割让五个行省和尼西比斯要塞、放弃罗马在亚美尼亚的影响为代价，换取军队安全撤退。尼西比斯移交前，居民只有三天时间离城。

作为基督徒，他终止了尤利安复兴异教的政策。364年2月，他被发现死于达达斯塔纳的营帐中，年仅三十三岁，在位八个月。

en:
Julian the Apostate (331–363) was the last non-Christian Roman emperor and a philosopher who wrote in Greek. A nephew of Constantine the Great, he lost his father in the massacre of 337. Raised Christian, he turned to Neoplatonism around twenty. Made Caesar of Gaul in 355, he fought Germanic raiders on the Rhine, and in 360 his Lutetia soldiers proclaimed him emperor. Constantius died naming him heir and Julian entered Constantinople in 361.

In 362 he restored pagan temples, withdrew the privileges Constantine had given Christian bishops and, by his School Edict, barred Christians from teaching the classics.

In 363 he invaded Persia, won before Ctesiphon but failed to take it, burned his fleet and pushed inland with a harried army. At Samarra a spear struck him and he died within three days; last words 'You have won, Galilean' are thought apocryphal. Jovian succeeded, ceded Nisibis and restored Christianity.

尤利安，世称背教者尤利安（331—363），是罗马帝国最后一位非基督教皇帝，也是用希腊语写作的哲学家。他是君士坦丁大帝的侄子，337年屠杀中丧父。自幼受基督教教育，约二十岁转向新柏拉图主义。355年任高卢凯撒，在莱茵河抵御日耳曼人，360年卢泰西亚士兵拥立他为帝。君士坦提乌斯病逝前指定他为继承人，361年进入君士坦丁堡。

362年重修异教神庙，取消君士坦丁所赐主教特权，以《学校敕令》禁止基督徒讲授古典典籍。

363年远征波斯，泰西封城下获胜却未能破城，焚毁舰队深入内陆，大军屡遭袭扰。在萨迈拉被长矛刺中，三天后去世；遗言“加利利人，你赢了”被认为出于附会。约维安继位，割让尼西比斯并恢复基督教地位。

en:
Flavius Julius Constantius (died 337) was a son of Emperor Constantius Chlorus and Flavia Maximiana Theodora, and a younger half-brother of Constantine the Great. Long kept away from court, he was summoned to Constantinople only after the empress Helena's death, and in 335 Constantine made him patricius and consul.

By his second wife Basilina he fathered the future emperor Julian, while an earlier son, Gallus, became Caesar under Constantius II. In the purges that followed Constantine's death in 337, Julius Constantius and his eldest son were executed on Constantius II's orders.

弗拉维乌斯·尤利乌斯·君士坦提乌斯（卒于337年）是皇帝君士坦提乌斯·克洛卢斯与弗拉维娅·马克西米安娜·狄奥多拉之子、君士坦丁大帝的异母弟。他长期被置于宫廷之外，直到皇后海伦娜去世后才应召前往君士坦丁堡，君士坦丁于335年授他贵族衔并任其为执政官。

他与继室巴西利娜生下后来的皇帝尤利安，前妻所生的加卢斯则被君士坦提乌斯二世立为恺撒。337年君士坦丁死后的大清洗中，他与长子一同被君士坦提乌斯二世下令处死。

en:
Justin I (c. 450–527) was born a peasant in Bederiana near Naissus and reached Constantinople illiterate, having fled poverty with two companions and little more than a sack of bread. He enlisted in the palace guard and rose to become its commander under Anastasius I. When Anastasius died in 518, Justin outmaneuvered his rivals and secured election as emperor.

A firm Chalcedonian, he healed the Acacian schism with Rome in 519. In his later years his nephew Justinian increasingly directed policy; in 527 Justin crowned him co-emperor, and on his death Justinian succeeded, founding the Justinianic dynasty.

查士丁一世（约450—527）出身农家，生于纳伊苏斯附近的贝德里亚纳，为逃避贫困与两名同伴离乡，随身几乎只有一袋面包，到君士坦丁堡时目不识丁。他加入宫廷卫队，在阿纳斯塔修斯一世麾下逐步升为卫队统领。518年阿纳斯塔修斯去世，查士丁计胜政敌，被拥立为帝。

他坚守迦克墩正统，519年结束了与罗马之间的阿卡西乌分裂。晚年政务多由外甥查士丁尼主持；527年他立查士丁尼为共治皇帝，去世后查士丁尼继位，开创查士丁尼王朝。

en:
Justin II (c. 520–578), nephew of Justinian I and husband of Sophia, was curopalates at his uncle's court. He succeeded the childless Justinian in 565, inheriting an overextended empire. He ended subsidies to the Avars and Persians: in 568 the Lombards invaded Italy and overran the Po valley, and in 572 his refusal of tribute to Khosrow I reopened war with Persia; the fall of Dara in 573 drove him mad.

In 574 he adopted Tiberius and named him Caesar, after which Tiberius ruled with Empress Sophia. In 578, in a lucid moment, Justin crowned Tiberius co-emperor and died.

zh:
查士丁二世（约520—578）是查士丁尼一世的外甥，娶索菲亚为妻，曾在舅父宫廷任宫廷总管。565年他继承无嗣舅父的皇位，接掌扩张过度的庞大帝国。他停止向阿瓦尔人和波斯人输送贡金：568年伦巴第人入侵意大利、席卷波河平原；572年他拒绝向霍斯劳一世纳贡，重启对波斯战争，573年达拉陷落更促使他精神失常。

en:
Justinian I (482–565) ruled the Eastern Roman Empire from 527 to 565 and tried to win back the lost West. Born a peasant at Tauresium, he was brought to Constantinople by his uncle Justin, who became emperor in 518 with his help. He married the actress Theodora, a powerful partner; he was called the emperor who never sleeps.

In 532 the Nika riots nearly toppled him; he considered fleeing by sea, but Theodora refused to leave and Belisarius crushed the revolt. The city was rebuilt, including Hagia Sophia. He sent Belisarius against the Vandals in 533; Belisarius took Ravenna in 540 and his generals restored Italy and southern Spain.

Under Tribonian, the Codex, Digest and Institutes formed the Corpus Juris Civilis, basis of much continental law. Plague struck him in 542, Theodora died in 548, and he died childless in 565, succeeded by his nephew Justin II.

查士丁尼一世（482—565）527年起统治东罗马帝国，志在收复西部。他出身农家，生于陶雷西乌姆，被舅父查士丁带到君士坦丁堡；518年查士丁在他帮助下称帝。他迎娶演员狄奥多拉，她成为有力伙伴，人称“不眠皇帝”。

532年尼卡暴动几乎推翻他，他一度想乘船出逃，狄奥多拉拒绝离开，贝利撒留将其镇压。都城重建，包括圣索菲亚大教堂。533年他派贝利撒留远征汪达尔人；540年贝利撒留攻占拉文纳，众将收复意大利和伊比利亚南部。

在特里波尼安主持下，《查士丁尼法典》、《学说汇纂》、《法学阶梯》合成《国法大全》，成为欧陆诸多法律的基础。542年他染瘟疫，548年狄奥多拉去世。565年他无嗣而终，外甥查士丁二世继位。

en:
Justinian II (668/669–711), last emperor of the Heraclian dynasty, succeeded his father Constantine IV in 685. In 688 he agreed with the Caliph to divide Cyprus's tax revenue. He defeated the Slavs of Macedonia in 688–689 and resettled many in Anatolia, but was later defeated by the Arabs after Slav troops defected.

His Quinisext Council of 692 estranged Rome, and in 695 Leontius overthrew him, slit his nose and exiled him to Cherson. In 705 he returned with an army from Bulgar khan Tervel, wearing a golden nose, and executed Leontius and Tiberius III.

His second reign ended in 711 when a Cherson revolt raised Philippicus; Justinian was beheaded and his young son Tiberius murdered, ending the Heraclian line.

zh:
查士丁尼二世（668/669—711）是希拉克略王朝末代皇帝，685年继承父亲君士坦丁四世的皇位。688年，他与哈里发商定平分塞浦路斯税收。他于688—689年击败马其顿的斯拉夫人，将许多人迁至安纳托利亚，后来却因斯拉夫士兵倒戈而败于阿拉伯人。

692年召开的五六会议使罗马离心；695年利昂提奥斯将他推翻，割去他的鼻子并流放至赫尔松。705年，他借保加尔汗特尔维尔的军队复位，戴着黄金假鼻处死利昂提奥斯和提比略三世。

711年赫尔松起兵拥立菲利皮科斯，他的第二次统治终结；查士丁尼被斩首，幼子提比略一同遇害，希拉克略王朝就此终结。

en:
Constantine Angelos (c. 1093–after 1166) was a Byzantine noble from Philadelphia who in c. 1122 married Theodora Komnene, daughter of Emperor Alexios I, over the apparent disapproval of Empress Irene; the marriage raised him to the rank of sebastohypertatos.

A trusted commander of Manuel I Komnenos, he led the fleet against the Sicilians in 1154, but disobeyed orders, lost the battle and was held captive in Palermo until 1158. In 1166 he refortified Zemun, Belgrade and Niš against Hungary. Through his sons he founded the Angelos line, which produced the emperors Isaac II and Alexios III.

en:
Constantine Palaiologos (c. 1230–1271) was a younger son of the megas domestikos Andronikos Palaiologos and the half-brother of Emperor Michael VIII. After Michael's accession he was made Caesar in 1259 and sebastokrator the next year, and he married Irene Komnene Laskarina Branaina.

He led the Byzantine army into the Morea against the Latin Principality of Achaea, but his campaign ended in defeat at the Battle of Prinitza. He later became a monk under the name Kallinikos and died in 1271.

en:
Constantine Palaiologos Asen was a Byzantine aristocrat and officer, a son of Bulgarian Tsar Ivan Asen III and Irene Palaiologina, probably born in exile in the late thirteenth century. In 1324 he and his brother Andronikos Asen signed Byzantium's treaty with Venice, and during the civil war between the two Andronikoi he served Andronikos II as strategos until captured in the defeat at the River Melas in 1328.

In 1342, supporting John V Palaiologos, he signed another Venetian treaty but was soon arrested with his son on Alexios Apokaukos' orders and vanished from the sources.

en:
Constantine Palaiologos (1261–1306) was the third son of Emperor Michael VIII and Theodora Palaiologina, born in Constantinople just after its recovery from the Latins, a porphyrogennetos or purple-born prince. He married Irene Palaiologina Raoulaina, with whom he had a son, John.

In 1280 he campaigned in Asia Minor, clearing Turkish raiders from the Maeander valley. In 1293 he was slandered to his brother Emperor Andronikos II and imprisoned; he later became a monk named Athanasios and died in Constantinople on 5 May 1306.

en:
Constantine X Doukas (c. 1006–1067) founded the Doukid dynasty and ruled Byzantium from 1059 to 1067. A scholar-aristocrat, he backed Isaac I Komnenos in 1057, later opposed his reforms and succeeded him in 1059.

As emperor he favoured bureaucrats over soldiers, cut army funding, disbanded his Armenian militia and left frontier forts unrepaired. Military aristocrats tried to assassinate him in 1061, and his taxes to pay the army made him unpopular.

Frontier losses mounted: the Normans took Calabria and Alp Arslan stormed Ani in 1064. He died on 23 May 1067, leaving his widow Eudokia ruling for his young sons.

君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯（约1006—1067）是杜卡斯王朝的建立者，1059至1067年为拜占庭皇帝。他是学者型贵族，1057年支持伊萨克一世·科穆宁夺权，后来反对其改革，于1059年继位。

在位时他重用文官、轻视武将，削减军费，解散亚美尼亚地方军，又不修缮边境要塞。1061年军方贵族试图刺杀他，而他为支付军费加税，也失去了民心。

边境败报接连不断：诺曼人夺取卡拉布里亚，阿尔普·阿尔斯兰于1064年攻陷阿尼。他于1067年5月23日去世，遗命皇后欧多西亚为年幼的儿子们守护皇位。

en:
Leo I the Thracian (c. 401–474) was Eastern Roman emperor from 457 to 474. A Thraco-Roman officer placed on the throne by the general Aspar, he gradually shook off his patron, and his 457 coronation was the first where the Patriarch of Constantinople crowned the emperor.

To check Aspar he allied with the Isaurians, marrying his daughter Ariadne to their leader, the future Zeno, and in 471 had Aspar and his son killed. His 468 expedition against the Vandals ended in costly defeat. He died in January 474, leaving the throne to his grandson Leo II.

利奥一世，绰号“色雷斯人”（约401—474），是457年至474年在位的东罗马帝国皇帝。他是色雷斯—罗马血统的军官，被名将阿斯帕尔扶上皇位，却逐渐摆脱了这位靠山；457年的加冕首次由君士坦丁堡牧首亲自为皇帝戴冠。

为制衡阿斯帕尔，他与伊苏利亚人结盟，把女儿阿里阿德涅嫁给其首领、后来的芝诺，并于471年诛杀阿斯帕尔父子。468年远征汪达尔人的行动以惨败告终，耗费巨大。474年1月他去世，皇位传给外孙利奥二世。

en:
Leo II (c. 467–474), called the Younger, was Eastern Roman emperor for barely a year, the only son of the Isaurian general Zeno and Ariadne, daughter of Emperor Leo I. On 17 November 473 his grandfather crowned him co-emperor, and on Leo I's death on 18 January 474 the seven-year-old became sole emperor.

On 29 January the Byzantine Senate made Zeno co-emperor. Leo II died in November 474, after which Zeno ruled alone.

en:
Leo III the Isaurian (c. 685–741) was born Konon in Germanikeia, Syria, and rose to command the Anatolic Theme. He allied with Artabasdos before forcing Theodosius III to abdicate in 717, ending the Twenty Years' Anarchy and founding the Isaurian dynasty.

In 717–718 he withstood the Umayyad siege of Constantinople. His edicts of 726–729 against icon veneration opened the iconoclast controversy and estranged the papacy; he also issued the law code Ecloga in 726 and destroyed an Arab army at Akroinon in 740. He died in 741 and was succeeded by his son Constantine V.

zh:
利奥三世（约685—741）生于叙利亚的日耳曼尼基亚，原名科农，后来执掌安纳托利亚军区。他与阿尔塔瓦兹德结盟，717年逼迫狄奥多西三世退位，结束二十年混乱，开创伊苏里亚王朝。

717—718年他顶住了倭马亚王朝对君士坦丁堡的围攻。他在726—729年颁布反对圣像崇拜的法令，开启圣像破坏之争，并与罗马教廷交恶；又于726年颁布法典《法律选编》，740年在阿克罗伊农歼灭一支阿拉伯军队。741年他去世，儿子君士坦丁五世继位。

en:
Leo IV the Khazar (750–780), son of Constantine V by the Khazar princess Tzitzak, was crowned co-emperor in 751 and married Irene of Athens in 769. He succeeded his father in September 775, already suffering from tuberculosis, and his illness and the youth of his son gave his half-brothers hope of the throne.

In 776 he named his young son Constantine VI heir and pardoned his half-brothers after their failed plot. His armies defeated the caliph's forces at Germanikeia in 778 and repelled another invasion the next year. When Leo died on 8 September 780, the nine-year-old Constantine became emperor under Irene's regency.

en:
Leo V (c. 775–25 December 820), called the Armenian, was a Byzantine general commanding the Anatolic Theme. After the rout at Versinikia in 813, he forced Michael I Rangabe to abdicate and took the throne.

He endured Krum of Bulgaria's blockade of Constantinople and attempted to kill him at a parley. After Krum's death he made a thirty-year peace with Omurtag. In 815 he deposed Patriarch Nikephoros and launched the second period of iconoclasm. On Christmas Day 820 conspirators serving Michael the Amorian murdered him during the dawn liturgy, and Michael became emperor.

利奥五世（约775—820年12月25日），人称“亚美尼亚人”，是拜占庭将领，官至安纳托利亚军区将军。813年韦尔西尼基阿之战溃败后，他逼迫米海尔一世·兰加贝退位，自立为帝。

他顶住保加利亚汗克鲁姆对君士坦丁堡的封锁，并试图在谈判时刺杀克鲁姆。克鲁姆死后，利奥与奥莫尔塔格订立三十年和约。815年，利奥废黜牧首尼基弗鲁斯，发起第二波圣像破坏运动。820年圣诞节，效忠阿摩里亚人米海尔的密谋者在黎明礼拜时将他杀害，米海尔随后称帝。

en:
Leo VI the Wise (866–912) was Byzantine emperor from 886 to 912. Reputedly Michael III's son by Eudokia Ingerina, his paternity was uncertain. His relationship with Basil deteriorated, and an accusation of conspiracy nearly cost him his sight. He completed the Basilika law code and wrote the treatise Tactica.

War with Simeon I of Bulgaria brought defeat at Boulgarophygon in 896 and annual tribute, and Leo of Tripoli sacked Thessalonica in 904. His four marriages to secure an heir pitted him against the patriarch, whom he replaced. He died in May 912, leaving young Constantine VII to his brother Alexander.

en:
Leontius, born in Isauria, was strategos of the Anatolic Theme who campaigned against the Umayyads in Armenia and forced the caliph to make peace in 688. Around the time of the Byzantine defeat at Sebastopolis in 692, Justinian II imprisoned him, but released him in 695 to lead the Theme of Hellas.

He rebelled at once, seized Constantinople, mutilated and exiled Justinian to Cherson, and ruled as Emperor Leo until 698, when Carthage was lost. A recovery expedition he sent failed and its officers rebelled. Overthrown in 698 by the officer Apsimar (Tiberius III), he was beheaded alongside Tiberius after Justinian II returned to power, on 15 February 706.

利昂提奥斯出生于伊苏利亚，曾任安纳托利亚军区将军，与倭马亚人在亚美尼亚作战，688年迫使哈里发求和。692年拜占庭在塞巴斯托波利斯战败，查士丁尼二世约在此时将他下狱，695年释放他并任命他统领希腊军区。

en:
Licinius (c. 265–325), born to a Dacian peasant family in Moesia Superior, was a friend of Galerius, who made him Augustus in 308 with charge of the Balkan provinces. After Galerius died in 311, Licinius and Maximinus Daza divided the eastern provinces.

In 313 he married Constantine's half-sister Constantia and jointly issued the Edict of Milan granting toleration to Christians, then defeated Maximinus Daza at Tzirallum and became Augustus of the East. He and Constantine later fell into civil war; he was defeated at Chrysopolis in 324, surrendered, and was executed the following year.

en:
Lucius Aurelius Verus (130–169) was Roman emperor from 161 until his death, ruling jointly with his adoptive brother Marcus Aurelius—Rome's first two simultaneous emperors. The son of Hadrian's heir Lucius Aelius Caesar, he was adopted by Antoninus Pius in 138, studied under Fronto and held the consulship with Marcus in 161.

He directed the Parthian war of 162–166, which ended in Roman victory and territorial gains, and wed Marcus' daughter Lucilla. In 168 the Marcomanni crossed the Danube; returning from that front he fell ill and died in early 169, probably of the Antonine Plague. The Senate deified him.

卢基乌斯·维鲁斯（130—169）于161年至去世任罗马皇帝，与养兄马可·奥勒留共同主政，是罗马史上第一对同时在位的皇帝。他是哈德良继承人卢基乌斯·埃利乌斯·凯撒之子，138年被安敦宁·毕尤收养，师从弗龙托，161年与马可共同担任执政官。

他指挥162—166年的帕提亚战争，罗马取胜并取得新领土；他还娶了马可的女儿露西拉。168年马科曼尼人渡过多瑙河，他从前线返回后病倒，于169年初去世，或死于安东尼大瘟疫，随后被元老院神化。

Macrinus (c. 165–218), born at Caesarea to a Berber equestrian family, was a lawyer who became praetorian prefect under Caracalla. He had Caracalla stabbed near Carrhae on 8 April 217 and was proclaimed emperor three days later, the first ruler from outside the senatorial class; he never visited Rome.

He ruled jointly with his young son Diadumenianus and made peace with Parthia and other neighbours, but his fiscal cuts angered the army. In 218 Julia Maesa raised a revolt for her grandson Elagabalus, defeating Macrinus at Antioch on 8 June. Captured at Chalcedon and executed in Cappadocia, he suffered damnatio memoriae by the Senate.

马克里努斯（约165—218）出生于凯撒里亚，出身柏柏尔骑士家庭，早年以法律才干入仕，后在卡拉卡拉麾下任禁卫军长官。他于217年4月8日派人在卡雷附近刺死卡拉卡拉，三天后被军队拥立为帝，是第一位非元老院阶层出身的皇帝，从未到过罗马。

他与年幼的儿子狄亚杜门尼安共治，并与帕提亚等邻邦议和，但财政紧缩引起军队不满。218年，尤利亚·梅萨为外孙埃拉伽巴路斯发动叛乱，于6月8日在安条克击败马克里努斯。他在卡尔西顿被俘，在卡帕多细亚被处死，随后被元老院处以记录抹杀之刑。

Manuel Erotikos Komnenos (c. 955/960–c. 1020) was a Byzantine general under Emperor Basil II and first securely attested ancestor of the Komnenian dynasty. In 978 he led the defence of Nicaea against the rebel Bardas Skleros, bluffing him into letting the starving city withdraw to Constantinople, and in 989 he persuaded Skleros to surrender.

He owned estates around Kastamon in Paphlagonia. When he died around 1020 his young sons were entrusted to Basil II; Isaac took the throne in 1057 and John's son became Alexios I.

Manuel I Komnenos (1118–1180), fourth son of John II, was proclaimed emperor in Cilicia in 1143 after his father's death. He led the Komnenian restoration to its height.

He managed the passage of the Second Crusade, invaded Norman Italy without lasting success, established a protectorate over the Crusader states, and defeated Hungary at Sirmium in 1167, extending Byzantine power over the Balkans.

In the east his ambitions suffered a serious setback against the Seljuk Turks at Myriokephalon in 1176, though he later made peace with the Seljuk sultan. He died in 1180, succeeded by his young son Alexios II.

en:
Manuel Kantakouzenos (c. 1326–1380) was the second son of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos and Irene Asanina, and the first of the long-ruling despots of the Morea, close kin of the Constantinople emperors. His father made him governor of Veria in 1343; when Stefan Dušan took it in 1347, Manuel took refuge in Thessaly.

He led Constantinople's defense against the Genoese in 1348–1349, then reached the Morea in 1349 and crushed the local archontes. When John V forced John VI to abdicate, Manuel resisted the emperor's appointees until the new regime recognized him. Peace with his Latin neighbors, an alliance against Murad I's raids, and Albanian settlers for the depopulated land gave the peninsula a long period of prosperity.

An army he led in the mid-1370s in a dispute over Gardiki was crushed by Francesco Sansverino. Manuel died at Mistra in 1380, succeeded by his elder brother Matthew.

Manuel Komnenos (1145–after 1185), eldest son of Andronikos I, was the ancestor of the Grand Komnenoi of Trebizond. Under Manuel I he served as envoy to the Russian principalities, and in 1164 helped his father escape from Constantinople. Jailed for opposing the regent Maria, he was freed in 1182.

He condemned Andronikos' persecution of the aristocracy and refused to oversee Maria's execution. Passed over for the succession, he was made sebastokrator while his brother John became co-emperor. In 1185 Isaac II Angelos had him blinded; his sons Alexios and David founded the Empire of Trebizond in 1204.

en:
Manuel Apokaukos was a Byzantine official, a son of the megas doux Alexios Apokaukos, the regency's chief minister during the civil war of 1341–1347. After Adrianople declared for the regency in 1341, his father sent him to govern the city.

When John Kantakouzenos captured Adrianople, Manuel took refuge in the nearby fortress of Boukelo. After Alexios retook the city, Manuel defected to Kantakouzenos in 1344, although the townspeople refused to follow him.

曼努埃尔·阿波考寇斯是14世纪拜占庭官员，海军大统帅阿历克塞·阿波考寇斯之子，其父在1341至1347年内战中担任摄政派的首席大臣。1341年阿德里安堡宣布归附摄政派后，父亲派他出掌该城。

Manuel Komnenos Raoul Asanes (born c. 1298), second son of Andronikos Asen and grandson of Ivan Asen III, was a Byzantine general and Kantakouzenos's brother-in-law. In 1329 Andronikos III entrusted him with the imperial standard at Pelekanos. Accused of plotting against the emperor in 1335, he was held at Vira until 1341.

In the civil war Kantakouzenos in 1342 left him commanding Didymoteicho and marched west. When the Bulgarians sent to help instead sought the city for themselves, Manuel carried his sister Irene's letter to Umur at Smyrna; Umur's Turks landed on the Maritsa and the Bulgarians withdrew.

Kantakouzenos made him sebastokrator in 1347 and despot in 1351, when he led the army and navy with the Venetians against Genoese Galata. In 1356 he backed his nephew Matthew Kantakouzenos against John V.

曼努埃尔·科穆宁·拉乌尔·阿森（约1298年生）是安德洛尼卡·阿森的次子、伊凡·阿森三世之孙，拜占庭将领，也是坎塔库泽努斯的大舅子。1329年佩勒卡农战役中，安德洛尼卡三世把皇家军旗交给他。1335年他被控阴谋反对皇帝，囚于维拉直到1341年。

内战中，坎塔库泽努斯1342年留他统率季季莫蒂霍守军，自己西征。前来相助的保加利亚人竟想夺取该城，曼努埃尔便带着妹妹伊琳娜的求援信去士麦那见乌穆尔；乌穆尔的土耳其人在马里查河登陆，保加利亚人撤走。

坎塔库泽努斯于1347年封他为至尊者，1351年升为专制公；同年他率领陆军和海军，联合威尼斯人进攻热那亚人的加拉塔。1356年，他支持外甥马修·坎塔库泽努斯对抗约翰五世。

Manuel Palaiologos (1297–1320) was a Byzantine prince and despot, the younger son of co-emperor Michael IX Palaiologos and Rita of Armenia, and grandson of Andronikos II.

In 1320, during an affair of his elder brother Andronikos with a woman of humble birth, Manuel went to her house at night; the brother's retainers, mistaking him for a rival, killed him. His father Michael IX died of grief only days later, and the murder helped drive the rift that ignited the civil war between Andronikos II and Andronikos III.

曼努埃尔·巴列奥略（1297—1320）是拜占庭皇子、专制公，共治皇帝米海尔九世·巴列奥略与亚美尼亚的丽塔的幼子，安德洛尼卡二世之孙。

1320年，其兄安德洛尼卡与一名出身低微的女子私通；某夜曼努埃尔前往该女住处，兄长的扈从把他误认为情敌，将他杀害。父亲米海尔九世悲痛过度，几天后便去世；这桩误杀也激化了皇室裂痕，成为安德洛尼卡二世与安德洛尼卡三世祖孙内战的诱因之一。

Marcian (c. 392–457) was Eastern Roman emperor from 450 to 457. A Thracian or Illyrian soldier who served the general Aspar, he took the throne after Theodosius II died, legitimised by marrying his sister Pulcheria.

He ended the tribute paid to Attila and in 452 sent armies across the Danube into the Huns' lands. After Attila died, he settled Germanic tribes within the empire as allies.

In 451 he convened the Council of Chalcedon, which alienated Syria and Egypt. He died in January 457 leaving a treasury surplus of seven million solidi, and Aspar secured the crown for Leo I.

马尔西安（约392—457）是450年至457年在位的东罗马帝国皇帝。他出身色雷斯或伊利里亚，在名将阿斯帕尔帐下效力，狄奥多西二世去世后被扶上皇位，并娶皇帝之姊普尔喀丽娅以正名分。

他停止向阿提拉纳贡，452年派兵渡过多瑙河攻入匈人腹地。阿提拉死后，他将日耳曼部族安置在帝国境内作为盟友。

451年他召开迦克墩公会议，会议的主张激怒了叙利亚和埃及的信徒。457年1月他去世时，国库盈余达七百万索利都斯金币，阿斯帕尔随后把皇冠交给了利奥一世。

Marcus Aurelius (121–180) was Roman emperor from 161 to 180, the last of the Five Good Emperors and a Stoic philosopher whose private notebook, the Meditations, remains among the great works of philosophy. Born in Rome and adopted by Antoninus Pius in 138, he refused to rule alone and made his adoptive brother Lucius Verus joint Augustus.

That year Parthia seized Armenia; Verus' war ended in 166, but the army carried the Antonine Plague home. The Marcomanni then broke across the Danube, and Marcus spent most of his remaining reign on that frontier. Between 170 and 180 he wrote the Meditations in Greek while on campaign.

He died on 17 March 180, aged 58, and was deified. Rome kept his bronze equestrian statue, the only imperial one to survive. His son Commodus, co-ruler since 177, succeeded him; Marcus was reportedly disappointed in the son he had carefully raised.

马可·奥勒留（121—180）于161至180年任罗马皇帝，是“五贤帝”中的最后一位，也是斯多葛派哲学家，他的私人笔记《沉思录》至今被列为哲学名著。他生于罗马，138年被安敦宁·毕尤收养；他不肯独自称帝，立养弟卢基乌斯·维鲁斯为共治奥古斯都。

同年帕提亚夺取亚美尼亚，维鲁斯指挥的战争于166年结束，但军队把安东尼大瘟疫带回国内。继而马科曼尼人突破多瑙河，他余下的统治大半在边境度过。170至180年，他在军旅中用希腊文写下《沉思录》。

180年3月17日他去世，终年58岁，被奉为神。罗马保存着他的青铜骑马像，是帝国时代唯一留存的骑马像。自177年起共治的儿子康茂德继位；据称马可对悉心培养的儿子深感失望。

Maria Doukaina Komnene Branaina Palaiologina was a Byzantine noblewoman of Palaiologan Constantinople and the wife of the general Michael Doukas Glabas Tarchaneiotes, who became protostrator under Michael VIII and Andronikos II. Together the couple restored the monastery church of the Pammakaristos, which they handed over to Patriarch John XII in 1293.

After Glabas died around 1305 to 1308, Maria became a nun under the name Martha and buried him in its side chapel. A probable daughter, Theodote, married the general Chandrenos.

玛丽亚·杜卡伊娜·科姆内纳·布拉奈纳·巴列奥洛吉娜是巴列奥略朝君士坦丁堡的贵族女性，嫁给了在米哈伊尔八世和安德洛尼卡二世两朝官至首席马夫的名将米哈伊尔·杜卡斯·格拉瓦斯·塔恰尼奥提斯。夫妇二人共同修复了帕马卡里斯托斯修道院教堂，并于1293年将其移交牧首约翰十二世。

约1305至1308年格拉巴斯去世后，玛丽亚出家为尼，取修道名玛尔莎，并将丈夫安葬在教堂的侧礼拜堂中。她可能还有一女名叫塞奥多塔，嫁给了将军汉兹里诺斯。

Maria Kantakouzene (born c. 1329) was probably the eldest daughter of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos and Irene Asanina. In 1340 she was betrothed to Nikephoros II Orsini, deposed ruler of Epirus, and married him around 1342. From 1351 the couple governed Ainos.

When Nikephoros sailed for Thessaly in 1356, Maria held Ainos and refused to surrender its fortress to the rebel commander Libidarios. Nikephoros, urged to cast her off for a Serbian marriage, later put her under guard at Arta.

She escaped on a ship sent by her brother Manuel, helped by Acarnanians and Albanians; the Albanians rose against Nikephoros until he broke with the Serbs and recalled her. Before she returned he fell fighting at the Achelous in 1359. She ended her life as a nun in Constantinople.

玛丽亚·坎塔库泽努斯（约1329年生）是皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯与伊琳娜·阿森尼娜之女，可能是长女。1340年她与被废黜的伊庇鲁斯君主尼基弗鲁斯二世·奥尔西尼订婚，约1342年成婚。1351年起夫妇二人治理埃诺斯。

1356年尼基弗鲁斯乘船前往色萨利，玛丽亚留守埃诺斯，拒绝向叛乱指挥官利比达里奥斯交出城堡。后来尼基弗鲁斯受人怂恿，想抛弃她另娶塞尔维亚人，将她软禁在阿尔塔。

她在阿卡纳尼亚人和阿尔巴尼亚人的帮助下，乘兄弟曼努埃尔派来的船逃走；阿尔巴尼亚人起而反抗尼基弗鲁斯，迫使他与塞尔维亚人断绝关系并召她回来。她尚未返回，他便于1359年在阿刻罗俄斯河作战阵亡。她最终在君士坦丁堡出家为尼。

en:
Maria of Alania (1053–1118), born Martha, was daughter of the Georgian king Bagrat IV and the only foreign-born Byzantine empress of the eleventh century. She married Michael VII Doukas in 1065 and became empress in 1071. When Michael was overthrown in 1078 she married his successor, Nikephoros III Botaneiates.

She backed Alexios I Komnenos's coup of 1081, and her son, the co-emperor Constantine Doukas, was betrothed to Alexios's daughter Anna. After Constantine lost his place as heir in 1087, Maria was forced into a monastery. Constantine died in 1096 and Maria in 1118.

阿兰的玛丽亚（1053—1118）原名玛尔塔，是格鲁吉亚国王巴格拉特四世之女，也是11世纪唯一一位外国出身的拜占庭皇后。她于1065年嫁给米哈伊尔七世·杜卡斯，1071年成为皇后。1078年米哈伊尔被废后，她改嫁继位者尼基弗鲁斯三世·沃塔尼亚蒂斯。

她支持阿历克塞一世·科穆宁1081年的政变；她的儿子、共治皇帝君士坦丁·杜卡斯与阿历克塞之女安娜订婚。1087年君士坦丁失去继承人地位后，玛丽亚被迫退入修道院。君士坦丁于1096年去世，玛丽亚于1118年去世。

Matthew Asen Kantakouzenos (c. 1325–June 1383) was the son of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos and Irene Asanina. In 1347 his father gave him a Thracian appanage for his support against John V, and in 1353 he was proclaimed co-emperor as civil war broke out again.

From Thrace he warred repeatedly on the Serbs, but in late 1356 or early 1357 he was defeated and captured by Vojihna; John V ransomed him, held him on Tenedos and Lesbos, and forced him to renounce the throne. In 1361 he retired to the Morea, ruling it briefly as despot after his brother Manuel's death in 1380.

马修·阿森·坎塔库泽努斯（约1325—1383年6月）是皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯与伊琳娜·阿森尼娜之子。1347年，因在内战中支持父亲对抗约翰五世，他受封色雷斯为领地；1353年内战再度爆发，他被拥立为共治皇帝。

他从色雷斯屡次进攻塞尔维亚人，却在1356年底或1357年初被沃伊赫纳击败俘获；约翰五世出钱把他赎走，先后囚禁于忒涅多斯岛和莱斯沃斯岛，逼迫他放弃帝号。1361年他退居摩里亚，1380年其弟曼努埃尔去世后，以专制公身份短暂统治摩里亚。

Matthew Blastares (c. 1290–c. 1360) was a Byzantine Greek hieromonk and canonist active in Thessalonica. A scholar of the Monastery of Kyr Isaac, he opposed any doctrinal reconciliation with Rome.

In 1335 he compiled his best-known work, the Syntagma kata stoicheion, an alphabetically ordered collection of church canons and imperial laws that circulated widely across the Orthodox world. He died in Thessalonica after 1346.

1335年，他编成最负盛名的著作《按字母排列的教会法汇编》，按字母顺序汇辑教会法规与帝国法律，在整个东正教世界广泛流传。他于1346年后在塞萨洛尼基去世。

en:
Maurice (539–602), born at Arabissus in Cappadocia, was Eastern Roman emperor from 582 and the last ruler of the Justinian dynasty. A successful general under Tiberius II, who made him his heir, he brought the long war with Sasanian Persia to a victorious close. By 599 he had driven the Avars back across the Danube.

He founded the Exarchates of Italy in 584 and Africa in 591. His unpopular financial measures alienated soldiers and civilians, and in 602 a mutiny led by Phocas overthrew him; Maurice and his six sons were executed. The military manual Strategikon is attributed to him.

莫里斯（539—602）生于卡帕多西亚的阿拉比苏斯，582年登基为东罗马皇帝，是查士丁尼王朝末代君主。他本是提比略二世麾下名将，被后者选为继承人；即位后赢得了与萨珊波斯的长期战争。到599年，他将阿瓦尔人逐回多瑙河以北。

他于584年和591年先后设立意大利总督区与阿非利加总督区。他为解决财政困难采取的措施不得人心，使军民离心，602年福卡斯率众哗变推翻了他，莫里斯与六个儿子一同被处死。兵书《战略论》相传出自他之手。

Maximinus Thrax (c. 173–238) was a Thracian-born Roman commander under Severus Alexander. After the army murdered Alexander in 235, the Pannonian legions made Maximinus emperor, the first non-senatorial, non-equestrian emperor; his accession opens the Crisis of the Third Century.

He defeated the Alemanni across the Rhine and raised his son Maximus to Caesar. In 238 the African revolt and the senatorial emperors turned Rome against him; his siege of Aquileia stalled, and his own soldiers killed him with his son Maximus.

马克西米努斯·色雷克斯（约173—238）是色雷斯出身的罗马军人，在亚历山大·塞维鲁麾下任指挥官。235年军队杀害亚历山大后，潘诺尼亚军团拥立马克西米努斯为帝，使他成为第一位非元老院、非骑士阶层出身的皇帝；他的登基标志着三世纪危机的开始。

他在莱茵河彼岸击败阿勒曼尼人，立儿子马克西姆斯为凯撒。238年阿非利加与罗马相继起事，元老院与他为敌；他围攻阿奎莱亚不下，被自己的士兵所杀，其子马克西姆斯同时遇害。

Michael Doukas Glabas Tarchaneiotes (c. 1235–1308) was a leading Byzantine general under Michael VIII and Andronikos II. In 1263 he defeated the Bulgarians in Thrace, and in 1279 he captured the Bulgarian capital of Tarnovo. He later recovered Dyrrhachion in Albania from the Angevins.

Unable to overcome Serbian guerrilla tactics, he advised peace, leading to the 1299 treaty sealed by Simonida's marriage to Stefan Uroš II. In 1304 he retook Mesembria from the Bulgarians but fell ill and returned to Constantinople. He restored the Pammakaristos Church, where he was buried.

米哈伊尔·杜卡斯·格拉瓦斯·塔恰尼奥提斯（约1235—1308）是米哈伊尔八世与安德洛尼卡二世两朝的拜占庭名将。1263年他在色雷斯击败保加利亚人，1279年攻占保加利亚首都特尔诺沃。他还从安茹家族手中收复阿尔巴尼亚的都拉佐。

他对塞尔维亚作战时受游击战术所阻，建议议和，促成1299年的和约，以西莫妮达嫁给斯特凡·乌罗什二世联姻修好。1304年他从保加利亚手中收复墨森布里亚，但患病返回君士坦丁堡。他重修了帕玛卡里斯托斯教堂，身后即葬于该处。

Michael I Rangabe (c. 770–844) was Byzantine emperor from 811 to 813. A courtier married to Prokopia, daughter of Nikephoros I, he took the throne in 811 when officials forced Staurakios to abdicate. He dropped Nikephoros's harsh taxes and gave generously to the army and church.

He leaned on the iconodule clergy, and in 812 recognised Charlemagne as emperor in exchange for Venice. After his army fled the Battle of Versinikia in 813, Leo the Armenian seized the throne; Michael abdicated into a monastery, where he died in 844. His sons were castrated to prevent the continuation of his dynasty.

米海尔一世·兰加贝（约770—844）于811至813年担任拜占庭皇帝。他本是宫廷重臣，娶尼基弗鲁斯一世之女普罗科皮娅为妻；811年重臣逼迫奄奄一息的斯陶拉基奥斯退位，米海尔登基。他废除尼基弗鲁斯的苛税，向军队和教会慷慨分发钱财。

他倚重圣像派教士，于812年承认查理曼的皇帝称号，换回威尼斯。813年军队在维尔西尼基亚战役溃败，亚美尼亚人利奥夺取皇位，米海尔退位进入修道院，于844年在院中去世。他的儿子遭到阉割，以阻止其王朝延续。

en:
Michael II (770–829), called the Amorian and the Stammerer, was the Amorium-born soldier who founded the Amorian dynasty and helped Leo V take power in 813. Sentenced to death for plotting in late 820, he had Leo murdered at the Christmas liturgy and was crowned that same day, still in chains. He crushed Thomas the Slav's revolt in 823–824.

Later Andalusian exiles seized Crete, and Muslim armies landed in Sicily in 827. He eased Leo's persecution of icon venerators, died in 829, and left the throne to his son Theophilos.

米海尔二世（770—829），绰号“阿摩里亚人”和“结巴者”，是生于阿莫利翁的军人，阿摩里亚王朝的开创者。他曾助利奥五世在813年夺权。820年末他因谋反被判死刑，却派人在圣诞节礼拜时刺杀利奥，自己当天戴着镣铐加冕。823—824年他镇压了托马斯的叛乱。

en:
Michael III (840–867) became Byzantine emperor at age two in 842, the last ruler of the Amorian dynasty. His mother Theodora's regency ended iconoclasm in 843. In 855 Michael and his uncle Bardas overthrew the regency, and Theodora was later sent to a monastery.

Under Bardas the Byzantines imposed baptism on Boris I of Bulgaria in 864 and sent Cyril and Methodius to Great Moravia. Michael's favourite Basil the Macedonian murdered Bardas in 866 and became co-emperor, then in 867 killed the drunken Michael in his bedchamber, founding the Macedonian dynasty.

米海尔三世（840—867）于842年两岁时即位，是阿摩里亚王朝末代皇帝。他的母亲狄奥多拉摄政，于843年终结了圣像破坏运动。855年，米海尔与舅父巴尔达斯推翻摄政政府，狄奥多拉后来被送入修道院。

在巴尔达斯主持下，拜占庭于864年迫使保加利亚的鲍里斯一世受洗，并派遣西里尔与美多德前往大摩拉维亚。米海尔的宠臣马其顿人巴西尔于866年杀害巴尔达斯、成为共治皇帝，又于867年趁米海尔醉酒在寝宫将他刺杀，建立马其顿王朝。

en:
Michael IV the Paphlagonian (c. 1010–1041) was a peasant's son from Paphlagonia who worked as a money changer in Constantinople before his brother John placed him at court. He became Zoë's lover, and in 1034 her husband Romanos III was found dying in his bath; Michael married Zoë that day and was crowned emperor the next.

Plagued by epilepsy, he left government to John, whose heavy taxes stirred revolts. In 1041 he took the field against Bulgarian rebels and returned victorious, only to die later that year.

en:
Michael IX Palaiologos (1277–1320), eldest son of Andronikos II, was crowned his father's co-emperor in 1294. That year he married Rita of Armenia, who bore him Andronikos III and Manuel. A brave soldier who spent his own money to encourage his troops, he nevertheless suffered repeated defeats.

He failed to stem the Turkish advance in Asia Minor in 1302, lost Skafida to the Bulgarians in 1304 and was routed by the Catalans at Apros in 1305. He died in 1320, aged 43, grieving for his son Manuel, accidentally killed by retainers of Andronikos III.

Michael Kantakouzenos (c. 1264–1316) was a Byzantine governor and the father of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos. In 1308 Andronikos II ended the yearly rotation of governors in the Morea and appointed Michael as the province's first long-term steward.

During his eight years in office he curbed corruption and stabilized the province's finances, enabling his successor to launch wars of conquest. He died in 1316, and his son John took the throne in 1347.

Michael Komnenos Tornikes Palaiologos Asanes, also called Michael Asen, was a fourteenth-century Byzantine aristocrat and administrator, the only known son of Constantine Palaiologos Asen and grandson of Bulgarian Tsar Ivan Asen III. He married Irene Komnene Kantakouzene Palaiologina Asenina; the couple appears in a miniature in the 1330 typikon of the Theotokos Bebaia Elpis convent in Constantinople.

Arrested with his father by Alexios Apokaukos in 1342, he later served as governor of Lesbos, probably around 1347. Nikephoros Gregoras composed an elegy on his death.

Michael Palaiologos Doukas (died 1156) was a Byzantine general, likely the son of Nikephoros Palaiologos and grandson of George Palaiologos. Exiled by his cousin Emperor John II, he was recalled on the accession of Manuel I in 1143, and by 1147 was sebastos, when he supplied the Second Crusade near Sardica and welcomed Louis VII of France.

In 1155 he and John Doukas led the Italian expedition that seized Bari, Trani and Andria from the Normans and negotiated with Genoa. He fell ill at Bari, was tonsured as the monk Moses, and died there in spring 1156.

Michael Palaiologos (born 1337) was the second son of Emperor Andronikos III Palaiologos and a younger brother of John V. Born a porphyrogennetos while his father reigned, he was raised to the rank of Despot before Andronikos III died in 1341.

In 1351 or 1352, while John V fought Matthew Kantakouzenos for the throne and sought Serbian help, Michael was sent to the Serbian court as a hostage. Nothing further is recorded of him.

Michael V Kalaphates (c. 1015–1042), nicknamed for his father's trade as a caulker, was the nephew of Michael IV, adopted as son and heir by Empress Zoë and made caesar in 1035. He succeeded Michael IV in 1041 but soon banished his uncle John.

In 1042 he exiled Zoë to Principo. Constantinople rose in revolt; Zoë's sister Theodora was proclaimed empress and Michael fled to the Stoudion monastery. Dragged from sanctuary, he was blinded and confined to a monastery, where he died the same year after a four-month reign.

Michael VI Bringas (died c. 1057), called Stratiotikos and the Old, was an elderly former military finance minister whom the dying Empress Theodora's advisors chose as her successor in 1056. He foiled one palace plot but enraged the army by restoring a general's rank without returning his estates.

In 1057 generals proclaimed Isaac Komnenos emperor, and Isaac routed his army at Petroe. Michael offered to adopt Isaac and make him caesar, but was rejected. Riots swept Constantinople, and the patriarch persuaded Michael to abdicate; he became a monk and died soon after.

Michael VII Doukas (c. 1050–c. 1090), nicknamed Parapinakes (minus a quarter) after the coinage devaluation of his reign, was the eldest son of Constantine X Doukas and senior Byzantine emperor from 1071 to 1078.

He left government to his minister Nikephoritzes while the empire lost Bari to Robert Guiscard, faced a Bulgarian revolt, and gave way across Asia Minor after Manzikert. Married to Maria of Alania, he was forced to abdicate in 1078 by Nikephoros Botaneiates, retiring to the Stoudios monastery and later becoming metropolitan of Ephesus.

米海尔七世·杜卡斯（约1050—约1090）是君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯的长子，1071—1078年为拜占庭正位皇帝，因任内货币贬值得到绰号‘帕拉皮纳基斯’（意为少四分之一）。

他将政事交给大臣尼基弗里齐斯；帝国被罗贝尔·吉斯卡尔夺去巴里，又遭遇保加利亚人叛乱，曼齐科特战役后在小亚细亚节节败退。他娶玛丽亚为后，1078年被尼基弗鲁斯·博塔尼亚特斯逼迫退位，隐入斯图狄乌斯修道院，后来出任以弗所都主教。

Michael VIII Palaiologos (1224–1282) became regent for Nicaea's boy emperor John IV Laskaris and was crowned co-emperor in 1259 after his victory at Pelagonia. In 1261 his troops seized Constantinople from the Latins; Michael entered the city, restored the Byzantine Empire and founded the Palaiologan dynasty. Later that year he had John IV blinded.

He rebuilt Constantinople and expanded the army and navy, but neglected the Anatolian frontier. Against Charles of Anjou he promoted the Union of Lyons in 1274 and supported the Sicilian Vespers of 1282, dying in Thrace later that year.

en:
Nero (37–68), born Lucius Domitius Ahenobarbus, was the last Julio-Claudian Roman emperor, ruling from 54 to 68. His mother Agrippina married Claudius, who adopted him; when Claudius died in 54, reportedly poisoned by her, Nero took the throne. Seneca and Burrus guided his early rule. In 59 he had Agrippina murdered.

He performed as actor, poet, musician and charioteer, scandalizing the aristocracy. Rome fought the Parthian War of 58–63 and crushed Boudica's revolt in Britain. After the Great Fire of Rome in 64 he built the Domus Aurea; Tacitus says he blamed and executed Christians.

The Pisonian conspiracy of 65 cost Seneca his life. In 68 Gaul and Spain revolted and the Senate declared him a public enemy. Abandoned by his guards, he killed himself on 9 June, reportedly saying ‘What an artist the world is losing.’ Civil war followed in the Year of the Four Emperors.

尼禄（37—68年），原名卢基乌斯·多米提乌斯·阿赫诺巴尔布斯，是儒略-克劳狄王朝最后一位罗马皇帝，54年至68年在位。母亲阿格里皮娜嫁给克劳狄，克劳狄收养了他；54年克劳狄去世，相传即被阿格里皮娜毒杀，尼禄登基。塞内卡和布鲁斯辅佐他早年治国。59年，他下令杀害阿格里皮娜。

他登台当演员、诗人、乐师和战车手，令贵族震惊。他在位时罗马于58至63年与帕提亚交战，并镇压了布狄卡起义。64年罗马大火后，他修建金宫；塔西佗称他归罪并处死基督徒。

65年皮索阴谋令塞内卡身死。68年高卢和西班牙起兵，元老院宣布他为公敌。禁卫军弃他而去，他于6月9日自杀，据传喃喃说道：“世间将失去一位多么了不起的艺术家。”随后爆发内战，进入“四帝之年”。

en:
Nerva (30–98), born Marcus Cocceius Nerva at Narni, north of Rome, was Roman emperor from 96 to 98 and the first of the Five Good Emperors. He skipped the usual careers and was a courtier. Exposing the Pisonian conspiracy against Nero in 65 earned triumphal honours. He backed the Flavians and held the consulship in 71 and 90.

After Domitian's murder in 96, the Senate made Nerva emperor with promises to restore liberties. His reign was troubled: strained finances, weak army authority. In October 97 the Praetorian Guard revolted and forced him to adopt an heir; he chose Trajan.

On 1 January 98 he suffered a stroke and died 27 January. The Senate deified him; he was the last emperor laid in the Mausoleum of Augustus. Tacitus wrote that he blended sovereignty and freedom. Trajan succeeded him, and the adoptive line ran through the Five Good Emperors to 180.

涅尔瓦（30—98），本名马库斯·科凯乌斯·涅尔瓦，生于罗马以北的纳尔尼，96—98年任罗马皇帝，是“五贤帝”之首。他没有走通常的仕途，而是宫廷侍臣。65年他因揭发反对尼禄的皮索阴谋获得凯旋荣誉。他支持弗拉维王朝，曾于71年和90年两度出任执政官。

96年图密善被杀后，元老院宣布涅尔瓦为皇帝，他许诺恢复被削减的自由。他在位短暂而多难：财政紧张，对军队权威不足。97年10月禁卫军哗变，迫使他收养继承人，他选中图拉真。

98年1月1日他中风，1月27日去世。元老院追尊他为神，他是最后一位葬入奥古斯都陵墓的皇帝。塔西佗写道，他把君权与自由融为一体。图拉真继位，他开创的养子传承经五贤帝延续到180年。

en:
Nikephoros Gregoras (c. 1295–c. 1360), born at Heraclea Pontica, was a Byzantine astronomer, theologian and historian. His uncle took him to Constantinople, where Andronikos II made him chartophylax. In 1326 he wrote a treatise proposing calendar reform; the emperor shelved it for fear of unrest, and Gregory XIII adopted almost the same reform more than two centuries later.

He fell with Andronikos II in 1328, but a public contest with Barlaam, whom he bested, drew many pupils, and he predicted the total solar eclipse of 16 July 1330 exactly.

From 1346 he opposed Gregory Palamas in the Hesychast dispute; the synod of 1351 declared his views heretical, he refused to recant and was confined at the Chora Monastery until 1354. Two of the 37 books of his Roman History argue against Palamas.

尼基弗鲁斯·格雷戈拉斯（约1295—约1360）出生于本都的赫拉克利亚，是拜占庭的天文学家、神学家和史家。叔父带他到君士坦丁堡，安德洛尼卡二世任命他为掌卷官。1326年他写成历法改革论文，皇帝怕引起骚乱而搁置，两百多年后格里高利十三世几乎照同样思路推行改历。

1328年安德洛尼卡二世被废，他也随之失势；但他在公开论战中击败巴拉姆，由此门生云集，并精确预测了1330年7月16日的日全食。

1346年起，他在静修派之争中反对格列高利·帕拉马斯；1351年主教会议宣布他的观点为异端，他拒绝悔改，被关在科拉修道院直至1354年。他所著三十七卷《罗马史》中有两卷反驳帕拉马斯。

Nikephoros I (c. 750–811) was Byzantine emperor from 802 to 811. As finance minister under Empress Irene, he deposed her in 802 and seized the throne. He reorganised imperial finances and military settlement, moving soldiers and peasants from Asia Minor to the Balkans, and crowned his son Staurakios co-emperor in 803.

His strict financial discipline brought him hostility among his subjects. He clashed with Charlemagne over Venice and with the Abbasid caliph Harun al-Rashid, and was killed in 811 while invading Bulgaria, in the disaster of the Battle of Pliska.

尼基弗鲁斯一世（约750—811）于802至811年担任拜占庭皇帝。他本是伊琳娜女皇手下的财政大臣，802年废黜女皇、夺取皇位。他整顿财政与军事屯垦，将士兵和农民从小亚细亚迁往巴尔干，并于803年给儿子斯陶拉基奥斯加冕为共治皇帝。

他严厉的财政纪律招致臣民的敌意。他围绕威尼斯与查理曼相争，又与阿拔斯哈里发哈伦·拉希德交战，811年率军入侵保加利亚，在普利斯卡战役的惨败中阵亡。

en:
Nikephoros II Phokas (c. 912–969) was a Cappadocian general whose troops stormed Chandax in 961 after a nine-month siege and reconquered Crete from the Muslims. With John Tzimiskes he sacked Aleppo in 962 and broke Hamdanid power. After Romanos II died in 963, he seized the throne and married Theophano.

He completed the conquest of Cilicia, took Tarsus in 965, recovered Cyprus, and in 969 took Antioch, earning him the name Pale Death of the Saracens. That year Theophano admitted Tzimiskes to his chamber and the conspirators killed him.

尼基弗鲁斯二世·福卡斯（约912—969）是卡帕多细亚的将领。961年他的军队围城九个月后攻占汉达克斯，从穆斯林手中收复克里特岛。962年他与约翰·齐米斯西斯联手洗劫阿勒颇，重创哈姆丹王朝。963年罗曼努斯二世死后，他夺取皇位，娶皇后塞奥法诺为妻。

他完成对奇里乞亚的征服，965年攻取塔尔苏斯，收复塞浦路斯，969年攻占安条克，因而得到“萨拉森人的苍白死神”之名。同年塞奥法诺把齐米斯西斯放进他的寝宫，密谋者将他杀害。

en:
Nikephoros III Botaneiates (1002–1081) was a general from a military family of the Anatolic Theme. He fought in the Pecheneg revolt of 1048–1053 and helped Isaac I Komnenos overthrow Michael VI at Petroe in 1057.

In 1078 he rose against Michael VII and entered Constantinople with the backing of the Senate and people. As emperor he crushed revolts by Bryennios, Basilakes and Constantine Doukas.

He also forgave debts in arrears and gave lavishly to the army and his supporters. In 1081 Alexios I Komnenos seized the capital; Nikephoros abdicated, took the monastic habit and died the same year.

尼基弗鲁斯三世·沃塔尼亚蒂斯（1002—1081）出身安纳托利亚军区的武将世家。他参加1048至1053年平定佩切涅格人叛乱的战争，1057年在彼得罗助伊萨克一世·科穆宁推翻米哈伊尔六世。

1078年，他起兵反对米哈伊尔七世，在元老院与君士坦丁堡民众支持下入主京城。在位期间他平定了布里尼奥斯、瓦西拉基斯和君士坦丁·杜卡斯的叛乱。

他还免除积欠的债务，向军队和支持者大加赏赐。1081年，阿历克塞一世·科穆宁攻占首都，尼基弗鲁斯退位出家，同年去世。

en:
Nikephoros Kallistos Xanthopoulos (c. 1256–1335) was a Byzantine priest of Hagia Sophia and ecclesiastical historian born in Constantinople. Granted access to the patriarchal library, he began his twenty-three-book Church History around 1310 and completed it after 1317, dedicating it to Andronikos II Palaiologos.

The surviving eighteen books run from Christ to the death of Emperor Phokas in 610, drawing on Eusebios and earlier historians. He also taught rhetoric and wrote saints' lives, synaxaria and religious poems.

尼基福罗斯·卡利斯托斯·克桑索普洛斯（约1256—1335）是出生于君士坦丁堡的拜占庭圣索菲亚大教堂神父、教会史家。他获准使用牧首图书馆，约于1310年开始撰写二十三卷本《教会史》，1317年后完成，并题献给安德洛尼卡二世·巴列奥略。

传世的十八卷从基督时代记述到610年皇帝福卡斯之死，取材于优西比乌等前辈史家。他还教授修辞学，并撰写圣徒传、圣徒历和宗教诗歌。

en:
Nikephoros Kantakouzenos (c. 1300–after 1355) was a Byzantine aristocrat and governor, a cousin of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos. In 1341, at the start of the civil war, Alexios Apokaukos had him imprisoned in Constantinople with other members of the family; he was freed only when John VI entered the city in March 1347.

By 1351 he held the rank of sebastokrator and governed Adrianople, defending its citadel with Matthew Kantakouzenos against John V in 1352. After John VI's fall in December 1354 he kept Adrianople for Matthew. His daughter Theodora married Alexios III of Trebizond in 1351.

尼基弗鲁斯·坎塔库泽努斯（约1300—1355年后）是拜占庭贵族、地方长官，皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯的表亲。1341年内战爆发时，阿历克塞·阿波考寇斯下令把他与坎塔库泽努斯家族其他成员一同囚禁在君士坦丁堡；直到1347年3月约翰六世入城，他才获释。

至迟1351年，他已受封至尊者并出任阿德里安堡长官，1352年与马修·坎塔库泽努斯共同守卫该城要塞，抵御约翰五世。1354年12月约翰六世倒台后，他为马修保住阿德里安堡。其女狄奥多拉于1351年嫁给特拉比松皇帝阿历克塞三世。

en:
Orbán, also called Urban (died 1453), was an iron founder and engineer from Brassó in Transylvania. In 1452 he offered his services to Emperor Constantine XI, who could neither pay him nor supply metal for a giant gun, so Orbán turned to Sultan Mehmed II.

He claimed his weapon could destroy even the walls of Babylon, and the sultan supplied funds and materials. At Adrianople he cast the colossal Basilic bombard in three months; sixty oxen dragged it to the 1453 siege of Constantinople, where his guns battered the Theodosian Walls. He is said to have been killed that year when one of his own cannons burst.

乌尔班（1453年卒）是特兰西瓦尼亚地区布拉索夫的铸铁师兼工程师。1452年他投奔拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁十一世，但皇帝既付不起薪俸，也凑不齐铸造巨型攻城炮所需的金属，乌尔班便转投苏丹穆罕默德二世。

他声称自己的火炮甚至能够摧毁巴比伦城墙，苏丹于是提供资金和物料。在阿德里安堡，他用三个月铸成巨型“巴塞利卡”臼炮，由六十头公牛拖到1453年的君士坦丁堡围城战场，他的炮群猛轰狄奥多西城墙。相传同年他因自己铸造的一门大炮炸膛而丧命。

en:
Marcus Salvius Otho (32–69) was the second of the four emperors of the year 69 and ruled for only ninety-one days. Suetonius describes the young Nero's courtier as plucking his body hair and wearing a careful wig. After Nero took his wife Poppaea Sabina, he was sent in 58 to govern remote Lusitania, where he ruled capably but never forgave Nero.

In 68 he joined Galba's revolt and followed him to Rome. When Galba adopted Piso Licinianus as heir, the praetorians killed him on 15 January 69 and proclaimed Otho emperor.

The German legions had already hailed Vitellius, and Otho's army was beaten at Bedriacum on 14 April with some 40,000 casualties. His men wanted to fight on, but he chose to end the war, saying it was more just that one die for all than many for one, and stabbed himself to death. Vitellius took the empire.

马库斯·萨尔维乌斯·奥托（32—69）是69年四帝之年的第二位皇帝，在位仅九十一天。他年轻时是尼禄的近臣，苏埃托尼乌斯称他讲究仪容，拔去体毛、戴精致假发。尼禄夺走他的妻子波培娅·萨宾娜后，奥托于58年被派去治理偏远的卢西塔尼亚；他治理有方，却始终不原谅尼禄。

68年，他加入加尔巴反尼禄的叛乱并随其进入罗马。加尔巴收皮索·李锡尼亚努斯为养子并立为继承人后，禁卫军于69年1月15日杀死加尔巴，拥立奥托为帝。

日耳曼军团此前已拥立维特里乌斯，4月14日奥托的军队在贝德里亚库姆战败，约40,000人伤亡。士兵们想再战，他却决定结束战争，说一人为众人而死比众人为一人而死更公正，随后自刎。帝位归于维特里乌斯。

日耳曼军团此前已拥立#TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,[GetCharacter('byz_vitellius').GetID],X #L 维特里乌斯#!#!，4月14日奥托的军队在贝德里亚库姆战败，约40,000人伤亡。士兵们想再战，他却决定结束战争，说一人为众人而死比众人为一人而死更公正，随后自刎。帝位归于维特里乌斯。

en:
Publius Helvius Pertinax (126–193) was a freedman's son from Alba Pompeia who rose through the army. He won fame in the Parthian War of 161–166 and later governed Syria and Britain, where his strictness provoked a mutiny; he resigned in 187 and later became prefect of Rome.

After Commodus's murder on the last day of 192, Pertinax became emperor, the first of the Year of the Five Emperors. He tried to restore discipline and coinage, but his economies enraged the Praetorian Guard.

After 87 days the guard stormed the palace and killed him on 28 March 193. Septimius Severus later deified him.

普布利乌斯·赫尔维乌斯·佩蒂纳克斯（126—193）是阿尔巴·蓬佩亚一名获释奴之子，行伍出身。他在161至166年的帕提亚战争中崭露头角，后来出任叙利亚和不列颠总督；在不列颠，他严整军纪引发兵变，于187年辞职，后来成为罗马城监。

192年最后一天康茂德遇刺后，佩蒂纳克斯登基，成为“五帝之年”的首位皇帝。他试图整顿军纪、改良币制，但紧缩开支激怒了禁卫军。

在位仅87天，禁卫军便在193年3月28日冲入皇宫将他杀死。塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁后来追尊他为神。

en:
Philip the Arab (c. 204–249), born at Philippopolis, rose to be praetorian prefect under emperor Gordian III. After Gordian died following the Battle of Misiche in 244, Philip was proclaimed emperor and made peace with Shapur I.

He rebuilt his home town as Philippopolis, but building costs and the tribute to Persia strained his finances and forced tax rises. His five-year reign brought rare stability amid the third-century crisis: in 246 he drove back the Carpi on the Danube, and in 248 he celebrated Rome's thousandth anniversary with the Secular Games. Rebellions then brought Decius into Italy, and Philip was defeated and killed at Verona in September 249.

阿拉伯人菲利普（约204—249）生于菲利普波利斯，在皇帝戈尔迪安三世麾下升任近卫军长官。244年戈尔迪安三世在米西切战役后死去，菲利普被拥立为帝，与沙普尔一世议和。

他将故乡重建为菲利普波利斯，但营建费用与对波斯的贡金令财政吃紧，被迫加税。他在位五年，是三世纪危机中少有的安定时期：246年他在多瑙河击退卡尔皮人，248年又举办百年祭典，庆祝罗马建城千年。随后各地叛乱使德西乌斯进军意大利，249年9月菲利普在维罗纳战败被杀。

en:
Philippicus, born Bardanes in Constantinople, was twice exiled, by Tiberius III and by Justinian II. His first exile followed a dream of an eagle shading his head, taken as a sign of imperial ambition. At Cherson he won the Khazars, and in 711 the city and fleet proclaimed him emperor.

After he took Constantinople, Justinian II and his young son Tiberius were killed. He deposed Patriarch Cyrus, imposed monothelitism and annulled the Sixth Ecumenical Council, which Rome rejected. On 3 June 713 Opsician rebels blinded him in the hippodrome, and he died later that year.

菲利皮科斯本名巴尔达内斯，生于君士坦丁堡，曾先后被提比略三世和查士丁尼二世流放。他第一次被流放前梦见一只鹰在头顶投下阴影，这被视为他觊觎帝位的征兆。在流放地赫尔松，他得到可萨人支持，711年赫尔松城与舰队拥立他为帝。

他攻占君士坦丁堡后，查士丁尼二世及其幼子提比略被杀。他废黜牧首居鲁士，强制推行基督一志论，废除第六次大公会议的决议，罗马方面不予承认。713年6月3日，奥普西金军区的叛军在赛马场将他刺瞎，他于同年死去。

en:
Phocas (547–610), a centurion in the Thracian army, led the mutinous troops during the Danube campaign of 602 that overthrew the emperor Maurice, after Maurice ordered the army to campaign north of the river through the winter. Crowned on 23 November 602, he executed Maurice and his sons and tried to rule through his relatives, meeting every challenge with purges that widened revolt.

While the Sasanians under Khusrow II overran the eastern provinces, the African exarch Heraclius the Elder rose against him. Heraclius the Younger took Constantinople on 5 October 610 and beheaded Phocas the same day.

en:
Probus (232–282), a Pannonian soldier, rose to high command under Aurelian; Tacitus made him commander in the East. The eastern army made him emperor in 276 after Tacitus' death; his rival Florian perished at Tarsus and the Senate confirmed him.

In 277–278 he cleared Gaul of Alemanni and Franks, crossed the Rhine, rebuilt Hadrian's Rhine–Danube forts and defeated Goths and Vandals. He settled people taken from the defeated Germans in depopulated provinces and strengthened the frontier.

In 280–281 he crushed three usurpers and triumphed at Rome. In 282, preparing a Persian war at Sirmium, he was killed in a mutiny that brought Carus to power.

普罗布斯（232—282）是潘诺尼亚军人，在奥勒良麾下升至高位，被塔西佗任命统领东方。塔西佗死后的276年，他被东方军队拥立为帝，竞争者弗洛里安努斯在塔尔苏斯败亡，元老院予以承认。

277至278年，他肃清高卢的阿勒曼尼人和法兰克人，渡过莱茵河，修复哈德良时期连接莱茵河与多瑙河的防线，并击败哥特人和汪达尔人。他将战败日耳曼人提供的人口安置在人烟稀少的行省，加强边防。

280至281年，他平定三个僭帝，在罗马举行凯旋式。282年，他在西尔米乌姆筹备波斯战争时死于兵变，卡鲁斯随之掌权。

en:
Pupienus (c. 164–238) was a Roman general and senator, a victorious commander against the Sarmatians and German tribes who twice held the consulship and served as urban prefect of Rome, known for his severity. He joined the Senate committee coordinating resistance to Maximinus Thrax.

When the Gordians died in Africa, the Senate made Pupienus and Balbinus joint emperors in April 238. Pupienus took charge at Ravenna, and Maximinus was murdered by his own troops outside Aquileia.

Back in Rome, the two emperors quarrelled. In July or August 238 disaffected Praetorians killed both in the guard barracks, after ninety-nine days' reign.

普皮恩努斯（约164—238）是罗马将领与元老，曾战胜萨尔马提亚人和日耳曼诸部，两度任执政官，并出任罗马城市长官，以严厉著称。他加入元老院协调对马克西米努斯作战的委员会。

戈尔迪安一世与戈尔迪安二世在阿非利加败亡后，元老院于238年4月推举普皮恩努斯与巴尔比努斯共同称帝。普皮恩努斯坐镇拉文纳指挥战事，马克西米努斯最终在阿奎莱亚城外被自己的士兵所杀。

回到罗马后，两位皇帝反目。238年7月或8月，心怀不满的禁卫军在军营中将二人拘捕处死，他们共在位九十九天。

Rita (10/11 January 1278 – July 1333) was a daughter of King Leo II of Armenian Cilicia and Queen Keran. In January 1294 she married the Byzantine co-emperor Michael IX Palaiologos and took the name Maria, serving as junior empress until 1317.

In 1320 her son Manuel was slain by mistake at the orders of his brother Andronikos, and Michael IX died soon after. Widowed, Rita retired to a convent as the nun Xene and died there in July 1333.

en:
Romanos I Lekapenos (c. 870–948) was the son of an Armenian peasant who rose from fleet commander to be Constantine VII's regent and co-emperor. In 919 he married his daughter Helena to Constantine, taking the title basileopator, and was crowned co-emperor in 920.

In 927 granddaughter Maria married Peter I of Bulgaria, sealing a peace. After heir Christopher died in 931, he kept Constantine above his sons.

In 944 sons Stephen and Constantine deposed and confined him to a monastery. When they threatened Constantine VII, Constantinople revolted and the brothers were exiled to their father, who died in 948.

Romanos I Lekapenos (c. 870–948) was the son of an Armenian peasant who rose from fleet commander to be Constantine VII's regent and co-emperor. In 919 he married his daughter Helena to Constantine, taking the title basileopator, and was crowned co-emperor in 920.

In 927 granddaughter Maria married Peter I of [GetCountry('BUL').GetName], sealing a peace. After heir Christopher died in 931, he kept Constantine above his sons.

927年，孙女玛丽亚与保加利亚皇帝彼得一世成婚，缔结和平。931年继承人克里斯托弗死后，他仍让君士坦丁的位次高于诸子。

944年，儿子斯蒂芬和君士坦丁将他废黜，把他关进修道院。两人威胁君士坦丁七世的地位时，君士坦丁堡起事，兄弟二人被流放到父亲身边；罗曼努斯于948年去世。

en:
Romanos II (938–963) became Byzantine emperor in 959, succeeding his father Constantine VII. He married Theophano in 956 after his first bride Bertha of Italy died young, and after his accession sent his mother from court and forced his sisters into convents.

He left government to eunuch Joseph Bringas and warfare to the Phokas brothers: Nikephoros reconquered Crete in 960–961 after the nine-month siege of Chandax, then seized Cilicia and sacked Aleppo in 962.

His reliance on his wife and officials angered the military nobility. He died suddenly after a hunt in March 963, leaving young sons Basil II and Constantine VIII.

罗曼努斯二世（938—963）于959年继承父皇君士坦丁七世，成为拜占庭皇帝。第一任妻子意大利的贝尔塔早逝后，他在956年迎娶赛奥法诺；即位后他遣母亲离开宫廷，迫使姐妹们进入修道院。

他把政务交给宦官约瑟夫·布林加斯，军事托付福卡斯兄弟：尼基弗鲁斯经九个月的坎达克斯围城战，于960—961年收复克里特岛，又在962年夺取奇里乞亚、洗劫阿勒颇。

他倚重妻子和官僚，激怒了军事贵族。963年3月，他在一次狩猎后暴毙，留下年幼的儿子巴西尔二世与君士坦丁八世。

en:
Romanos III Argyros (968–1034) was a senior judge and urban prefect of Constantinople when the dying Constantine VIII made him divorce his wife and marry his daughter Zoë in November 1028; three days later he was emperor. He aspired to be a philosopher king like Marcus Aurelius and a commander like Trajan.

He cut the aristocracy's taxes and spent heavily on churches. In 1030 he led a disastrous campaign against Aleppo, routed at Azaz.

Estranged from Zoë and her lover Michael, Romanos died in his bath on 11 April 1034, widely thought murdered at her order. Michael IV succeeded him.

他削减贵族赋税，斥巨资修建教堂。1030年他亲征阿勒颇，在阿扎兹惨败。

他与佐伊及其情夫米海尔失和。1034年4月11日，罗曼努斯死在浴室中，时人多认为他是奉佐伊之命遇害，米海尔四世随后即位。

en:
Romanos IV Diogenes (c. 1030–1072), son of the general Constantine Diogenes, was a Cappadocian commander. In 1068 he was crowned Byzantine emperor after marrying the dowager empress Eudokia Makrembolitissa.

Determined to halt the army's decline and Turkish incursions, he campaigned against the Seljuk Turks amid rivalry with the Doukas family. In 1071 Alp Arslan defeated his army at Manzikert and took him prisoner, a blow that weakened Byzantine authority in Anatolia. The Doukai proclaimed Michael VII emperor; defeated in Cilicia and promised his life, Romanos was blinded, exiled to Prote, and died in 1072.

罗曼努斯四世·第欧根尼（约1030—1072）是将领君士坦丁·第欧根尼之子，出身卡帕多西亚军事贵族。1068年，他与守寡的女皇欧多西亚·玛克勒姆玻利提萨成婚并加冕为拜占庭皇帝。

他决心遏止军队衰败和突厥人入侵，在与杜卡斯家族的争斗中出征抗击塞尔柱突厥人。1071年，他的军队在曼齐刻尔特被阿尔普·阿尔斯兰击败，他本人被俘；此役削弱了拜占庭在小亚细亚的统治。杜卡斯家族拥立米哈伊尔七世；他在奇里乞亚兵败，虽获免死承诺，仍被刺瞎、放逐到普罗特岛，于1072年去世。

en:
Lucius Septimius Severus (145–211) was Roman emperor from 193 to 211 and the first emperor from a non-Italian provincial family. Born at Leptis Magna in Africa, he entered the Senate under Marcus Aurelius and in 187 married the Syrian Julia Domna, who bore him Caracalla and Geta.

In the Year of the Five Emperors of 193 he was the last to seize power: he deposed Didius Julianus, beat Pescennius Niger at Issus in 194, and in 197 defeated Clodius Albinus at Lugdunum. He then marched against Parthia, sacked Ctesiphon and pushed the frontier to the Tigris.

In 208 he went to Britain, strengthened Hadrian's Wall and in 209 invaded Caledonia, dying at Eboracum on 4 February 211; the frontier then fell back to the Wall. He is said to have told his sons to enrich the soldiers and scorn everyone else. His sons succeeded him, founding the Severan dynasty.

卢基乌斯·塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁（145—211）于193至211年在位，是第一位出身非意大利裔行省家族的罗马皇帝。他生于阿非利加的大莱普提斯，在马可·奥勒留时期进入元老院，187年迎娶叙利亚人尤利亚·多姆娜，生下卡拉卡拉和盖塔。

193年五帝之年中，他是最后一个夺权者：他推翻尤利安努斯，194年在伊苏斯击败奈哲尔，197年在卢格杜努姆击败阿尔拜努斯，随后进兵安息，劫掠泰西封，把边界推到底格里斯河。

208年他前往不列颠，加固哈德良长城，209年入侵喀里多尼亚，211年2月4日死于艾伯拉肯，边界此后退回长城一线。相传他告诫儿子们要厚待士兵、无视其他所有人。两子继位，开创塞维鲁王朝。

Shishman was a younger son of Tsar Michael Shishman of Bulgaria and his Serbian wife Ana, named after his grandfather Shishman of Vidin. After his father fell at Velbazhd in 1330, his brother Ivan Stephen briefly held the Bulgarian throne before being overthrown by Ivan Alexander in 1331.

While the rest of his family fled to Serbia and Dubrovnik, Shishman took refuge with the Golden Horde for about a decade. In 1341 he appeared in Constantinople, whose regent John Kantakouzenos refused Bulgarian demands to surrender him and armed to defend him. His later fate is unknown.

en:
Staurakios (died 11 January 812) was the shortest-reigning Byzantine emperor, ruling for just sixty-eight days. The only son of Nikephoros I, he was crowned co-emperor on Christmas Day 803 and in 807 married Theophano of Athens.

He fought beside his father in the invasion of Bulgaria and survived the Battle of Pliska on 26 July 811, but with a severed spine. Carried back to Constantinople on a litter, he was proclaimed emperor, but his wounds made the succession disputed.

On 2 October his brother-in-law Michael I Rangabe deposed him. Staurakios was forced into a monastery and died there three months later.

斯陶拉基奥斯（812年1月11日卒）是在位时间最短的拜占庭皇帝，仅统治六十八天。他是尼基弗鲁斯一世的独子，803年圣诞节被加冕为共治皇帝，807年娶雅典的赛奥法诺为妻。

811年他随父出征保加利亚，在7月26日的普利斯卡战役中幸存，脊柱却被斩断。他被担架送回君士坦丁堡并拥立为帝，但重伤使继承人问题引发争议。

10月2日，他被姐夫米海尔一世·兰加贝废黜。斯陶拉基奥斯被迫进入修道院，三个月后在院中去世。

en:
Syrgiannes Palaiologos Philanthropenos (c. 1290–1334) was a Byzantine general, born to a Cuman chief and a niece of Michael VIII. In the civil war between Andronikos II and Andronikos III, he backed the grandson in 1321, helped force a partition, defected that December, and was jailed for plotting to seize the throne.

Pardoned, he governed Thessalonica from 1329, fled to Stefan Dušan of Serbia in 1334, and led Serbian troops that overran much of Macedonia. Later that year he was lured out and murdered by Sphrantzes Palaiologos.

Pardoned, he governed [GetCountry('THE').GetName] from 1329, fled to Stefan Dušan of [GetCountry('SER').GetName] in 1334, and led Serbian troops that overran much of Macedonia. Later that year he was lured out and murdered by Sphrantzes Palaiologos.

西尔吉安·巴列奥略·菲兰特罗佩诺斯（约1290—1334）是拜占庭将领，父亲为库曼人首领，母亲是米海尔八世的外甥女。安德洛尼卡二世与安德洛尼卡三世间的内战中，他于1321年支持皇孙，促成分治协议，12月即倒戈，后因阴谋篡位被监禁。

获赦后他于1329年出镇塞萨洛尼基，1334年逃往塞尔维亚的斯特凡·杜尚处，率塞军攻占马其顿大片土地。同年他被诱出，遭斯法兰策·巴列奥略刺杀。

en:
Theodora Angelina Palaiologina (born c. 1200) was a Byzantine noblewoman, the only daughter of the despot Alexios Palaiologos and Irene Angelina, herself a daughter of Emperor Alexios III Angelos. She married Andronikos Palaiologos, megas domestikos of the Empire of Nicaea.

Their four children included Michael VIII, born in 1223, who became Nicaean emperor in 1259 and recovered Constantinople in 1261 as founder of the Palaiologan dynasty, as well as John Palaiologos. Theodora thus linked the Angeloi to the last Byzantine imperial house.

狄奥多拉·安格利娜·巴列奥略（约1200年生）是拜占庭贵族女子，专制公阿历克修斯·巴列奥略与伊琳娜·安格琳娜的独女，其母是皇帝阿历克塞三世·安格洛斯之女。她嫁给尼西亚帝国大统帅安德洛尼卡·巴列奥略。

en:
Theodora Palaiologina (c. 1240–1303), or Theodora Vatatzaina, was great-niece of the Nicaean emperor John III Vatatzes, who raised her and in 1253 married her to general Michael Palaiologos. She became empress when Michael VIII recovered Constantinople in 1261.

With Patriarch Arsenios's help she foiled Michael's plan to divorce her. She arranged her daughters' marriages and sought clemency for disgraced courtiers.

Initially sympathetic to opponents of the 1274 Union of Lyons, she apparently later supported Michael's policy and was forced to recant publicly in 1283. As dowager empress she restored Constantinople's Lips monastery and died on 4 March 1303.

狄奥多拉·巴列奥略（约1240—1303），又称狄奥多拉·瓦塔泽娜，是尼西亚皇帝约翰三世·瓦塔泽斯的侄孙女。约翰三世将她抚养成人，1253年把她嫁给将领米海尔·巴列奥略。1261年米海尔八世收复君士坦丁堡，她成为皇后。

她借助牧首阿尔塞尼奥斯之力，挫败了米海尔休弃她的打算。她为女儿们安排婚事，为失宠的廷臣求情。

她起初同情反对1274年里昂公会议教会合并的人，后来似乎转而支持米海尔的政策，1283年被迫公开撤回立场。成为皇太后之后，她重修君士坦丁堡的利普斯修道院，于1303年3月4日去世。

en:
Theodora Porphyrogenita (c. 980–1056) was the last sovereign of Byzantium's Macedonian dynasty and the youngest daughter of Constantine VIII. In 1028 she refused to marry Romanos Argyros, arguing he was already married and too close a kin, and in 1031 was forced into the Petrion monastery.

The 1042 uprising against Michael V brought her out to rule jointly with her sister Zoe until Zoe married Constantine IX. When Constantine died in January 1055, the aged Theodora took sole power despite court opposition, reigning until her death on 31 August 1056, the end of the Macedonian line.

生于紫室者狄奥多拉（约980—1056）是拜占庭马其顿王朝的末代君主，君士坦丁八世的幼女。1028年她拒绝嫁给罗曼努斯·阿吉罗斯，理由是他已有妻室且血缘过近，1031年被迫进入佩特里昂修道院。

1042年反对米海尔五世的起义把她接出修道院，与姐姐佐伊共同执政，直到佐伊嫁给君士坦丁九世。1055年1月君士坦丁去世后，年迈的狄奥多拉不顾宫廷反对独自掌权，统治至1056年8月31日去世，马其顿王朝世系也随她而终。

en:
Theodora Kantakouzene (c. 1330–c. 1396) was a daughter of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos and Irene Asanina. In January 1346 she was betrothed to the Ottoman ruler Orhan Gazi to seal her father's alliance during the Byzantine civil war, and that summer she was escorted to Bithynia, where the wedding took place.

Unusually, she kept her Christian faith and worked to protect Christians under Ottoman rule. Halil Bey, often considered her son although his parentage is disputed, was executed by his half-brother Murad I after Orhan died in 1362. Theodora spent her later years in Constantinople, held at Galata by Andronikos IV in 1379–1381.

狄奥多拉·坎塔库泽努斯（约1330—约1396）是皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯与伊琳娜·阿森尼娜之女。1346年1月，为在内战中巩固父亲与奥斯曼埃米尔国的同盟，她被许配给奥斯曼统治者奥尔汗·加齐；同年夏，她被护送前往比提尼亚完婚。

她婚后仍保持基督教信仰，致力保护奥斯曼统治下的基督徒。1362年奥尔汗死后，哈利勒贝伊被异母兄穆拉德一世处死；哈利勒常被认为是狄奥多拉之子，但其母系身份存疑。狄奥多拉晚年回到君士坦丁堡，1379至1381年被安德洛尼卡四世囚禁在加拉塔。

en:
Theodora Komnene (born 15 January 1096) was a Byzantine princess, the fourth daughter of Emperor Alexios I Komnenos and Irene Doukaina. She was married first around 1111 to the nobleman Constantine Kourtikes, who died childless before 1118, and then, about 1122, to Constantine Angelos of Philadelphia.

By Angelos she had seven children. Her grandsons Isaac II and Alexios III Angelos both became emperors, making her ancestress of the Angelos dynasty. She is last attested in October 1136.

en:
Theodora Syrgiannaina (c. 1305–1347 or 1349) was a Byzantine noblewoman of the Syrgiannes family who became queen consort of Armenian Cilicia. In 1330–1332 she married Guy de Lusignan, Byzantine governor of Serres, as his second wife.

Elected king of Cilician Armenia in 1342 as Constantine II, her husband was killed in a baronial uprising in April 1344. Their daughter Isabella of Lusignan later married Manuel Kantakouzenos, Despot of the Morea. Theodora died in Constantinople in 1347 or 1349.

狄奥多拉·西尔伊安奈娜（约1305—1347或1349年）是西尔伊安诺斯家族的拜占庭贵妇，后成为奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王后。1330至1332年间，她嫁给时任塞雷总督的吕西尼昂的居伊，为其第二任妻子。

1342年居伊被拥立为奇里乞亚亚美尼亚国王，称康斯坦丁二世，1344年4月在贵族叛乱中被杀。两人的女儿吕西尼昂的伊莎贝拉后来嫁给摩里亚专制公曼努埃尔·坎塔库泽努斯。狄奥多拉于1347或1349年在君士坦丁堡去世。

en:
Theodore I Laskaris (c. 1175–1221) founded the Empire of Nicaea after the Fourth Crusade. In 1200 he married Anna, daughter of Emperor Alexios III; when the crusaders seized Constantinople in 1203 he escaped to Bithynia and organized Greek resistance there.

His position improved after Bulgaria defeated the Latins at Adrianople in 1205. He took imperial titles in 1205 and was crowned by a new patriarch at Nicaea in 1208.

In 1211 he routed a Seljuk invasion and captured Alexios III, and in 1212 made peace with the Latin emperor. He died in November 1221, succeeded by his son-in-law John III Vatatzes.

狄奥多尔一世·拉斯卡里斯（约1175—1221）在第四次十字军之后建立尼西亚帝国。1200年他娶皇帝阿莱克修斯三世之女安娜；1203年十字军攻占君士坦丁堡时，他逃到比提尼亚，在当地组织希腊人抵抗。

1205年保加利亚人在阿德里安堡击败拉丁人后，他的处境得到改善。1205年他采用皇帝头衔，1208年在尼西亚由新选出的牧首加冕。

1211年他击溃塞尔柱人的入侵并俘获阿莱克修斯三世，1212年与拉丁帝国皇帝议和。1221年11月去世，由女婿约翰三世·瓦塔泽斯继位。

en:
Theodore II Doukas Laskaris (1221/1222–1258) ruled the Empire of Nicaea from 1254. The only son of John III Vatatzes and Irene Laskarina, he married Elena Asenina, daughter of Bulgarian ruler Ivan Asen II, in 1235.

From 1241 he governed in Asia Minor during his father's Balkan campaigns. As emperor he repelled a Bulgarian invasion in 1256, forced Michael II of Epirus to cede Dyrrachium, and reformed the army around Anatolian recruits.

He died in August 1258, leaving George Mouzalon as regent for his young son John IV. Within days Mouzalon was murdered and Michael Palaiologos seized the throne.

狄奥多尔二世·杜卡斯·拉斯卡里斯（1221/1222—1258）于1254年成为尼西亚帝国皇帝。他是约翰三世·瓦塔泽斯与伊琳娜·拉斯卡丽娜的独子，1235年娶保加利亚沙皇伊凡·阿森二世之女埃列娜·阿森妮娜。

自1241年起，他在父亲远征巴尔干时留守小亚细亚。在位期间，他于1256年击退保加尔军队入侵，迫使伊庇鲁斯的米哈伊尔二世割让都拉斯，并以安纳托利亚本地新兵为兵源改革军队。

1258年8月他病逝，遗命乔治·穆扎隆辅佐幼子约翰四世。不出几天穆扎隆即遭杀害，米哈伊尔·巴列奥略夺取皇位。

en:
Theodosius I (347–395), called the Great, was Roman emperor from 379 to 395 and the last man to rule the whole Roman Empire. Born at Cauca in Hispania, after Valens fell to the Goths at Adrianople, Gratian invested him with the purple at Sirmium in 379.

He could not drive the Goths out; in 382 he settled them south of the Danube as autonomous allies. The Council of Constantinople in 381 made Nicene Christianity orthodoxy against Arianism. He defeated Magnus Maximus in 388 and Eugenius at the Frigidus in September 394.

In 390, after a riot at Thessalonica killed his general Butheric, Roman troops slaughtered thousands of its people; Ambrose of Milan made him do penance without his robes until Christmas. He died at Milan on 17 January 395, leaving the east to Arcadius and the west to Honorius; the division lasted until the West fell.

狄奥多西一世（347—395），后世称狄奥多西大帝，于379至395年在位，是最后一位统治全罗马帝国的皇帝。他生于西班牙考卡；瓦伦斯在阿德里安堡死于哥特人后，格拉提安于379年在西尔米乌姆授予他紫袍。

他无法驱逐哥特人，382年将他们安置在多瑙河以南，作为自治的同盟者。381年君士坦丁堡公会议确立尼西亚基督教为正统、阿里乌斯派为异端。388年他击败马格努斯·马克西穆斯，394年9月在弗里吉都斯河战胜尤吉尼厄斯。

390年萨洛尼卡骚乱杀死将领布特里克，罗马军队屠杀数千居民；米兰的安布罗斯要他忏悔，他至圣诞节不着皇袍。395年1月17日卒于米兰，东部传阿卡狄乌斯，西部传霍诺留，分治持续到西罗马灭亡。

en:
Theodosius II (401–450), called the Calligrapher, was the only son of Arcadius and Aelia Eudoxia. Made co-augustus in January 402 at nine months old, he became sole eastern emperor in May 408. Early government fell to Anthemius, builder of the Theodosian Walls, and from 414 to his sister Pulcheria.

In 425 he founded the University of Constantinople and made Valentinian III western emperor. The Codex Theodosianus of 438 collected imperial edicts since Constantine I.

His reign saw the Council of Ephesus in 431 and heavy tribute to Attila's Huns. He died on 28 July 450 after a riding accident.

狄奥多西二世（401—450），人称“书法家”，是阿卡狄乌斯与欧多西亚的独子。402年1月，年仅九个月的他被立为共治奥古斯都，408年5月成为东部唯一皇帝。朝政早年由主持修建狄奥多西城墙的安特米乌斯执掌，414年起由其姊普尔喀丽亚监护。

425年他创办君士坦丁堡大学，并立瓦伦提尼安三世为西部皇帝。438年颁行的《狄奥多西法典》汇集了君士坦丁一世以来的皇帝敕令。

他在位期间还经历了431年以弗所公会议，以及向阿提拉的匈人缴纳巨额贡金。450年7月28日他因坠马伤重而死。

en:
Theodosius III (died c. 754) was a tax collector at Adramyttium when the Byzantine navy and Opsician troops mutinied against Anastasius II in 715 and proclaimed the reluctant official emperor. His forces took Constantinople late that year, and he restored the Sixth Ecumenical Council's image.

The Anatolic and Armeniac themes rejected him as an Opsician puppet. He bought Bulgar aid from Khan Tervel to face Leo the Isaurian's revolt and an Umayyad invasion. After Leo captured his son at Nicomedia, Theodosius abdicated on 25 March 717 and spent his remaining years as a monk.

en:
Theophilos (c. 812–842), Amorian emperor, was crowned co-emperor by his father Michael II in 821 and ruled alone from 829. He executed his father's accomplices in Leo V's murder to prove his justice. His 832 edict banning icon veneration made him Byzantium's last iconoclast ruler, and he persecuted defiant clerics.

He won at Charsianon in 831 and took Melitene in 837, but Caliph al-Mu'tasim sacked Amorion, the ancestral home of his dynasty, in 838. He died on 20 January 842, and his widow Theodora soon restored the icons.

Theophilos (c. 812–842), Amorian emperor, was crowned co-emperor by his father Michael II in 821 and ruled alone from 829. He executed his father's accomplices in Leo V's murder to prove his justice. His 832 edict banning icon veneration made him [GetCountry('BYZ').GetName]'s last iconoclast ruler, and he persecuted defiant clerics.

He won at Charsianon in 831 and took Melitene in 837, but Caliph al-Mu'tasim sacked Amorion, the ancestral home of his dynasty, in 838. He died on 20 January 842, and his widow Theodora soon restored the icons.
zh:
狄奥菲洛斯（约812—842）是阿摩里亚王朝皇帝，821年被父亲米海尔二世加冕为共治皇帝，829年开始亲政。他处死参与谋杀利奥五世的父亲旧党，以彰显正义。832年他下诏禁止崇拜圣像，成为拜占庭最后一位推行圣像破坏政策的皇帝，并迫害抗命的教士。

他在831年的哈西安农之战获胜，837年攻取梅利蒂尼，但哈里发穆阿台绥姆于838年攻陷了其王朝祖籍地阿莫利翁。842年1月20日狄奥菲洛斯去世，遗孀塞奥多拉很快恢复了圣像崇拜。

en:
Tiberius II Constantine (c. 535–582), a Thracian commander of the Excubitor guard, was the trusted friend of Justin II. Justin adopted him and named him Caesar in 574 during his madness.

Tiberius governed with Empress Sophia, and in September 578 the dying Justin crowned him Augustus before his death on 4 October. A generous ruler, he gave away thousands of pounds of gold and ended Monophysite persecution.

His general Maurice raided into Persia, but in 582 the Avars seized Sirmium and Slavs overran the Balkans. Dying, Tiberius made Maurice co-emperor on 13 August 582 and died the next day.
